armA.definition: Complete lack of inhibition or restraint.
armA.arabic: الانطلاق بحرية تامة من غير أي قيود أو كسوف.. زي لما ترقص بجنون.
examples: (Noun usage rare at A1)
(Noun usage rare at A2)
He drove with reckless abandon.
She danced with total abandon.
They spent money with wild abandon.
He threw himself into the project with characteristic abandon.
armA.mnemonic: اربطها بـ 'Band' 'فرقة موسيقية'.. لما تسمع الـ 'Band' بترقص بـ 'Abandon' 'انطلاق وحرية'.

armB.definition: Complete lack of inhibition or restraint.
armB.arabic: الانطلاق بحرية تامة من غير أي قيود أو كسوف.. زي لما ترقص بجنون.
examples: She danced with total abandon.
They spent money with wild abandon.
He drove with reckless abandon.
armB.mnemonic: اربطها بـ 'Band' 'فرقة موسيقية'.. لما تسمع الـ 'Band' بترقص بـ 'Abandon' 'انطلاق وحرية'.

armA.definition: Not present in a place; or not paying attention.
armA.arabic: غائب ومش موجود.. أو موجود بجسمه بس عقله مش معاه 'سرحان'.
examples: Why were you absent from school?
Love was totally absent from his childhood.
She had an absent look on her face.
armA.mnemonic: قسّمها: 'Ab-sent'.. يعني 'Sent' 'أرسلناه' بعيد فهو 'Absent' 'غائب'.

armB.definition: Not present in a place; or not paying attention.
armB.arabic: غائب ومش موجود.. أو موجود بجسمه بس عقله مش معاه 'سرحان'.
examples: He is absent today.
Why were you absent from school?
Love was totally absent from his childhood.
She had an absent look on her face.
He absented himself from the meeting.
In the absence of evidence, we cannot convict him.
armB.mnemonic: قسّمها: 'Ab-sent'.. يعني 'Sent' 'أرسلناه' بعيد فهو 'Absent' 'غائب'.

armA.definition: Existing or available in large quantities; plentiful.
armA.arabic: موجود بكميات كبيرة جداً وكفاية وزيادة، زي الميه في المحيط.
examples: There is a lot of food.
The garden has abundant flowers.
Fish are abundant in this lake.
We have an abundant supply of clean water.
The country is abundant in natural resources.
There is abundant evidence to support the theory.

armB.definition: Existing or available in large quantities; plentiful.
armB.arabic: موجود بكميات كبيرة جداً وكفاية وزيادة، زي الميه في المحيط.
examples: Fish are abundant in this lake.
We have an abundant supply of clean water.
There is abundant evidence to support the theory.

armA.definition: A teacher or scholar in a college or institute of higher education.
armA.arabic: شخص بيشتغل في الجامعة زي الدكتور أو الباحث.
examples: He wants to become an academic.
As an academic, he values research above all else.
The university invited a leading academic to deliver the keynote speech.

armB.definition: A teacher or scholar in a college or institute of higher education.
armB.arabic: شخص بيشتغل في الجامعة زي الدكتور أو الباحث.
examples: Not typically used in A1 contexts.
Not typically used in A2 contexts.
He wants to become an academic.
Academics from all over the world attended.
There is a debate among academics.
As an academic, he values research above all else.

armA.definition: Able to be agreed on; suitable; satisfactory.
armA.arabic: مقبول أو مُرضي. حاجة مش لازم تكون ممتازة بس كويسة وتمشي الحال.
examples: We need to find a solution that is acceptable to everyone.
Her work is acceptable but not great.
The noise levels were barely acceptable.
armA.mnemonic: جاية من 'Accept' 'يقبل'.. لو قبلت الحاجة، تبقى 'Acceptable' 'مقبولة'.

armB.definition: Able to be agreed on; suitable; satisfactory.
armB.arabic: مقبول أو مُرضي. حاجة مش لازم تكون ممتازة بس كويسة وتمشي الحال.
examples: The food is okay.
Is this price okay for you?
Her work is acceptable but not great.
We need to find a solution that is acceptable to everyone.
The noise levels were barely acceptable.
Such behavior is socially acceptable only in certain contexts.
armB.mnemonic: جاية من 'Accept' 'يقبل'.. لو قبلت الحاجة، تبقى 'Acceptable' 'مقبولة'.

armA.definition: In a way that is correct and true in every detail.
armA.arabic: بشكل دقيق وصحيح، من غير أي غلطات.
examples: It is difficult to predict the weather accurately.
The report accurately reflects the current situation.
The map depicts the area accurately.
armA.mnemonic: جاية من 'Accurate'.. زي الـ 'Cure' 'علاج' لازم يكون 'Accurate' 'دقيق' عشان يجيب نتيجة.

armB.definition: In a way that is correct and true in every detail.
armB.arabic: بشكل دقيق وصحيح، من غير أي غلطات.
examples: He counts well.
Please write the name accurately.
The map depicts the area accurately.
It is difficult to predict the weather accurately.
The report accurately reflects the current situation.
The sensor accurately measured the fluctuations in temperature.
armB.mnemonic: جاية من 'Accurate'.. زي الـ 'Cure' 'علاج' لازم يكون 'Accurate' 'دقيق' عشان يجيب نتيجة.

armA.definition: A person whose profession is acting on the stage, in movies, or on television.
armA.arabic: الشخص اللي بيمثل أدوار وشخصيات في الأفلام والمسلسلات.
examples: He is a famous actor.
I want to be an actor.
The actor played a funny role.
armA.mnemonic: هو الشخص اللي بيعمل 'Act' أو 'Action' 'فعل' التمثيل.

armB.definition: A person whose profession is acting on the stage, in movies, or on television.
armB.arabic: الشخص اللي بيمثل أدوار وشخصيات في الأفلام والمسلسلات.
examples: He is a famous actor.
I want to be an actor.
The actor played a funny role.
She is a talented actor and singer.
The actor's portrayal of the villain was chilling.
As a method actor, he stays in character for months.
armB.mnemonic: هو الشخص اللي بيعمل 'Act' أو 'Action' 'فعل' التمثيل.

armA.definition: Existing in fact; real.
armA.arabic: الحقيقي أو الفعلي، يعني اللي حصل بجد مش اللي إحنا متخيلينه.
examples: This is the actual car used in the movie.
The actual cost was higher than expected.
I need the actual figures, not estimates.
The actual problem is lack of communication.
There is a difference between perceived risk and actual risk.
The actualization of his dreams took many years of hard work.
armA.mnemonic: مش 'Act' 'تمثيل'.. ده 'Actual' يعني حقيقي وواقعي.

armB.definition: Existing in fact; real.
armB.arabic: الحقيقي أو الفعلي، يعني اللي حصل بجد مش اللي إحنا متخيلينه.
examples: This is the actual car used in the movie.
The actual cost was higher than expected.
I need the actual figures, not estimates.
armB.mnemonic: مش 'Act' 'تمثيل'.. ده 'Actual' يعني حقيقي وواقعي.

armA.definition: Severe or intense (of pain/illness); showing a perceptive understanding.
armA.arabic: وصف للألم الشديد جداً، أو للملاحظة الدقيقة والذكية 'بصيرة حادة'.
examples: She suffered from acute pain in her back.
He has an acute sense of hearing.
The report provides an acute analysis of the political situation.
armA.mnemonic: اربطها بـ 'Cut' 'جرح'.. الجرح بيسبب ألم 'Acute' 'حاد'.

armB.definition: Severe or intense (of pain/illness); showing a perceptive understanding.
armB.arabic: وصف للألم الشديد جداً، أو للملاحظة الدقيقة والذكية 'بصيرة حادة'.
examples: It is a sharp pain.
He has an acute illness.
The problem is becoming acute.
She suffered from acute pain in her back.
He has an acute sense of hearing.
The report provides an acute analysis of the political situation.
armB.mnemonic: اربطها بـ 'Cut' 'جرح'.. الجرح بيسبب ألم 'Acute' 'حاد'.

armA.definition: A person who gives advice, especially professionally in a particular field.
armA.arabic: شخص يقدم النصيحة أو المشورة، خاصة بشكل مهني أو رسمي مثل المستشار المالي أو القانوني.
examples: She works as a legal adviser for a large international firm.
I made an appointment to see a career adviser at the university.
You should consult a financial adviser before making any major investments.
armA.mnemonic: مشتقة من الفعل 'advise' (ينصح) مع اللاحقة 'er' التي تدل على الفاعل، فالـ adviser هو الشخص الذي يقدم النصح أو المستشار.

armB.definition: A person who gives advice, especially professionally.
armB.arabic: الشخص اللي بيدي نصايح، غالباً بيكون خبير أو مستشار في شغله.
examples: Not used in A1 contexts.
He is a financial adviser.
I need to speak to an adviser.
She works as a legal adviser for the firm.
The president's special adviser resigned.
He acts as a technical adviser on the film set.
armB.mnemonic: جاية من الفعل 'Advise' ينصح.. الـ 'Adviser' هو الناصح أو المستشار.

armA.definition: Formed by the combination of many separate units; total.
armA.arabic: إجمالي أو كلي.. الناتج عن تجميع حاجات كتير مع بعض.
examples: The total score is high.
They calculated the aggregate cost.
The aggregate number of students increased.
We analyzed the aggregate data from all branches.
The aggregate demand in the economy is rising.
The study examines the aggregate effect of these policies on the environment.
armA.mnemonic: قريبة من 'Agree' 'يوافق'.. لما الأرقام تتفق وتتجمع مع بعض بتعمل 'Aggregate'.

armB.definition: Formed by the combination of many separate units; total.
armB.arabic: إجمالي أو كلي.. الناتج عن تجميع حاجات كتير مع بعض.
examples: We analyzed the aggregate data from all branches.
The aggregate demand in the economy is rising.
The study examines the aggregate effect of these policies on the environment.
armB.mnemonic: قريبة من 'Agree' 'يوافق'.. لما الأرقام تتفق وتتجمع مع بعض بتعمل 'Aggregate'.

armA.definition: Belonging to a foreign country or nation; unfamiliar and disturbing.
armA.arabic: غريب جداً ومختلف عن اللي انت متعود عليه، أو جاي من كوكب تاني.
examples: It is strange.
It looks like an alien world.
Their customs are alien to us.
He felt alien in the big city.
The idea of cheating is alien to his nature.
The landscape was stark and alien, devoid of familiar vegetation.
armA.mnemonic: فيلم 'Alien' المشهور بتاع الفضاء.. الكائن كان 'Alien' غريب.

armB.definition: Belonging to a foreign country or nation; unfamiliar, strange, or opposed in nature.
armB.arabic: غريب جداً وغير مألوف، أو منافٍ لطبيعة الشخص ومبادئه، أو وافد من بلد أو عالم آخر.
examples: The idea of cheating is alien to his nature.
Their customs are alien to us.
The landscape was stark and alien, devoid of familiar vegetation.
armB.mnemonic: فيلم 'Alien' المشهور بتاع الفضاء.. الكائن كان 'Alien' غريب.

armA.definition: Claim or assert that someone has done something illegal or wrong, typically without proof.
armA.arabic: يدعي أو يزعم إن حد عمل حاجة غلط بس من غير دليل قاطع.
examples: The plaintiffs allege that the company misled investors about the risks.
Critics allege that the new policy will harm low-income families.
They allege that senior officials knew about the fraud for months.
armA.mnemonic: اربط الصوت بـ 'قال إيه' في العامية: كأنك بتعلق باستنكار على ادعاء بدون دليل: 'قال إيه (allege) بيزعم كذا!'

armB.definition: Claim or assert that someone has done something illegal or wrong, typically without proof.
armB.arabic: يدعي أو يزعم إن حد عمل حاجة غلط بس من غير دليل قاطع.
examples: He says he didn't do it.
They claim he is wrong.
She alleged that he stole the money.
The newspaper alleged a cover-up by the government.
The prosecution alleges that the defendant was at the scene.
It was alleged that the company had ignored safety regulations for years.
armB.mnemonic: الشرطة بتقول إنه سرق، بس هو بيـ 'Allege' إنه كان في البيت ومسرقش حاجة.

armA.definition: To cause someone to find something funny or entertaining.
armA.arabic: تخلي حد يضحك أو يتسلى 'يمتع'.
examples: The clown amused the kids.
This game will amuse you.
I bought a magazine to amuse myself on the train.
His jokes failed to amuse the audience.
We were amused by his awkward attempt to dance.
Queen Victoria famously said, 'We are not amused'.
armA.mnemonic: 'Muse' 'إلهة الفن'.. لما الـ 'Muse' تحضر، الناس بتنبسط وتـ 'Amuse'.

armB.definition: To cause someone to find something funny or entertaining.
armB.arabic: يُسَلّي أو يُضْحِك، أو يجعل شخصاً يقضي وقتاً ممتعاً ومسلياً.
examples: This game will amuse you.
I bought a magazine to amuse myself on the train.
His jokes failed to amuse the audience.
armB.mnemonic: 'Muse' 'إلهة الفن'.. لما الـ 'Muse' تحضر، الناس بتنبسط وتـ 'Amuse'.

armA.definition: To examine methodically and in detail the constitution or structure of something.
armA.arabic: إنك تحلل حاجة وتفصصها عشان تفهمها كويس، زي تحليل البيانات أو تحليل الدم.
examples: We need to analyse the survey results before making a decision.
Scientists will analyse the water samples to test for pollution.
The committee met to analyse the financial risks of the project.
armA.mnemonic: جاية من 'Analysis' 'تحليل'.. يعني بتعمل 'Analyse'.

armB.definition: To examine methodically and in detail the constitution or structure of something.
armB.arabic: إنك تحلل حاجة وتفصصها عشان تفهمها كويس، زي تحليل البيانات أو تحليل الدم.
examples: We analyze the data.
He analyzed the problem.
Scientists analyze the results of the experiment.
We need to analyze the market trends.
The software analyses text for sentiment.
She analyzed the poem's meter and rhyme scheme.
armB.mnemonic: جاية من 'Analysis' 'تحليل'.. يعني بتعمل 'Analyse'.

armA.definition: The space between two intersecting lines, or a way of looking at something.
armA.arabic: الزاوية الهندسية، أو وجهة نظر معينة بتشوف منها الموضوع.
examples: Draw a line at an angle.
The camera angle made him look tall.
Try to look at the problem from a different angle.
armA.mnemonic: كلمة 'Angle' 'زاوية' قريبة من 'Ankle' 'كاحل'.. الـ 'Ankle' بيعمل 'Angle' مع رجلك.

armB.definition: The space between two intersecting lines, or a way of looking at something.
armB.arabic: الزاوية الهندسية، أو وجهة نظر معينة بتشوف منها الموضوع.
examples: Look at this corner.
Draw a line at an angle.
The camera angle made him look tall.
Try to look at the problem from a different angle.
The article had a political angle to it.
The sun struck the water at an oblique angle.
armB.mnemonic: كلمة 'Angle' 'زاوية' قريبة من 'Ankle' 'كاحل'.. الـ 'Ankle' بيعمل 'Angle' مع رجلك.

armA.definition: A protein produced in the blood to fight diseases and foreign substances.
armA.arabic: مادة 'بروتين' جسمك بيفرزها عشان تحارب الأمراض والبكتيريا اللي بتهاجمك.
examples: The body fights germs.
Antibodies help us stay healthy.
The vaccine helps your body make antibodies.
Tests showed a high level of antibodies in her blood.
The virus mutates to escape antibody detection.
Monoclonal antibody therapy is used for certain cancers.
armA.mnemonic: 'Anti' يعني ضد.. و 'Body' يعني جسم.. هو جسم صغير 'Anti' 'ضد' الأمراض.

armB.definition: A protein produced in the blood to fight diseases and foreign substances.
armB.arabic: مادة 'بروتين' جسمك بيفرزها عشان تحارب الأمراض والبكتيريا اللي بتهاجمك.
examples: The lab test checks whether a protective antibody is present in the bloodstream.
The virus mutates to escape antibody detection.
Monoclonal antibody therapy has become an effective treatment for certain cancers.
armB.mnemonic: 'Anti' يعني ضد.. و 'Body' يعني جسم.. هو جسم صغير 'Anti' 'ضد' الأمراض.

armA.definition: A regretful acknowledgment of an offense or failure.
armA.arabic: الاعتذار. لما تقول لحد 'أنا آسف' عشان غلطت في حقه.
examples: He said sorry.
She wrote a letter of apology.
I accepted his apology.
He owes you a sincere apology.
The company issued a public apology for the error.
His so-called apology was merely a justification for his behavior.
armA.mnemonic: جاية من 'Apologize'.. لما تقول 'I am sorry' ده اسمه 'Apology'

armB.definition: A regretful acknowledgment of an offense or failure.
armB.arabic: الاعتذار، وهو إظهار الندم والاعتراف بالخطأ لطلب العفو أو تصحيح الموقف.
examples: She wrote a letter of apology.
He owes you a sincere apology.
The company issued a public apology for the error.
armB.mnemonic: تخيل أن رائد فضاء من رحلة 'أبولو جِه' (Apollo-gy) علشان يقدّم اعتذار رسمي.

armA.definition: A software application, especially for a mobile device.
armA.arabic: برنامج صغير بتنزله على موبايلك أو الكمبيوتر عشان تعمل بيه حاجة معينة، زي 'Whatsapp' أو 'Uber'.
examples: I have a game app.
Download the app to your phone.
This app helps you learn languages.
The app crashed and I lost my data.
Developers are constantly updating the app.
The app's interface is intuitive and user-friendly.
armA.mnemonic: هي اختصار لكلمة 'Application'.. وأول حروفها 'App' زي 'Apple'.. تخيل إنك بتنزل 'App' من على 'Apple' ستور.

armB.definition: A software application, especially for a mobile device.
armB.arabic: برنامج صغير بتنزله على موبايلك أو الكمبيوتر عشان تعمل بيه حاجة معينة، زي 'Whatsapp' أو 'Uber'.
examples: Download the app to your phone.
This app helps you learn languages.
The app crashed and I lost my data.
armB.mnemonic: هي اختصار لكلمة 'Application'.. وأول حروفها 'App' زي 'Apple'.. تخيل إنك بتنزل 'App' من على 'Apple' ستور.

armA.definition: To add something as an attachment or supplement.
armA.arabic: تضيف حاجة في آخر حاجة تانية، زي لما ترفق ملف مع إيميل أو تضيف ملاحظة في آخر الكتاب.
examples: Add this to the end.
Please append your signature here.
He appended a note to the letter.
The author appended a bibliography to the book.
The lawyer asked to append a new clause to the contract.
The software allows you to append new records to the database.
armA.mnemonic: قريبة من 'Appendix' 'الزائدة الدودية أو الملحق'.. الـ 'Append' هو فعل الإضافة أو الإلحاق.

armB.definition: To add something as an attachment or supplement.
armB.arabic: تضيف حاجة في آخر حاجة تانية، زي لما ترفق ملف مع إيميل أو تضيف ملاحظة في آخر الكتاب.
examples: Please append your signature here.
The lawyer asked to append a new clause to the contract.
The software allows you to append new records to the database.
armB.mnemonic: قريبة من 'Appendix' 'الزائدة الدودية أو الملحق'.. الـ 'Append' هو فعل الإضافة أو الإلحاق.

armA.definition: Relevant or appropriate to a particular situation.
armA.arabic: حاجة تنفع تتطبق أو مناسبة للموقف ده.
examples: This rule is for you.
Fill in the form where applicable.
The discount is applicable to students only.
These laws are not applicable in this country.
The theory is applicable to many different fields.
The clause is deemed applicable under international maritime law.
armA.mnemonic: جاية من 'Apply' 'يطبق'.. الـ 'Applicable' هو اللي قابل للتطبيق.

armB.definition: Relevant or appropriate to a particular situation, person, or thing.
armB.arabic: مناسب أو ينفع يُطبّق في حالة أو موقف معين (قابل للتطبيق).
examples: Fill in the form where applicable.
The discount is applicable to students only.
The theory is applicable to many different fields.
armB.mnemonic: جاية من الفعل Apply (يطبق)، واللاحقة able- تعني قابل لـ، يبقى applicable = قابل للتطبيق.

armA.definition: In a manner that is suitable or proper in the circumstances.
armA.arabic: إنك تعمل الحاجة بالشكل الصح والمناسب للموقف اللي إنت فيه.
examples: You should dress appropriately for the interview.
She responded appropriately to the question.
The funds were not used appropriately.
armA.translations: بشكل مناسب على نحو ملائم بما يناسب الموقف
armA.mnemonic: من 'Proper' مناسب.. اتصرف 'Appropriately' يعني خليك 'Proper' ومحترم.

armB.definition: In a manner that is suitable or proper in the circumstances.
armB.arabic: إنك تعمل الحاجة بالشكل الصح والمناسب للموقف اللي إنت فيه.
examples: Please dress well.
He didn't act appropriately.
She responded appropriately to the question.
You should dress appropriately for the interview.
The funds were not used appropriately.
The committee failed to deal appropriately with the conflict of interest.
armB.mnemonic: من 'Proper' مناسب.. اتصرف 'Appropriately' يعني خليك 'Proper' ومحترم.

armA.definition: To emerge; to become apparent; to come into being.
armA.arabic: حاجة تظهر أو تحصل فجأة، زي مشكلة أو فرصة.
examples: Questions may arise during the meeting.
Serious consequences may arise from this decision.
New difficulties can arise if we do not plan carefully.
armA.mnemonic: تشبه 'Rise' 'يشرق/يصعد'.. لما المشكلة 'Arise' يعني بتطلع وتظهر قدامك.

armB.definition: To emerge; to become apparent; to come into being.
armB.arabic: حاجة تظهر أو تحصل فجأة، زي مشكلة أو فرصة.
examples: Problems arise.
A new difficulty has arisen.
Questions may arise during the meeting.
If the need arises, we will hire more staff.
Serious consequences may arise from this decision.
A controversy arose regarding the interpretation of the law.
armB.mnemonic: تشبه 'Rise' 'يشرق/يصعد'.. لما المشكلة 'Arise' يعني بتطلع وتظهر قدامك.

armA.definition: Able to express thoughts and feelings clearly and effectively.
armA.arabic: شخص فصيح، بيعرف يعبر عن أفكاره بوضوح ولباقة.
examples: She is very articulate for her age.
The teacher gave an articulate explanation.
The lawyer presented a highly articulate defense of his client.
armA.mnemonic: زي 'Article' 'مقال'.. الشخص الـ 'Articulate' بيتكلم بوضوح وترتيب كأنه بيقرا 'Article' مكتوب ببراعة.

armB.definition: Able to express thoughts and feelings clearly and effectively.
armB.arabic: شخص فصيح، بيعرف يعبر عن أفكاره بوضوح ولباقة.
examples: He speaks clearly.
She is very articulate for her age.
The teacher gave an articulate explanation.
He is an intelligent and articulate speaker.
She was unusually articulate about her feelings.
The lawyer presented a highly articulate defense of his client.
armB.mnemonic: زي 'Article' 'مقال'.. الشخص الـ 'Articulate' بيتكلم بوضوح وترتيب كأنه بيقرا 'Article' مكتوب ببراعة.

armA.definition: To express an idea or feeling fluently and coherently.
armA.arabic: إنك تعرف تعبر عن أفكارك وتتكلم بوضوح وطلاقة.
examples: She struggled to articulate her feelings.
The teacher helped him articulate his thoughts.
He was able to articulate the complex theory simply.
armA.mnemonic: كلمة 'Art' 'فن'.. الـ 'Articulate' عنده فن الكلام.

armB.definition: To express an idea or feeling fluently and coherently.
armB.arabic: إنك تعرف تعبر عن أفكارك وتتكلم بوضوح وطلاقة.
examples: Speak clearly.
He can articulate his words well.
She struggled to articulate her feelings.
The teacher helped him articulate his thoughts.
He was able to articulate the complex theory simply.
The philosophy was never fully articulated by its founder.
armB.mnemonic: كلمة 'Art' 'فن'.. الـ 'Articulate' عنده فن الكلام.

armA.definition: A writer of a book, article, or report.
armA.arabic: المؤلف أو الكاتب اللي بيألف الكتب والقصص.
examples: He is a famous author.
Who is the author of this book?
The author signed my copy.
She is the author of several scientific papers.
As the author of the report, he took full responsibility.
The author's distinctive voice permeates every chapter.
armA.mnemonic: الـ 'Author' هو اللي عنده الـ 'Authority' 'سلطة' على القصة اللي بيكتبها.

armB.definition: A writer of a book, article, or report.
armB.arabic: المؤلف أو الكاتب اللي بيألف الكتب والقصص.
examples: He is a famous author.
Who is the author of this book?
The author signed my copy.
armB.mnemonic: الـ 'Author' هو اللي عنده الـ 'Authority' (سلطة) على القصة اللي بيكتبها.

armA.definition: Having the freedom to govern itself or control its own affairs, or capable of operating independently without external control.
armA.arabic: مستقل.. بيحكم نفسه بنفسه أو بيشتغل لوحده من غير تحكم خارجي.
examples: Universities are often autonomous institutions.
The country is divided into several autonomous regions.
The development of autonomous weapons systems raises ethical questions.
armA.mnemonic: 'Auto' يعني 'تلقائي' أو 'ذاتي'.. 'Autonomous' يعني شغال مع نفسه باستقلالية.

armB.definition: Having the freedom to govern itself or control its own affairs.
armB.arabic: مستقل.. بيحكم نفسه بنفسه أو بيشتغل لوحده من غير تحكم خارجي.
examples: The robot moves by itself.
He wants to be independent.
The region has its own government.
Universities are often autonomous institutions.
The country is divided into several autonomous regions.
The development of autonomous weapons systems raises ethical questions.
armB.mnemonic: 'Auto' يعني 'تلقائي' أو 'ذاتي'.. 'Autonomous' يعني شغال مع نفسه باستقلالية.

armA.definition: The action of keeping away from or not doing something.
armA.arabic: إنك تتجنب حاجة أو تبعد عنها، زي تجنب المشاكل أو الضرايب.
examples: His avoidance of the question was obvious.
Collision avoidance systems are now common in cars.
Tax avoidance is legal, but tax evasion is a crime.
armA.mnemonic: جاية من 'Avoid' يعني يتجنب.. الـ 'Avoidance' هو التجنب نفسه

armB.definition: The action of keeping away from or not doing something.
armB.arabic: إنك تتجنب حاجة أو تبعد عنها.. زي تجنب المشاكل أو الضرايب
examples: Stay away from fire.
Avoidance of bad food is good.
His avoidance of the question was obvious.
Collision avoidance systems are now common in cars.
Tax avoidance is legal, but tax evasion is a crime.
Psychological avoidance of trauma can lead to long-term issues.
armB.mnemonic: جاية من 'Avoid' يعني يتجنب.. الـ 'Avoidance' هو التجنب نفسه

armA.definition: A brightly colored rubber bag inflated with air or gas, used as a toy or decoration.
armA.arabic: كيس مطاطي ملون بننفخه هوا أو غاز، بنستخدمه في اللعب والزينة.
examples: I want a red balloon.
The child cried when his balloon popped.
They took a ride in a hot-air balloon.
armA.mnemonic: هي هي بالعربي 'بالون'.

armB.definition: A brightly colored rubber bag inflated with air or gas, used as a toy or decoration.
armB.arabic: كيس مطاطي ملون بننفخه هوا أو غاز، بنستخدمه في اللعب والزينة.
examples: I want a red balloon.
We blew up balloons for the birthday party.
The child cried when his balloon popped.
They took a ride in a hot-air balloon.
The national debt has ballooned in recent years.
The politician floated a trial balloon to test public reaction.
armB.mnemonic: هي هي بالعربي 'بالون'.

armA.definition: An institution for keeping money, or the land along a river.
armA.arabic: ليها معنيين: البنك اللي بنحط فيه الفلوس، أو ضفة النهر 'الشط'.
examples: I need to go to the bank.
He sat on the river bank.
I have a bank account.
The plane banked to the left.
Don't bank on him helping you.
The data bank contains sensitive information.
armA.mnemonic: الـ 'Bank' بيحفظ الفلوس زي ما 'Tank' 'الخزان' بيحفظ الماية.

armB.definition: An institution for keeping money, or the land along a river.
armB.arabic: ليها معنيين: البنك اللي بنحط فيه الفلوس، أو ضفة النهر 'الشط'.
examples: I need to go to the bank to withdraw some cash.
She works as a manager at a local bank.
We sat on the river bank and had a picnic.
armB.mnemonic: الـ 'Bank' بيحفظ الفلوس زي ما 'Tank' 'الخزان' بيحفظ الماية.

armA.definition: The legal state of being unable to pay outstanding debts.
armA.arabic: حالة قانونية لما الشخص أو الشركة مايقدروش يسددوا ديونهم، يعني 'فلّسوا' رسميًا.
examples: The company declared bankruptcy last year.
Many small businesses face bankruptcy during a recession.
The moral bankruptcy of the regime was evident to all.
armA.mnemonic: كلمة 'Bank' (بنك) و'Rupt' تشبه 'Rupture' (تمزق أو كسر)؛ يعني علاقتك بالبنك انكسرت ولم يعد معك مال لسداد ديونك.

armB.definition: The legal state of being unable to pay outstanding debts.
armB.arabic: حالة قانونية لما الشخص أو الشركة مايقدروش يسددوا ديونهم، يعني 'فلّسوا' رسميًا.
examples: The shop has no money left.
He lost his money and faced bankruptcy.
The company declared bankruptcy last year.
Many small businesses face bankruptcy during a recession.
The moral bankruptcy of the regime was evident to all.
They filed for Chapter 11 bankruptcy to restructure their debts.
armB.mnemonic: كلمة 'Bank' 'بنك' و 'Rupt' زي 'Rupture' 'تمزق/كسر'.. يعني علاقتك بالبنك انكسرت وماعدش معاك فلوس.

armA.definition: An unpleasant or despicable person (informal); historically, an illegitimate child.
armA.arabic: كلمة شتيمة بتتقال للشخص الوغد أو السيء جداً. وأصلها كان معناها 'ابن غير شرعي'.
examples: He acted like a total bastard to his staff.
I can't believe that bastard stole my idea.
In medieval times, being a bastard affected your inheritance rights.
armA.mnemonic: كلمة بنسمعها كتير في الأفلام الأجنبي لما حد يشتم حد ويقوله يا 'Bastard'.

armB.definition: An unpleasant or despicable person (informal); historically, an illegitimate child.
armB.arabic: كلمة شتيمة بتتقال للشخص الوغد أو السيء جداً. وأصلها كان معناها 'ابن غير شرعي'.
examples: He is a bad man.
Don't be mean.
He acted like a total bastard to his staff.
Life can be a real bastard sometimes.
I can't believe that bastard stole my idea.
In medieval times, being a bastard affected your inheritance rights.
armB.mnemonic: كلمة بنسمعها كتير في الأفلام الأجنبي لما حد يشتم حد ويقوله يا 'Bastard'.

armA.definition: To exist, live, or occur; used to describe the state, quality, or identity of something.
armA.arabic: يكون.. يعني الفعل اللي بيوصف الحالة أو الوجود. زي لما تقول 'أنا أكون سعيد' أو 'هو يكون دكتور'
examples: I want to be a teacher.
She was happy yesterday.
You must be tired after the trip.
The meeting is to be held on Monday.
Whatever may be the consequences, I will do it.
To be or not to be, that is the question.
armA.mnemonic: كلمة 'Be' شبه كلمة 'Bee' 'نحلة'.. تخيل نحلة بتقول 'I want to be a Queen' 'عايزة أكون ملكة'

armB.definition: To exist, live, or occur; used to describe the state, quality, or identity of something.
armB.arabic: يكون.. يعني الفعل اللي بيوصف الحالة أو الوجود. زي لما تقول 'أنا أكون سعيد' أو 'هو يكون دكتور'
examples: I want to be a teacher.
Please be careful.
You must be tired after the trip.
armB.mnemonic: كلمة 'Be' شبه كلمة 'Bee' 'نحلة'.. تخيل نحلة بتقول 'I want to be a Queen' 'عايزة أكون ملكة'

armA.definition: A pebbly or sandy shore, especially by the ocean between high- and low-water marks.
armA.arabic: الشاطئ أو البلاج، المكان اللي فيه رمل وميه وبنروح نصيف فيه.
examples: We played on the beach.
Let's go to the beach tomorrow.
The hotel has a private beach.
They walked along the sandy beach at sunset.
The whales beached themselves on the shore.
The coastline is characterized by pristine, secluded beaches.

armB.definition: An area of sand or small stones next to the ocean or a lake.
armB.arabic: الشاطئ أو البلاج، وهو مساحة من الرمل أو الحصى بجوار البحر أو البحيرة.
examples: We played on the beach.
Let's go to the beach tomorrow.
The hotel has a private beach.

armA.definition: To carry the weight of; to support or endure.
armA.arabic: يتحمل أو يطيق حاجة صعبة، أو يشيل مسؤولية، وساعات بتيجي بمعنى يحمل 'زي يحمل اسم'.
examples: The bridge was designed to bear the weight of heavy trucks.
He could not bear the pain any longer.
Please bear in mind that the rules have changed.
armA.mnemonic: تخيل إنك شايل 'Bear' 'دب' تقيل على ضهرك.. لازم 'Bear' 'تتحمل' الوزن ده.

armB.definition: To carry the weight of; to support or endure.
armB.arabic: يتحمل أو يطيق حاجة صعبة، أو يشيل مسؤولية، وساعات بتيجي بمعنى يحمل 'زي يحمل اسم'.
examples: I cannot bear this noise.
She bears a heavy load on her back.
Please bear in mind that the rules have changed.
He couldn't bear the pain any longer.
The bridge was designed to bear the weight of heavy trucks.
She bore the burden of her family's secrets for decades.
armB.mnemonic: تخيل إنك شايل 'Bear' 'دب' تقيل على ضهرك.. لازم 'Bear' 'تتحمل' الوزن ده.

armA.definition: To start doing something; to undergo the first part of an action.
armA.arabic: يبدأ.. يعني تبتدي وتعمل أول خطوة في الموضوع.
examples: We can begin the meeting now.
What time does the concert begin?
They will begin to work tomorrow.
armA.mnemonic: عكس 'End'.. 'Begin' يعني يبدأ.

armB.definition: To start doing something; to undergo the first part of an action.
armB.arabic: يبدأ.. يعني تبتدي وتعمل أول خطوة في الموضوع.
examples: Class begins at nine.
She began to sing.
It began to rain heavily.
He began his career as a teacher.
The negotiations began in secret.
The universe began with the Big Bang.
armB.mnemonic: عكس 'End'.. 'Begin' يعني يبدأ.

armA.definition: A hollow metal object that makes a ringing sound when struck.
armA.arabic: الجرس المعدن اللي بيعمل صوت رنين عشان ينبهك.
examples: The school bell rang.
I have a bell on my bike.
The warning bell tolled ominously in the distance.
armA.mnemonic: كلمة 'Bell' شبه 'Bill' 'فاتورة'.. بس الجرس صوته أحلى من صوت الفاتورة.

armB.definition: A hollow metal object that makes a ringing sound when struck.
armB.arabic: الجرس المعدن اللي بيعمل صوت رنين عشان ينبهك.
examples: The school bell rang.
I have a bell on my bike.
She rang the doorbell twice.
The church bells chime every hour.
That name rings a bell (sounds familiar).
The warning bell tolled ominously in the distance.
armB.mnemonic: كلمة 'Bell' شبه 'Bill' 'فاتورة'.. بس الجرس صوته أحلى من صوت الفاتورة.

armA.definition: The front part of the human body below the chest, containing the stomach and bowels.
armA.arabic: يعني البطن أو الكرش. كلمة عامية شوية وبسيطة عن كلمة 'Stomach'.
examples: My belly is full.
The baby was sleeping on its belly.
He has a bit of a pot belly from drinking too much beer.
The plane landed on its belly.
They laughed deep in their bellies.
The underbelly of the city is full of crime.
armA.mnemonic: الـ 'Belly' يعني البطن.. افتكر الراجل اللي عنده 'Belly' كبير شبه الـ 'Bell' 'الجرس'.

armB.definition: The front part of the human body below the chest, containing the stomach and bowels.
armB.arabic: يعني البطن أو الكرش. كلمة عامية شوية وبسيطة عن كلمة 'Stomach'.
examples: My belly is full.
The baby was sleeping on its belly.
The plane landed on its belly.
armB.mnemonic: الـ 'Belly' يعني البطن.. افتكر الراجل اللي عنده 'Belly' كبير شبه الـ 'Bell' 'الجرس'.

armA.definition: To shape or force into a curve; to incline the body downward.
armA.arabic: إنك تتني حاجة وتخليها مقوسة، أو إنك تميل جسمك لتحت.
examples: Bend your knees.
Can you bend this wire?
He bent down to pick up the coin.
The trees were bending in the wind.
They refused to bend to the terrorists' demands.
He tried to bend the rules to suit his purpose.
armA.mnemonic: اربطها بـ 'Band'.. زي ما الـ 'Band' 'الرباط' ممكن تعمل له 'Bend' 'تثنيه'.

armB.definition: To shape or force into a curve; to incline the body downward.
armB.arabic: إنك تتني حاجة وتخليها مقوسة، أو إنك تميل جسمك لتحت.
examples: Can you bend this wire?
Make sure to bend your knees when lifting heavy objects.
He refused to bend the rules for anyone.
armB.mnemonic: اربطها بـ 'Band'.. زي ما الـ 'Band' 'الرباط' ممكن تعمل له 'Bend' 'تثنيه'.

armA.definition: The holy book of Christians; or any book considered the most authoritative on a subject.
armA.arabic: الكتاب المقدس عند المسيحيين، وممكن تستخدم مجازاً لأي كتاب مهم جداً وشامل في مجاله.
examples: The Bible is a holy book.
He reads the Bible every Sunday.
There are many stories in the Bible.
This cookbook is the bible of French cooking.
Scholars analyze the Bible's historical context.
For investors, this report is the bible of the industry.
armA.mnemonic: قريبة من كلمة 'By' 'بواسطة'.. الكتاب اللي الناس بتهتدي 'By' بواسطته هو الـ 'Bible'.

armB.definition: The holy book of Christians; or any book considered the most authoritative on a subject.
armB.arabic: الكتاب المقدس عند المسيحيين، وممكن تستخدم مجازاً لأي كتاب مهم جداً وشامل في مجاله.
examples: He reads the Bible every Sunday.
There are many stories in the Bible.
This cookbook is the bible of French cooking.
armB.mnemonic: قريبة من كلمة 'By' 'بواسطة'.. الكتاب اللي الناس بتهتدي 'By' بواسطته هو الـ 'Bible'.

armA.definition: A difficult or annoying situation; also, something that binds or fastens.
armA.arabic: ورطة أو مأزق.. لما تكون في موقف صعب ومش عارف تتصرف. 'Informal: in a bind'.
examples: This is a problem.
I am in a difficult spot.
The glue acts as a bind for the wood.
His sudden departure put the team in a real bind.
We are in a bind because the funding was cut.
The legal double bind made it impossible for him to testify.
armA.mnemonic: كلمة 'Bind' شبه 'بند'.. البند ده في العقد حطني في 'Bind' 'ورطة' كبيرة

armB.definition: A difficult, awkward, or problematic situation from which it is hard to escape; a predicament.
armB.arabic: ورطة أو مأزق؛ موقف صعب أو معقد يجد الشخص صعوبة في الخروج منه، ويُستخدم كثيراً في التعبير 'in a bind'.
examples: His sudden departure put the team in a real bind.
We are in a bind because the funding was cut.
The unexpected train strike left hundreds of commuters in a tight bind.
armB.mnemonic: كلمة 'Bind' شبه 'بند'.. البند ده في العقد حطني في 'Bind' 'ورطة' كبيرة

armA.definition: To tie or fasten something tightly; to unite people or things.
armA.arabic: يربط حاجة جامد، أو يجمع الناس مع بعض برابط قوي.
examples: Tie the shoes.
They bind the books together.
Use a rope to bind the logs.
Shared experiences bind them together.
The contract binds the company to pay the fees.
Proteins bind to specific receptors on the cell surface.
armA.mnemonic: زي ما تقول 'بند'.. العقد فيه 'بند' بيعمل 'Bind' 'بيلزم' الطرفين

armB.definition: To tie or fasten tightly, unite people or things, or legally oblige someone.
armB.arabic: يربط شيئاً بإحكام، أو يجمع الناس برابط قوي، أو يُلزم قانونياً وأخلاقياً.
examples: Use a rope to bind the logs.
Shared experiences bind them together.
The terms of this agreement legally bind both parties.
armB.mnemonic: زي ما تقول 'بند'.. العقد فيه 'بند' بيعمل 'Bind' 'بيلزم' الطرفين

armA.definition: A female dog (literal); slang for a difficult situation or an unpleasant person.
armA.arabic: المعنى الأصلي: أنثى الكلب. في العامية: بتستخدم لوصف موقف صعب جداً أو كإهانة 'امرأة سيئة'.
examples: The bitch is feeding her puppies.
The dog breeder has a champion bitch.
Life can be a real bitch sometimes.
Stop complaining and quit bitching.
The exam was a real bitch to pass.
He muttered something about her being a bitch under his breath.

armB.definition: A female dog, wolf, or fox; informally, an offensive term for an unpleasant woman or a slang term for a very difficult situation.
armB.arabic: المعنى الحرفي: أنثى الكلب. وفي العامية تُستخدم كلفظ مهين لوصف امرأة سيئة الطباع، أو مجازياً للتعبير عن موقف أو أمر شديد الصعوبة والمشقة.
examples: The dog breeder has a champion bitch.
The exam was a real bitch to pass.
Life can be a real bitch sometimes.
armB.translations: أنثى الكلب كلبة أمر شاق ومزعج

armA.definition: A website where someone regularly records their thoughts or opinions.
armA.arabic: موقع شخصي على النت بتكتب فيه مقالات أو يوميات أو رأيك في حاجة معينة، والناس ممكن تقراها وتعلق عليها.
examples: I read a blog about food.
She writes a blog every week.
He started a travel blog to share his photos.
armA.mnemonic: تذكر أن كلمة blog منحوتة من web + log، أي أنها سجل أو يوميات (log) على شبكة الويب (web).

armB.definition: A website where someone regularly records their thoughts or opinions.
armB.arabic: موقع شخصي على النت بتكتب فيه مقالات أو يوميات أو رأيك في حاجة معينة، والناس ممكن تقراها وتعلق عليها.
examples: I read a blog about food.
She writes a blog every week.
He started a travel blog to share his photos.
Fashion blogs have become very influential in the industry.
The political blog sparked a heated debate online.
Micro-blogging platforms have transformed modern journalism.
armB.mnemonic: كلمة 'Blog' جاية من 'Block'.. كأنك بتكتب في 'Block' نوتة بس على النت.

armA.definition: To send out a stream of air from the mouth, or of the wind, to move and create a current of air.
armA.arabic: تطلع هوا من بؤك عشان تطفي شمعة أو تنفخ بالونة، أو لما الهوا يتحرك بقوة.
examples: Make a wish and blow out the candles on your birthday cake.
A cold wind began to blow across the empty street.
You should blow gently on the soup to cool it down.
armA.mnemonic: اربطها بكلمة 'Flow' 'تدفق'.. الـ 'Blow' هو تدفق الهوا.

armB.definition: To send a current of air from your mouth.
armB.arabic: تطلع هوا من بؤك عشان تطفي شمعة أو تنفخ بالونة، أو لما الهوا يتحرك بقوة.
examples: The wind blows hard.
Blow out the candles.
He blew into the trumpet.
The storm blew the roof off.
Don't blow your chance to win.
The scandal blew over after a few weeks.
armB.mnemonic: اربطها بكلمة 'Flow' 'تدفق'.. الـ 'Blow' هو تدفق الهوا.

armA.definition: A flat piece of wood or other hard material used for a specific purpose, or a flat surface used for writing on or displaying information; also, a group of people who control an organization.
armA.arabic: لوح خشب أو سبورة بنكتب عليها، وممكن تيجي بمعنى مجلس الإدارة اللي بياخد القرارات في الشركة.
examples: The teacher wrote the answer on the board.
We need a long wooden board to fix the fence.
The board of directors met to discuss the budget.
armA.mnemonic: كلمة 'Board' قريبة من 'Bored' 'زهقان'.. الطلاب بيبصوا على الـ 'Board' 'السبورة' وهم 'Bored'.

armB.definition: A long, thin, flat piece of wood or other hard material used for floors or other building purposes.
armB.arabic: لوح خشب أو سبورة بنكتب عليها، وممكن تيجي بمعنى مجلس الإدارة اللي بياخد القرارات في الشركة.
examples: The teacher wrote the answer on the board.
We need a long wooden board to fix the fence.
He is a member of the school board.
The board of directors met to discuss the budget.
The floorboards creaked as he walked across the room.
She swept the pieces off the chess board in frustration.
armB.mnemonic: كلمة 'Board' قريبة من 'Bored' 'زهقان'.. الطلاب بيبصوا على الـ 'Board' 'السبورة' وهم 'Bored'.

armA.definition: A strong shoe that covers the foot and ankle.
armA.arabic: الحذاء اللي برقبته عالية 'البوت'. وفي بريطانيا بيقولوا 'Boot' على شنطة العربية.

Put your bags in the boot of the car.
These hiking boots are waterproof.
The computer needs a reboot.

armA.mnemonic: 'بوت'.. كلنا بنلبس 'Boot' في الشتا.

armB.definition: A strong shoe that covers the foot and ankle.

Put your bags in the boot of the car.

armB.mnemonic: 'بوت'.. كلنا بنلبس 'Boot' في الشتا.

armA.definition: A regular male companion with whom one has a romantic or sexual relationship.
armA.arabic: الصديق أو الحبيب اللي البنت مرتبطة بيه عاطفياً.
examples: He is my boyfriend.
She loves her boyfriend.
I introduced my boyfriend to my parents.
They have been boyfriend and girlfriend for years.
She broke up with her boyfriend yesterday.
The concept of a 'boyfriend' varies across different cultures.

armB.mnemonic: 'Boy' 'ولد' + 'Friend' 'صديق'.. يعني صديق ولد 'حبيب'.

armA.definition: A part of a tree growing from the trunk; or a local office of a company.
armA.arabic: ممكن يكون غصن شجرة، وممكن يكون فرع لشركة أو بنك في مكان معين.

Our bank has a branch near my house.
Botany is a branch of biology.

armB.definition: A part of a tree growing from the trunk; or a local office of a company.

He promised not to break the law.

armB.definition: To separate into pieces as a result of a blow, shock, or strain.

armA.definition: To keep animals for the purpose of producing young; to cause something to happen.
armA.arabic: إنك تربي حيوانات عشان تنتج منها سلالات جديدة، أو بمعنى يسبب ويولد مشاعر معينة.
examples: They breed horses on this farm.
Mosquitoes breed in stagnant water.
Poor living conditions often breed crime and social unrest.
armA.mnemonic: كلمة 'Breed' قريبة من 'Bread' 'عيش'.. زي ما العيش بيخمر ويكتر، الـ 'Breed' يعني يتكاثر ويزيد.

armA.definition: A woman on her wedding day or just before it.
armA.arabic: المرأة في يوم زفافها أو قبله مباشرة (العروس أو العروسة).
examples: The bride wore a traditional white dress.
The bride and groom cut the wedding cake together.
She was a nervous bride on her wedding day.
armA.mnemonic: 'Bride' قريبة من 'Pride' (فخر).. العريس يشعر بالـ 'Pride' بعروسته الـ 'Bride'.

armB.definition: A woman on her wedding day or just before it.
armB.arabic: الست في يوم فرحها 'العروسة'.
examples: The bride looks beautiful.
The bride and groom cut the cake.
She was a nervous bride on her wedding day.

armB.mnemonic: 'Bride' قريبة من 'Pride' 'فخر'.. العريس بيبقى عنده 'Pride' بعروسته الـ 'Bride'.

armA.definition: To take or carry someone or something to a place.
armA.arabic: يحضر أو يجيب.. يعني تجيب حاجة معاك وإنت جاي.

The news brought tears to her eyes.

armB.mnemonic: شبه كلمة 'Pringles'.. ممكن تقولي 'Bring Pringles'؟ يعني هات برينجلز.

armA.definition: Something that absorbs shock or protects against impact; or temporary computer memory.
armA.arabic: حاجة بتفصل بين شيئين عشان تقلل الصدمة أو التأثير، أو مساحة تخزين مؤقتة في الكمبيوتر.
examples: Trees act as a buffer against the wind.
Savings can be a buffer against financial trouble.
The UN established a buffer zone between the two countries.
armA.mnemonic: كلمة 'Buffer' بتفكرك بـ 'Bumper' اكصدام العربية.. الاتنين بيحمو من الصدمات.

armB.definition: Something that absorbs shock or protects against impact; or temporary computer memory.

examples: The video is buffering.
Use a buffer to polish the car.
Trees act as a buffer against the wind.

armA.definition: To make something by putting bricks or other materials together.
armA.arabic: يبني حاجة زي بيت أو عمارة، أو حتى يبني مهارة ويطورها.
examples: We want to build a sandcastle on the beach.

armA.definition: A soft yellow fat obtained from milk, used in cooking and on bread.
armA.arabic: الزبدة الصفرا اللي بنعملها من اللبن وبنحطها على العيش أو نطبخ بيها.
examples: I like bread and butter.

You need butter to bake a cake.

armA.definition: A very large and important church, usually the main one in an area.

armA.definition: To act as chairperson of or preside over (an organization, meeting, or public event).
armA.arabic: لما تكون أنت الريس أو المسؤول اللي بيدير الاجتماع والقعدة

armA.definition: To pick out or select as being the best or most appropriate.
armA.arabic: يختار حاجة من وسط حاجات كتير، أو يقرر ياخد حاجة معينة.

armA.definition: To arrange something in groups or categories according to shared qualities.

armA.definition: A sharp, curved nail on the foot of an animal or bird, or the pincer of a shellfish such as a crab.

Traditionalists cling to the old customs despite modern changes.
armB.mnemonic: نفس الفكرة: 'Cling' يعني يلزق زي 'Link'.

armA.definition: Awkward in movement or in handling things.
armA.arabic: يعني حركته تقيلة وبيوقع الحاجات.. مش رشيق
examples: The waiter was clumsy and spilled the wine.
He made a clumsy attempt to catch the ball.
The bulky equipment made the divers feel clumsy underwater.
armA.mnemonic: اربط الكلمة بعبارة 'كل ما يمسك' (Clum-sy) حاجة يوقعها ويكسرها لأنه شخص أخرق.

armB.definition: Awkward in movement or in handling things.
armB.arabic: يعني حركته تقيلة وبيوقع الحاجات.. مش رشيق
examples: He dropped the cup.
I am very clumsy today.
He made a clumsy attempt to catch the ball.
The waiter was clumsy and spilled the wine.
It was a clumsy apology that made things worse.
The bulky equipment made the divers feel clumsy underwater.
armB.mnemonic: الشخص الـ 'Clumsy' بيعمل 'Clumps' 'كوارث' وهو ماشي وبيكسر الحاجة

armA.definition: A person who trains athletes; or a bus used for longer journeys.
armA.arabic: المدرب اللي بيعلم اللعيبة، أو الأتوبيس الكبير اللي بيسافر مسافات طويلة.
examples: He is our football coach.
We took a coach to London.
The coach called a timeout.
She hired a life coach to help with her career.
We flew coach to save money.
The stagecoach was the primary means of transport in the Old West.
armA.mnemonic: الـ 'Couch' يعني كنبة.. بس الـ 'Coach' مبيخلكش تقعد عليها، بيخليك تتمرن.

armB.definition: A person who trains athletes; or a bus used for longer journeys.
armB.arabic: المدرب اللي بيعلم اللعيبة، أو الأتوبيس الكبير اللي بيسافر مسافات طويلة.
examples: He is our football coach.
We took a coach to London.
The coach gave the team advice before the game.
armB.mnemonic: الـ 'Couch' يعني كنبة.. بس الـ 'Coach' مبيخلكش تقعد عليها، بيخليك تتمرن.

armA.definition: A flat, round piece of metal used as money.
armA.arabic: الفلوس الفكة المعدن، زي الجنيه المعدن.
examples: He put a coin in the machine.
The flip of a coin decided the winner.
She tossed a coin into the fountain.

collocations: two sides of the same coin

armA.mnemonic: شبه كلمة 'Corn'.. زمان كانوا بيشتروا الـ 'Corn' بـ 'Coin' واحدة

armB.definition: A flat, round piece of metal used as money.
armB.arabic: الفلوس الفكة المعدن، زي الجنيه المعدن.
examples: I have a gold coin.
He put a coin in the machine.
She collects rare coins.
The flip of a coin decided the winner.
The term was coined by a famous sociologist.
To coin a phrase, it was a blessing in disguise.
armB.mnemonic: شبه كلمة 'Corn'.. زمان كانوا بيشتروا الـ 'Corn' بـ 'Coin' واحدة

armA.definition: A journalist who writes a regular article for a newspaper or magazine.
armA.arabic: صحفي بيكتب مقال ثابت بشكل دوري في جريدة أو مجلة.
examples: He is a famous columnist.
I read the columnist's article today.
The columnist writes about sports every week.
She works as a political columnist for a major daily newspaper.
The columnist's controversial views sparked a debate.
As a seasoned columnist, his insights influence public opinion significantly.
armA.mnemonic: هو الشخص اللي بيكتب في 'Column' 'عمود' في الجريدة.. فبنسميه 'Columnist'.

armB.definition: A journalist who writes a regular article for a newspaper or magazine.
armB.arabic: صحفي بيكتب مقال ثابت بشكل دوري في جريدة أو مجلة.
examples: She works as a political columnist for a major daily newspaper.
The columnist writes about sports every week.
As a seasoned columnist, his insights influence public opinion significantly.
armB.mnemonic: هو الشخص اللي بيكتب في 'Column' 'عمود' في الجريدة.. فبنسميه 'Columnist'.

armA.definition: To move or travel towards the speaker or a specific place.
armA.arabic: إنك تتحرك وتقرب من المكان اللي المتكلم موجود فيه، أو توصل لمكان معين.
examples: Come here, please.
Can you come to my party?
Dreams can come true.
How did this come about?
Come what may, I will support you.
The agreement came into force yesterday.

armB.definition: To move or travel towards the speaker or a specific place.
armB.arabic: إنك تتحرك وتقرب من المكان اللي المتكلم موجود فيه، أو توصل لمكان معين.
examples: Come here, please.
Can you come to my party?
Please come in and sit down.

armA.definition: A verbal or written remark expressing an opinion or reaction.
armA.arabic: تعليق بتقوله أو بتكتبه عشان تقول رأيك في حاجة.
examples: I read your comment.
She made a nice comment about my dress.
Do you have any comments on the proposal?
He refused to make a comment to the press.
The article is a commentary on modern society.
Her comments were taken out of context.
armA.mnemonic: كلنا عارفين الـ 'Comment' 'التعليق' اللي بيتكتب على 'Facebook' أو 'YouTube'.

armB.definition: A verbal or written remark expressing an opinion or reaction.
armB.arabic: تعليق بتقوله أو بتكتبه عشان تقول رأيك في حاجة.
examples: I read your comment.
She made a nice comment about my dress.
He refused to make a comment to the press.
armB.mnemonic: كلنا عارفين الـ 'Comment' 'التعليق' اللي بيتكتب على 'Facebook' أو 'YouTube'.

armA.definition: A person who comments on events or on a text, especially on television or radio.
armA.arabic: المعلق، زي معلق الكورة اللي بيوصف الماتش، أو المحلل السياسي اللي بيشرح الأخبار.
examples: The commentator talks.
I like this sports commentator.
The commentator described the goal excitedly.
Political commentators analyzed the election results.
He works as a financial commentator for a news channel.
The commentator's biased remarks sparked a controversy.
armA.mnemonic: من 'Comment' 'تعليق'.. فالـ 'Commentator' هو اللي شغلته التعليق.

armB.definition: A person who comments on events or on a text, especially on television or radio.
armB.arabic: المعلق، زي معلق الكورة اللي بيوصف الماتش، أو المحلل السياسي اللي بيشرح الأخبار.
examples: The commentator described the goal excitedly.
He works as a financial commentator for a news channel.
A guest commentator joined the live broadcast to analyze the debate.
armB.mnemonic: من 'Comment' 'تعليق'.. فالـ 'Commentator' هو اللي شغلته التعليق.

armA.definition: A representative of the supreme authority in an area; a person in charge.
armA.arabic: المفوض أو المسؤول الكبير في الحكومة، زي مأمور الشرطة أو مسؤول لجنة.
examples: He is the police commissioner.
The commissioner visited the school.
She was appointed as a commissioner.
The budget was approved by the commissioner.
The High Commissioner issued a statement on human rights.
The commissioner's inquiry revealed systemic corruption.
armA.mnemonic: جاي من 'Commission' 'لجنة أو مهمة'.. فالـ 'Commissioner' هو رئيس اللجنة.

armB.definition: An official in charge of a government department, public agency, or police force, or an appointed member of a commission.
armB.arabic: المفوض أو المسؤول الكبير في الحكومة، زي مأمور الشرطة أو مسؤول لجنة.
examples: The police commissioner announced new safety measures across the city.
She was appointed as a commissioner to oversee the independent inquiry.
The budget was approved by the commissioner before the project began.
armB.mnemonic: جاي من 'Commission' 'لجنة أو مهمة'.. فالـ 'Commissioner' هو رئيس اللجنة.

armA.definition: Occurring, found, or done often; not rare.
armA.arabic: حاجة موجودة كتير وعادية، أو حاجة مشتركة بين كذا حد.
examples: Colds are very common in winter.
It is a common bird in this park.
We have a common goal.
armA.mnemonic: شبه 'Come on'.. يعني يلا بينا دي حاجة 'Common' 'شائعة' وكل الناس بتعملها.

armB.definition: Occurring, found, or done often; not rare.
armB.arabic: حاجة موجودة كتير وعادية، أو حاجة مشتركة بين كذا حد.
examples: It is a common bird in this park.
We have a common goal.
Colds are very common in winter.
It is common knowledge that smoking is bad for you.
The two cultures share a common heritage.
The tragedy of the commons describes how shared resources are depleted.
armB.mnemonic: شبه 'Come on'.. يعني يلا بينا دي حاجة 'Common' 'شائعة' وكل الناس بتعملها.

armA.definition: Relating to or supporting communism.
armA.arabic: صفة تصف أي شيء متعلق بالشيوعية أو مؤيد لنظامها وأفكارها.
examples: The country was governed under strict communist rule for several decades.
The collapse of the communist bloc dramatically reshaped European politics.
He analyzed the development of communist ideology in the twentieth century.
armA.mnemonic: نفس فكرة 'Community'.. نظام 'Communist' يعني نظام مجتمعي شامل.

armB.definition: Relating to communism.
armB.arabic: صفة بتوصف أي حاجة ليها علاقة بالشيوعية.
examples: It is a political idea.
China is a big country.
They lived in a communist country.
The communist party won the election.
The collapse of the communist bloc changed history.
He analyzed the communist ideology deeply.
armB.mnemonic: نفس فكرة 'Community'.. نظام 'Communist' يعني نظام مجتمعي شامل.

armA.definition: A commercial business.
armA.arabic: مؤسسة تجارية أو شركة بيشتغل فيها ناس عشان يكسبوا فلوس.
examples: He works for a big company.
I enjoy her company.
The company produces cars.
We are expecting company for dinner.
He keeps bad company.
The company's assets were liquidated after the scandal.
armA.mnemonic: جاي منها 'Companion' 'رفيق'.. الـ 'Company' هي الناس اللي معاك سواء في الشغل 'شركة' أو في القعدة 'صحبة'.

armB.definition: A commercial business.
armB.arabic: مؤسسة تجارية أو شركة بيشتغل فيها ناس عشان يكسبوا فلوس.
examples: He works for a big company.
The company produces cars.
She wants to start her own software company.
armB.mnemonic: جاي منها 'Companion' 'رفيق'.. الـ 'Company' هي الناس اللي معاك سواء في الشغل 'شركة' أو في القعدة 'صحبة'.

armA.definition: To a moderate degree as compared to something else; relatively.
armA.arabic: نسبياً أو بالمقارنة بغيره. يعني لما تقارن حاجة بحاجة تانية.
examples: The city is comparatively small.
Comparatively few people know the truth.
Inflation has remained comparatively low despite the economic turmoil.
armA.mnemonic: جاية من 'Compare' 'يقارن'.. يعني بتحكم على الحاجة بالمقارنة بغيرها

armB.definition: To a moderate degree as compared to something else; relatively.
armB.arabic: نسبياً أو بالمقارنة بغيره. يعني لما تقارن حاجة بحاجة تانية.
examples: It is quite small.
The test was not too hard compared to the last one.
The city is comparatively small.
Comparatively few people know the truth.
The disease is comparatively rare in this region.
Inflation has remained comparatively low despite the economic turmoil.
armB.mnemonic: جاية من 'Compare' 'يقارن'.. يعني بتحكم على الحاجة بالمقارنة بغيرها

armA.definition: A consideration or estimate of the similarities or dissimilarities between two things.
armA.arabic: إنك تقارن بين حاجتين عشان تشوف إيه الشبه والاختلاف بينهم.
examples: Make a comparison between the two cars.
In comparison to the old one, this is better.
There is no comparison between them.
armA.mnemonic: جاية من 'Compare' يعني يقارن.. فالـ 'Comparison' هي المقارنة.

armB.definition: A consideration or estimate of the similarities or dissimilarities between two things.
armB.arabic: إنك تقارن بين حاجتين عشان تشوف إيه الشبه والاختلاف بينهم.
examples: Not typically used in A1 contexts.
In comparison to the old one, this is better.
Make a comparison between the two cars.
There is no comparison between them.
The comparison highlights the differences.
He drew a comparison between the Roman Empire and modern society.
armB.mnemonic: جاية من 'Compare' يعني يقارن.. فالـ 'Comparison' هي المقارنة.

armA.definition: Involving competition or wanting to win and be better than others.
armA.arabic: تنافسي، يعني بيحب المنافسة وعايز يكسب دايماً، أو بيئة فيها منافسة قوية زي السوق.
examples: Sports are fun.
It is a very hard game.
They offer competitive prices.
She is a very competitive player who hates losing.
The job market is highly competitive right now.
To survive in this industry, we must maintain a competitive edge.
armA.mnemonic: جاية من 'Compete' 'ينافس'.. في الـ 'Competition' 'المسابقة' لازم تكون 'Competitive' عشان تكسب.

armB.definition: Involving competition or wanting to win and be better than others.
armB.arabic: تنافسي، يعني بيحب المنافسة وعايز يكسب دايماً، أو بيئة فيها منافسة قوية زي السوق.
examples: She is a very competitive player who hates losing.
They offer competitive prices to attract new customers.
The job market is highly competitive right now.
armB.mnemonic: جاية من 'Compete' 'ينافس'.. في الـ 'Competition' 'المسابقة' لازم تكون 'Competitive' عشان تكسب.

armA.definition: A thing that completes or brings to perfection, or the full number or amount required.
armA.arabic: حاجة بتكمّل حاجة تانية وتخليها متناسقة أو تامة، أو العدد والنصاب الكامل المطلوب لشيء معين.
examples: The wine was a perfect complement to the cheese.
The scarf is a nice complement to the dress.
The team needs a full complement of players.
armA.mnemonic: كلمة 'Complete' 'يكمل'.. الـ 'Complement' هو اللي بيعمل 'Complete' للصورة.

armB.definition: A thing that completes or brings to perfection.
armB.arabic: حاجة بتكمل حاجة تانية وتخليها أحلى أو تامة، زي الطقم لما يكمل بعضه.
examples: It goes well with it.
The scarf is a nice complement to the dress.
Rice is a good complement to curry.
The team needs a full complement of players.
The wine was a perfect complement to the cheese.
In grammar, a subject complement follows a linking verb.
armB.mnemonic: كلمة 'Complete' 'يكمل'.. الـ 'Complement' هو اللي بيعمل 'Complete' للصورة.

armA.definition: To add to something in a way that enhances or improves it.
armA.arabic: إنك تضيف لحاجة عشان تحسنها أو تكملها، زي لما تحط صوص على الأكل يكمل طعمه.
examples: They match well.
The colors complement each other.
This sauce complements the meat.
Her skills complement his experience perfectly.
We need a strategy that complements our existing policies.
The architectural style complements the surrounding landscape.
armA.mnemonic: نفس فكرة 'Complete'.. الفعل 'Complement' يعني 'بيعمل Complete'.

armB.definition: To add to something in a way that enhances or improves it.
armB.arabic: إنك تضيف لحاجة عشان تحسنها أو تكملها، زي لما تحط صوص على الأكل يكمل طعمه.
examples: The colors complement each other.
Her skills complement his experience perfectly.
A good wine will complement the meal.
armB.mnemonic: نفس فكرة 'Complete'.. الفعل 'Complement' يعني 'بيعمل Complete'.

armA.definition: The state of having many parts and being difficult to understand or deal with.
armA.arabic: إن الحاجة تكون معقدة وفيها تفاصيل كتير ومش سهلة.
examples: The complexity of the law makes it hard to follow.
We need to reduce the complexity of the process.
The novel is admired for the psychological complexity of its characters.
armA.mnemonic: جاية من 'Complex' 'مجمع/معقد'.. الـ 'Complexity' هي درجة التعقيد دي.

armB.definition: The state of having many parts and being difficult to understand or deal with.
armB.arabic: إن الحاجة تكون معقدة وفيها تفاصيل كتير ومش سهلة.
examples: It is a big problem.
The game has some difficulty.
I was surprised by the complexity of the map.
The complexity of the law makes it hard to follow.
We need to reduce the complexity of the process.
The novel is admired for the psychological complexity of its characters.
armB.mnemonic: جاية من 'Complex' 'مجمع/معقد'.. الـ 'Complexity' هي درجة التعقيد دي.

armA.definition: A person who writes music, especially as a professional occupation.
armA.arabic: الشخص اللي بيألف الموسيقى ويكتب الألحان، زي بيتهوفن أو عمر خيرت.
examples: Mozart is a famous composer.
The composer wrote a new song for the film.
He is regarded as the greatest composer of his generation.
armA.mnemonic: هو اللي بيعمل 'Compose' 'تأليف' للموسيقى على الـ 'Computer' أو البيانو.

armB.definition: A person who writes music, especially as a professional occupation.
armB.arabic: الشخص اللي بيألف الموسيقى ويكتب الألحان، زي بيتهوفن أو عمر خيرت.
examples: Mozart is a famous composer.
She wants to be a music composer.
The composer wrote a new song for the film.
Contemporary composers often use computers.
He is regarded as the greatest composer of his generation.
The composer's avant-garde style challenged traditional harmony.
armB.mnemonic: هو اللي بيعمل 'Compose' 'تأليف' للموسيقى على الـ 'Computer' أو البيانو.

armA.definition: To express complete disapproval of; to sentence someone to a punishment.
armA.arabic: إنك تعلن رفضك الشديد لتصرف معين وتستنكره، أو القاضي يحكم على حد بعقوبة 'زي الإعدام'.
examples: Human rights groups openly condemn the government's harsh policies.
Do not condemn someone before you hear their side of the story.
The judge had no choice but to condemn the murderer to life in prison.
armA.mnemonic: الكلمة فيها 'Damn' 'لعنة'.. كأنك بتلعن الفعل السيء ده وبتستنكره بشدة.

armB.definition: To express complete disapproval of; to sentence someone to a punishment.
armB.arabic: إنك تعلن رفضك الشديد لتصرف معين وتستنكره، أو القاضي يحكم على حد بعقوبة 'زي الإعدام'.
examples: Bad actions are wrong.
The judge punished him.
We condemn violence.
The building was condemned as unsafe.
He was condemned to death for his crimes.
The film was condemned by religious groups for its controversial content.
armB.mnemonic: الكلمة فيها 'Damn' 'لعنة'.. كأنك بتلعن الفعل السيء ده وبتستنكره بشدة.

armA.definition: The borders or boundaries of a place (usually plural 'confines').
armA.arabic: حدود أو نطاق مكان معين (غالباً بتيجي جمع Confines).
examples: The prisoner paced within the narrow confine of his cell.
He struggled against the rigid confine of social expectations.
The author felt restricted by the strict confine of the genre.
armA.mnemonic: جاية من 'Fine' 'نهاية' 'زي في الإيطالي'.. الـ 'Confines' هي النهايات أو الحدود بتاعة المكان.

armB.definition: The borders or boundaries of a place (usually plural 'confines').
armB.arabic: حدود أو نطاق مكان معين 'غالباً بتيجي جمع Confines'.
examples: Stay within the room.
The dog stayed within the confines of the yard.
He felt safe within the confines of his home.
The discussion went beyond the confines of the agenda.
She broke free from the narrow confines of her village life.
Within the confines of this theory, the results make sense.
armB.mnemonic: جاية من 'Fine' 'نهاية' 'زي في الإيطالي'.. الـ 'Confines' هي النهايات أو الحدود بتاعة المكان.

armA.definition: A formal meeting or a legislative body, especially in the US.
armA.arabic: اجتماع رسمي كبير أو المجلس التشريعي 'زي البرلمان' خصوصاً في أمريكا.
examples: The party held its annual congress to elect a leader.
A medical congress was held in Paris to discuss recent advances.
Both houses of congress must approve the proposed budget.
armA.mnemonic: كينغ كونغ 'Kong' عمل اجتماع كبير في الـ 'Congress'.

armB.definition: A formal meeting or a legislative body, especially in the US.
armB.arabic: اجتماع رسمي كبير أو المجلس التشريعي 'زي البرلمان' خصوصاً في أمريكا.
examples: The Congress makes laws.
She visited the Congress building.
A medical congress was held in Paris.
Members of Congress voted on the new tax bill.
The party held its annual congress to elect a leader.
Congressional oversight is vital for a balanced democracy.
armB.mnemonic: كينغ كونغ 'Kong' عمل اجتماع كبير في الـ 'Congress'.

armA.definition: Overcome and take control of a place or people by use of military force.
armA.arabic: تسيطر على بلد بالحرب، أو تتغلب على خوف أو مشكلة صعبة.
examples: He wants to win.
The army conquered the city.
She worked hard to conquer her fear of spiders.
Scientists are trying to conquer the disease.
The Romans set out to conquer the known world.
He had to conquer his own demons before he could lead others.
armA.mnemonic: شبه 'King'.. الـ 'King' هو اللي بيعمل 'Conquer' للممالك.

armB.definition: To take control of a place or people by military force, or to successfully overcome a problem or fear.
armB.arabic: تسيطر على بلد بالحرب، أو تتغلب على خوف أو مشكلة صعبة.
examples: The Romans set out to conquer the known world.
She worked hard to conquer her fear of spiders.
Scientists are trying to conquer the disease.
armB.mnemonic: شبه 'King'.. الـ 'King' هو اللي بيعمل 'Conquer' للممالك.

armA.definition: The subjugation and assumption of control of a place or people by use of military force.
armA.arabic: الغزو أو الفتح، لما جيش يسيطر على بلد تانية بالقوة، أو الانتصار في حاجة صعبة.
examples: The Spanish conquest of the Americas changed the world.
The conquest of inflation is the government's main goal.
His memoirs detail the military conquest of the entire region.
armA.mnemonic: جاية من 'Quest' 'بحث/مهمة'.. الـ 'Conquest' هي المهمة الكبيرة للسيطرة على الأرض.

armB.definition: The subjugation and assumption of control of a place or people by use of military force.
armB.arabic: الغزو أو الفتح، لما جيش يسيطر على بلد تانية بالقوة، أو الانتصار في حاجة صعبة.
examples: They celebrated the conquest.
The conquest of the city took two months.
Stories of conquest and war are common in history.
The Spanish conquest of the Americas changed the world.
The conquest of inflation is the government's main goal.
His memoirs detail the military conquest of the entire region.
armB.mnemonic: جاية من 'Quest' 'بحث/مهمة'.. الـ 'Conquest' هي المهمة الكبيرة للسيطرة على الأرض.

armA.definition: Following as a result or effect of something.
armA.arabic: اللي بيحصل كنتيجة لحاجة قبله، يعني التابع أو الناتج.
examples: The heavy rains and consequent flooding devastated the region.
The rise in prices and consequent fall in demand was expected.
He made a mistake and suffered the consequent loss of money.
armA.mnemonic: شبه كلمة 'sequence' (تسلسل)؛ الـ 'consequent' هو الشيء اللي بيجي تالي في التسلسل كنتيجة لما قبله.

armB.definition: Following as a result or effect of something.
armB.arabic: اللي بيحصل كنتيجة لحاجة قبله، يعني التابع أو الناتج.
examples: Not used in A1.
The consequent rain made us wet. (Simple context)
The consequent delay was annoying.
He made a mistake and suffered the consequent loss of money.
The rise in prices and consequent fall in demand was expected.
The heavy rains and consequent flooding devastated the region.
armB.mnemonic: شبه 'Sequence' 'تسلسل'.. الـ 'Consequent' هو اللي بيجي تالي في التسلسل كنيجة.

armA.definition: An association, typically of several business companies.
armA.arabic: مجموعة شركات أو بنوك متحدة مع بعض عشان ينفذوا مشروع كبير صعب شركة واحدة تعمله لوحدها.
examples: The project is funded by a consortium.
A consortium of investors bought the club.
The consortium won the bid to build the airport.
armA.mnemonic: شبه 'Concert' حفلة.. بس دي حفلة 'Consortium' لرجال الأعمال والشركات الكبيرة.

armB.definition: An association, typically of several business companies.
armB.arabic: مجموعة شركات أو بنوك متحدة مع بعض عشان ينفذوا مشروع كبير صعب شركة واحدة تعمله لوحدها.
examples: Companies work together.
A group of banks formed a team.
The project is funded by a consortium.
A consortium of investors bought the club.
The consortium won the bid to build the airport.
International consortia are often required for large-scale infrastructure projects.
armB.mnemonic: شبه 'Concert' حفلة.. بس دي حفلة 'Consortium' لرجال الأعمال والشركات الكبيرة.

armA.definition: Standing out so as to be clearly visible; attracting notice.
armA.arabic: واضح جداً وملفت للنظر، أي حد ياخد باله منه بسهولة لأنه مختلف أو ظاهر.
examples: Not used in A1.
The red hat was very conspicuous.
He tried not to look conspicuous.
Her bright clothes made her conspicuous in the crowd.
He was conspicuous by his absence at the wedding.
The bird's plumage makes it conspicuous to predators.
armA.mnemonic: 'Con' + 'Pic'.. كأنها صورة 'Pic' واضحة جداً.. 'Conspicuous'.

armB.definition: Standing out so as to be clearly visible; attracting notice.
armB.arabic: واضح جداً وملفت للنظر، أي حد ياخد باله منه بسهولة لأنه مختلف أو ظاهر.
examples: Her bright clothes made her conspicuous in the crowd.
He was conspicuous by his absence at the wedding.
The bird's plumage makes it conspicuous to predators.
armB.mnemonic: 'Con' + 'Pic'.. كأنها صورة 'Pic' واضحة جداً.. 'Conspicuous'.

armA.definition: A secret plan by a group to do something unlawful or harmful.
armA.arabic: خطة سرية بيعملها مجموعة ناس عشان يضروا حد أو يعملوا حاجة مش قانونية، يعني مؤامرة.
examples: The bad men had a secret plan.
They talked about a conspiracy to steal the money.
He believes in a conspiracy against the government.
The police uncovered a conspiracy to rob the bank.
Conspiracy theories often spread quickly on the internet.
She was charged with conspiracy to commit fraud.
armA.mnemonic: فيها شبه من كلمة 'Piracy' 'قرصنة'.. القرصنة محتاج خطة سرية و 'Conspiracy' يعني مؤامرة.

armB.definition: A secret plan by a group to do something unlawful or harmful.
armB.arabic: خطة سرية بيعملها مجموعة ناس عشان يضروا حد أو يعملوا حاجة مش قانونية، يعني مؤامرة.
examples: The police uncovered a conspiracy to rob the bank.
He believes in a conspiracy against the government.
She was charged with conspiracy to commit fraud.
armB.mnemonic: فيها شبه من كلمة 'Piracy' 'قرصنة'.. القرصنة محتاج خطة سرية و 'Conspiracy' يعني مؤامرة.

armA.definition: A set of basic laws and principles that a country or organization is governed by.
armA.arabic: الدستور، يعني مجموعة القوانين الأساسية اللي بتمشي عليها الدولة أو المنظمة.
examples: Every country has laws.
The club has a written rule book.
They voted to change the constitution.
Freedom of speech is guaranteed by the constitution.
The new law was declared unconstitutional.
He has a robust physical constitution.
armA.mnemonic: جزء منها كلمة 'Institute' 'مؤسسة'.. الـ 'Constitution' هو اللي بيأسس القوانين للمؤسسات.

armB.definition: A set of basic laws and principles that a country or organization is governed by.
armB.arabic: الدستور، يعني مجموعة القوانين الأساسية اللي بتمشي عليها الدولة أو المنظمة.
examples: Freedom of speech is guaranteed by the constitution.
They voted to change the constitution.
He has a robust physical constitution.
armB.mnemonic: جزء منها كلمة 'Institute' 'مؤسسة'.. الـ 'Constitution' هو اللي بيأسس القوانين للمؤسسات.

armA.definition: To interpret a word or action in a particular way.
armA.arabic: تفهم أو تفسر كلام أو تصرف بطريقة معينة.
examples: How should I construe your remark about my performance?
It is easy to construe his silence as an admission of guilt.
The judge had to construe the ambiguous clause in the contract.
armA.mnemonic: تشبه 'Construct' 'يبني'.. إنت بتبني 'Construe' فهمك للموضوع.

armB.definition: To interpret a word or action in a particular way.
armB.arabic: تفهم أو تفسر كلام أو تصرف بطريقة معينة.
examples: Don't construe it wrong.
She construed his silence as agreement.
His words were construed as a threat.
How should I construe your remark?
Any ambiguity in the contract will be construed against the drafter.
Her politeness was misconstrued as flirtation by her colleague.
armB.mnemonic: تشبه 'Construct' 'يبني'.. إنت بتبني 'Construe' فهمك للموضوع.

armA.definition: Occurring only if specific circumstances exist; dependent on.
armA.arabic: يعني حاجة مش أكيدة.. معتمدة على شرط تاني عشان تحصل
examples: Our success is contingent on your support.
The sale of the house is contingent on getting a loan.
The job offer is contingent upon passing a background check.
armA.mnemonic: اربطها بـ 'Contact'.. الحاجة دي 'Contingent' يعني لازم يحصل 'Contact' مع شرط معين عشان تحصل

armB.definition: Occurring only if specific circumstances exist; dependent on.
armB.arabic: يعني حاجة مش أكيدة.. معتمدة على شرط تاني عشان تحصل
examples: It depends on the weather.
The plan is not certain.
Our success is contingent on your support.
The sale of the house is contingent on getting a loan.
The job offer is contingent upon passing a background check.
We must prepare for all contingent liabilities in the contract.
armB.mnemonic: اربطها بـ 'Contact'.. الحاجة دي 'Contingent' يعني لازم يحصل 'Contact' مع شرط معين عشان تحصل

armA.definition: Relating to or contained within a formal legal agreement.
armA.arabic: حاجة ليها علاقة بالعقد المكتوب، يعني ملزمة قانونياً بناءً على الاتفاق اللي وقعتوا عليه.
examples: We have a paper agreement.
It is part of the contract.
I have a contractual duty to finish this.
The company fulfilled its contractual obligations.
There was a contractual dispute between the two parties.
The contractual stipulations were ambiguous regarding liability.
armA.mnemonic: جاية من 'Contract' 'عقد'.. أي حاجة 'Contractual' يعني ماشية تبع الـ 'Contract'.

armB.definition: Relating to or contained within a formal legal agreement.
armB.arabic: حاجة ليها علاقة بالعقد المكتوب، يعني ملزمة قانونياً بناءً على الاتفاق اللي وقعتوا عليه.
examples: I have a contractual duty to finish this.
The company fulfilled its contractual obligations.
There was a contractual dispute between the two parties.
armB.mnemonic: جاية من 'Contract' 'عقد'.. أي حاجة 'Contractual' يعني ماشية تبع الـ 'Contract'.

armA.definition: Deny the truth of a statement by asserting the opposite.
armA.arabic: تقول عكس الكلام اللي اتقال، أو تكذب حد وتقول إنه غلطان.
examples: He says no, she says yes.
Don't contradict your teacher.
The evidence seems to contradict his story.
She dared not contradict her boss in the meeting.
The survey results contradict the earlier findings.
It is difficult to contradict the logic of his philosophical argument.
armA.mnemonic: 'Contra' يعني ضد + 'Dict' يعني قول.. يبقى 'Contradict' يعني تقول ضد الكلام.

armB.definition: To say the opposite of what someone has said, or to conflict with a fact or statement.
armB.arabic: أن تقول عكس ما قيل وتعارضه، أو أن يتعارض أمر أو دليل مع حقيقة أخرى بحيث لا يجتمعان.
examples: Don't contradict your teacher.
The evidence seems to contradict his story.
She dared not contradict her boss in the meeting.
armB.mnemonic: 'Contra' يعني ضد + 'Dict' يعني قول.. يبقى 'Contradict' يعني تقول ضد الكلام.

armA.definition: The state of being able to proceed with something with little effort or difficulty.
armA.arabic: الراحة أو الملاءمة. إن الحاجة تكون سهلة ومناسبة ليك ومابتتعبكش.
examples: I like the convenience of this car.
Please call me at your convenience.
We bought it for the sake of convenience.
The house has every modern convenience.
The marriage was one of convenience, not love.
They apologized for the inconvenience caused by the delay.
armA.mnemonic: من 'Convene' 'يجتمع' بس المعنى اتطور لـ 'مناسب'. افتكر 'Convenience Store' المحل اللي جنبك وبيريحك.

armB.definition: The state of being able to proceed with something with little effort or difficulty.
armB.arabic: الراحة أو الملاءمة؛ أن يكون الشيء سهلاً ومناسباً لك دون مشقة أو عناء.
examples: Please call me at your convenience.
We bought it for the sake of convenience.
The house has every modern convenience.
armB.mnemonic: من 'Convene' 'يجتمع' بس المعنى اتطور لـ 'مناسب'. افتكر 'Convenience Store' المحل اللي جنبك وبيريحك.

armA.definition: To come from different directions and meet at one point.
armA.arabic: يعني يتجمعوا أو يتقابلوا في نقطة واحدة.. زي ما الطرق بتتلاقى في ميدان
examples: The roads meet here.
The two paths converge at the river.
Fans converged on the stadium for the game.
Our opinions finally converged after hours of discussion.
Economic policies across Europe are beginning to converge.
The lines of perspective converge at the vanishing point.
armA.mnemonic: عكس 'Diverge'.. افتكر 'Conversation' الناس بتتجمع 'Converge' عشان تتكلم

armB.definition: To come from different directions and meet at one point, or to gradually become similar.
armB.arabic: يعني يتجمعوا أو يتقابلوا في نقطة واحدة.. زي ما الطرق بتتلاقى في ميدان، أو تتقارب الأفكار والسياسات
examples: The two paths converge at the river.
Economic policies across Europe are beginning to converge.
The lines of perspective converge at the vanishing point.
armB.mnemonic: عكس 'Diverge'.. افتكر 'Conversation' الناس بتتجمع 'Converge' عشان تتكلم

armA.definition: Opposite or contrary in direction, action, or sequence.
armA.arabic: حاجة عكس حاجة تانية تمامًا، أو المقابل ليها.
examples: They have opposite views.
The converse is also true.
He holds the converse opinion to mine.
High speed increases risk; the converse effect is safety at low speeds.
However, the converse argument is equally valid.
In logic, if a proposition is true, its converse is not necessarily true.
armA.mnemonic: كلمة 'Verse' يعني بيت شعر.. 'Converse' يعني البيت المقلوب أو العكس.

armB.definition: Opposite or contrary in direction, action, or sequence.
armB.arabic: حاجة عكس حاجة تانية تمامًا، أو المقابل ليها في الاتجاه أو النتيجة.
examples: He holds the converse opinion to mine.
However, the converse argument is equally valid.
High speed increases risk; the converse effect is safety at low speeds.
armB.mnemonic: لاحظ التشابه بين converse وبين reverse (عكسي) وinverse (معكوس)؛ الثلاث كلمات تشترك في جذر يدل على الدوران والعكس.

armA.definition: In an opposite way; used to introduce a statement that reverses the previous one.
armA.arabic: كلمة بنستخدمها عشان نقول العكس. يعني لو قلت حاجة وعايز تقول عكسها تماماً.
examples: Not applicable for A1 (Advanced connector).
Some people like hot weather; conversely, others prefer cold.
You can go by bus, or conversely, you can walk.
Poor health is accepted as a cause of poverty; conversely, poverty causes poor health.
American consumers prefer white eggs; conversely, British buyers like brown eggs.
If the tax is reduced, spending may rise; conversely, if interest rates go up, spending may fall.
armA.mnemonic: جاية من 'Converse' يعني عكس. لما تقول حاجة و 'Conversely' تقول عكسها.

armB.definition: In an opposite way; used to introduce a statement that reverses or contrasts with the previous one.
armB.arabic: كلمة بنستخدمها عشان نقول العكس أو بالمقابل، يعني لما تذكر فكرة وتطرح الفكرة المعاكسة ليها تماماً.
examples: Poor health is accepted as a cause of poverty; conversely, poverty causes poor health.
American consumers prefer white eggs; conversely, British buyers like brown eggs.
Some people like hot weather; conversely, others prefer cold.
armB.translations: بالعكس بالمقابل على العكس من ذلك
armB.mnemonic: جاية من 'Converse' يعني عكس. لما تقول حاجة و 'Conversely' تقول عكسها.

armA.definition: A person who has changed their religious faith or other beliefs.
armA.arabic: شخص غيّر دينه أو معتقده أو حتى رأيه السياسي وبقى مؤمن بحاجة جديدة.
examples: He is a new member of the group.
She joined the club as a new member.
The group welcomes new converts warmly.
He is a recent convert to vegetarianism.
Recent converts are often the most zealous believers.
The book details the experiences of a convert to Buddhism.
armA.mnemonic: لما تعمل 'Convert' 'تحويل' للملف.. الاسم منها 'Convert' هو الشخص اللي عمل 'تحويل' لدينه.

armB.definition: A person who has changed their religious faith or other beliefs.
armB.arabic: شخص غيّر دينه أو معتقده أو حتى رأيه السياسي وبقى مؤمن بحاجة جديدة.
examples: He is a recent convert to vegetarianism.
The book details the experiences of a convert to Buddhism.
As a new convert, he was eager to learn about the traditions of the community.
armB.mnemonic: لما تعمل 'Convert' 'تحويل' للملف.. الاسم منها 'Convert' هو الشخص اللي عمل 'تحويل' لدينه.

armA.definition: To change the form, character, or function of something.
armA.arabic: يغيّر حاجة من شكل لشكل، زي تحويل العملة، أو تحويل ملف PDF لـ Word، أو تغيير الدين.
examples: Can we change this sofa into a bed?
I need to change my dollars to euros.
You can convert the file to PDF.
They converted the old warehouse into luxury apartments.
The solar cells convert sunlight directly into electricity.
