The responsibility falls on you.
The city fell to the invading army after a long siege.
armA.mnemonic: كلمة 'Fall' شبه 'Fail' 'يفشل'.. لو فشلت ممكن تـ 'Fall' 'تقع'.

armB.definition: To move downwards quickly and without control.
armB.arabic: يقع أو ينزل بسرعة من فوق لتحت من غير ما يتحكم في نفسه.
examples: Be careful not to fall.
Leaves fall from the trees in autumn.
You will fall if you run on the wet floor.
armB.mnemonic: كلمة 'Fall' شبه 'Fail' 'يفشل'.. لو فشلت ممكن تـ 'Fall' 'تقع'.

armA.definition: A person who has a strong interest in or admiration for a particular person or thing; or a cooling device.
armA.arabic: تأتي بمعنيين شائعين: مروحة التبريد والتهوية، أو الشخص المعجب والمشجع لشخص أو فريق أو شيء ما.
examples: Turn on the fan, it's hot.
I am a football fan.
She is a big fan of that singer.
armA.mnemonic: تذكر أن كلمة Fan تشبه كلمة (فَنّ)؛ فالمشجع (fan) يعشق فَنّ فريقه المفضل، أو تخيل مشجعاً يحمل مروحة (fan) في المدرجات الحارة.

armB.definition: A person who has a strong interest in or admiration for a particular person or thing; or a cooling device.
armB.arabic: ليها معنيين: الشخص المعجب والمشجع لفنان أو فريق، أو المروحة اللي بتجيب هوا.
examples: I am a football fan.
Turn on the fan, it's hot.
She is a big fan of that singer.
The fans cheered loudly for their team.
The celebrity stopped to sign autographs for his fans.
The troops fanned out across the field.
armB.mnemonic: الـ 'Fan' هو 'المشجع' اللي بيحب فنان.. وكمان الـ 'Fan' هي 'المروحة' اللي بتجيب هوا.

armA.definition: Having a large amount of excess flesh; overweight.
armA.arabic: صفة للشخص أو الحيوان اللي وزنه زايد، أو الحاجة اللي فيها دهون كتير.
examples: The cat is very fat.
He thinks he is too fat.
You will get fat if you eat too many sweets.
armA.mnemonic: اربطها بكلمة 'Fast' (سريع).. الشخص الـ 'Fat' غالباً مش بيبقى 'Fast'.

armB.definition: Having a large amount of excess flesh; overweight.
armB.arabic: صفة للشخص أو الحيوان اللي وزنه زايد، أو الحاجة اللي فيها دهون كتير.
examples: The cat is very fat.
He thinks he is too fat.
You should avoid eating fatty foods.
The doctor advised him to reduce his fat intake.
It's a big fat lie.
The company grew fat on government contracts.
armB.mnemonic: اربطها بكلمة 'Fast' 'سريع'.. الشخص الـ 'Fat' غالباً مش بيبقى 'Fast'.

armA.definition: To experience an emotion or physical sensation.
armA.arabic: يحس أو يشعر.. سواء وجع في جسمك أو مشاعر في قلبك.
examples: I feel happy.
Do you feel sick?
I feel like eating pizza.
She felt the fabric to see if it was silk.
I feel strongly that we should go.
He felt his way through the dark room.
armA.mnemonic: زي ما قلنا.. الـ 'Feel' 'فيل' بيحس 'Feel' بخرطومه.

armB.definition: To experience an emotion or physical sensation.
armB.arabic: يحس أو يشعر.. سواء وجع في جسمك أو مشاعر في قلبك.
examples: I feel happy.
Do you feel sick?
I feel like eating pizza.
armB.mnemonic: الـ 'فيل' بيحس (feel) بخرطومه.

armA.definition: Producing or capable of producing abundant vegetation, crops, or offspring; highly productive or inventive.
armA.arabic: خصب؛ يصف الأرض كثيرة الإنتاج للزرع، أو الكائن الحي القادر على الإنجاب والتكاثر، أو العقل/الخيال الغني بالأفكار الجديدة.
examples: The Nile Valley is very fertile.
They went to a doctor to check if they were fertile.
He has a fertile imagination for writing stories.
armA.mnemonic: اربطها بـ 'Fruit'.. الأرض الـ 'Fertile' بتطلع 'Fruit' كتير.

armB.definition: Producing or capable of producing abundant vegetation or crops.
armB.arabic: الأرض اللي بتطلع زرع كتير، أو الشخص القادر على الإنجاب.
examples: The land is good for plants.
Farmers like fertile soil.
The Nile Valley is very fertile.
They went to a doctor to check if they were fertile.
He has a fertile imagination for writing stories.
The 1920s provided a fertile ground for new artistic movements.
armB.mnemonic: اربطها بـ 'Fruit'.. الأرض الـ 'Fertile' بتطلع 'Fruit' كتير.

armA.definition: Intense and passionate feeling.
armA.arabic: حماس قوي جدًا ومشاعر ملتهبة تجاه حاجة بتؤمن بيها أو بتحبها.
examples: The speech was delivered with patriotic fervour.
His religious fervour surprised everyone in the room.
The revolutionary fervour swept across the entire nation.
armA.mnemonic: قريبة من 'Fever' (حُمّى).. الـ 'Fervour' هو حماس سخن زي الحُمّى.

armB.definition: Intense and passionate feeling.
armB.arabic: حماس قوي جدًا ومشاعر ملتهبة تجاه حاجة بتؤمن بيها أو بتحبها.
examples: He speaks with love.
The fans cheered with joy.
She worked with great energy and spirit.
The speech was delivered with patriotic fervour.
His religious fervour surprised everyone in the room.
The revolutionary fervour swept across the entire nation.
armB.mnemonic: قريبة من 'Fever' 'حُمّى'.. الـ 'Fervour' هو حماس سخن زي الحُمّى.

armA.definition: To take part in a violent struggle or struggle to overcome something.
armA.arabic: إنك تدخل في خناقة أو تحارب عشان تكسب حاجة أو تتغلب على مشكلة.
examples: Cats and dogs often fight.
We must fight for our rights.
Doctors fight to save lives every day.
She had to fight back tears when she heard the news.
They fought tooth and nail to keep the company afloat.
The rebels continue to fight against the regime.
armA.mnemonic: اربطها بكلمة 'Fist' 'قبضة'.. عشان الـ 'Fight' بيكون بالـ 'Fist'.

armB.definition: To take part in a violent struggle or make a strong effort to overcome something.
armB.arabic: إنك تدخل في خناقة أو شجار، أو تحارب وتكافح عشان تكسب حاجة أو تتغلب على مشكلة.
examples: Cats and dogs often fight.
We must fight for our rights.
Doctors fight to save lives every day.
armB.mnemonic: اربطها بكلمة 'Fist' 'قبضة'.. عشان الـ 'Fight' بيكون بالـ 'Fist'.

armA.definition: A slender threadlike object or fiber, especially in a lightbulb.
armA.arabic: خيط رفيع جداً، زي السلك اللي جوه اللمبة القديمة اللي بينور لما الكهربا تمشي فيه.
examples: The lightbulb filament is broken.
Old bulbs use a tungsten filament.
The 3D printer needs a new spool of plastic filament.
armA.mnemonic: أولها 'Fill' 'يملأ'.. الـ 'Filament' هو الخيط الرفيع اللي بيملأ اللمبة نور.

armB.definition: A slender threadlike object or fiber, especially in a lightbulb.
armB.arabic: خيط رفيع جداً، زي السلك اللي جوه اللمبة القديمة اللي بينور لما الكهربا تمشي فيه.
examples: The bulb has a wire.
The lightbulb filament is broken.
Old bulbs use a tungsten filament.
The 3D printer needs a new spool of plastic filament.
Muscles are made of thick and thin filaments.
The nebula contains vast filaments of glowing gas.
armB.mnemonic: أولها 'Fill' 'يملأ'.. الـ 'Filament' هو الخيط الرفيع اللي بيملأ اللمبة نور.

armA.definition: To discover or perceive by chance or search.
armA.arabic: يلاقي أو يجد. لما تدور على حاجة وتوصلها، أو تكتشف حاجة بالصدفة.
examples: I can't find my keys.
Did you find the book you wanted?
I find it hard to believe his story.
You will find that this software is very useful.
She found herself in a difficult situation.
The court found the defendant guilty of all charges.
armA.mnemonic: كلمة 'Find' شبه 'Fine'.. لما تلاقي حاجة 'Fine' 'كويسة' بتبقى 'Lucky Find'.

armB.definition: To discover or perceive by chance or search.
armB.arabic: يلاقي أو يجد. لما تدور على حاجة وتوصلها، أو تكتشف حاجة بالصدفة.
examples: I can't find my keys.
Did you find the book you wanted?
You will find that this software is very useful.
armB.mnemonic: كلمة 'Find' شبه 'Fine'.. لما تلاقي حاجة 'Fine' 'كويسة' بتبقى 'Lucky Find'.

armA.definition: A person who catches fish for a living or for sport.
armA.arabic: الشخص اللي بيصطاد سمك، سواء كشغلانة أو هواية.
examples: The fisherman caught a big fish.
The fisherman went out to sea early in the morning.
The old fisherman mended his nets.
armA.mnemonic: 'Fish' 'سمك' + 'Man' 'رجل'.. رجل السمك 'الصياد'.

armB.definition: A person who catches fish for a living or for sport.
armB.arabic: الشخص اللي بيصطاد سمك، سواء كشغلانة أو هواية.
examples: The fisherman has a boat.
The fisherman caught a big fish.
Fishermen go out to sea early in the morning.
The old fisherman mended his nets.
Local fishermen are protesting against pollution.
The livelihood of the coastal fishermen depends on sustainable practices.
armB.mnemonic: 'Fish' 'سمك' + 'Man' 'رجل'.. رجل السمك 'الصياد'.

armA.definition: The condition of being physically strong and healthy.
armA.arabic: حالة اللياقة البدنية، إن جسمك يكون صحي وقوي وتقدر تعمل مجهود.
examples: He goes to the fitness center.
Walking is good for your fitness.
She has a high level of physical fitness.
The doctor questioned his fitness to drive after the accident.
Survival of the fittest is a key concept in evolution.
The rigorous training ensures the soldiers' combat fitness.
armA.mnemonic: كلمة 'Fit' يعني مناسب.. الـ 'Fitness' إن جسمك يكون مناسب وصحي.

armB.definition: The condition of being physically strong and healthy.
armB.arabic: حالة اللياقة البدنية، إن جسمك يكون صحي وقوي وتقدر تعمل مجهود.
examples: Walking is good for your fitness.
She has a high level of physical fitness.
The doctor questioned his fitness to drive after the accident.
armB.mnemonic: كلمة 'Fit' يعني مناسب.. الـ 'Fitness' إن جسمك يكون مناسب وصحي.

armA.definition: To run away quickly from a dangerous or unpleasant situation.
armA.arabic: يعني يهرب بسرعة من خطر أو مكان مش آمن، زي الهروب من حريق أو حرب.
examples: Many people had to flee the country.
The robbers tried to flee the scene.
Refugees were forced to flee their homes.
armA.mnemonic: كلمة 'Flee' شبه كلمة 'Fly' 'يطير'.. لما تهرب من الخطر كأنك بتطير من السرعة.

armB.definition: To run away quickly from a dangerous or unpleasant situation.
armB.arabic: يعني يهرب بسرعة من خطر أو مكان مش آمن، زي الهروب من حريق أو حرب.
examples: They flee from the fire.
The cat fled when the dog barked.
Many people had to flee the country.
The robbers tried to flee the scene.
Refugees were forced to flee their homes.
All rational thought seemed to flee his mind.
armB.mnemonic: كلمة 'Flee' شبه كلمة 'Fly' 'يطير'.. لما تهرب من الخطر كأنك بتطير من السرعة.

armA.definition: The lower surface of a room, on which one may walk.
armA.arabic: الأرضية اللي بنمشي عليها في الأوضة، أو الطابق في العمارة.
examples: The bag is on the floor.
I live on the second floor.
Don't sit on the cold floor.
armA.mnemonic: كلمة 'Floor' قريبة من 'Flower'.. ممكن تفرش 'Flowers' على الـ 'Floor'.

armB.definition: The lower surface of a room, on which one may walk.
armB.arabic: الأرضية اللي بنمشي عليها في الأوضة، أو الطابق في العمارة.
examples: The bag is on the floor.
I live on the second floor.
Don't sit on the cold floor.
The dance floor was crowded.
The senator took the floor to speak.
She was floored by the surprising news.
armB.mnemonic: كلمة 'Floor' قريبة من 'Flower'.. ممكن تفرش 'Flowers' على الـ 'Floor'.

armA.definition: A bold or extravagant gesture made to attract attention, or an ornamental detail in writing, speech, or performance.
armA.arabic: حركة استعراضية ملفتة للنظر، أو لمسة زخرفية وتنميق في الكلام أو الكتابة.
examples: He opened the door with a dramatic flourish.
The speech ended with a rhetorical flourish.
She signed her name with an elaborate flourish.
armA.mnemonic: جاية من 'Flower' 'وردة'.. الـ 'Flourish' تزيين وزخرفة زي الورد.

armB.definition: A bold or extravagant gesture to attract attention; or a decorative detail.
armB.arabic: حركة استعراضية ملفتة للنظر، أو زخرفة وتزيين في الكتابة أو الكلام.
examples: The flower is nice.
He waved his hand.
The signature had a fancy curl.
He opened the door with a dramatic flourish.
The speech ended with a rhetorical flourish.
The manuscript was decorated with artistic flourishes.
armB.mnemonic: جاية من 'Flower' 'وردة'.. الـ 'Flourish' تزيين وزخرفة زي الورد.

armA.definition: To grow or develop in a healthy or vigorous way.
armA.arabic: يزدهر وينمو بقوة.. لما مشروع أو زرعة تكبر وتنجح.
examples: Business is starting to flourish.
Bacteria flourish in warm, damp environments.
Plants need adequate sunlight and water to flourish.
armA.mnemonic: زي الـ 'Flower' 'الوردة' لما تفتح وتكبر.. المشروع بيـ 'Flourish'.

armB.definition: To grow or develop in a healthy or vigorous way.
armB.arabic: يزدهر وينمو بقوة.. لما مشروع أو زرعة تكبر وتنجح.
examples: Flowers grow in the sun.
The plant grows well here.
Business is starting to flourish.
The arts flourished during that period.
Under her leadership, the company flourished.
Bacteria flourish in warm, damp environments.
armB.mnemonic: زي الـ 'Flower' 'الوردة' لما تفتح وتكبر.. المشروع بيـ 'Flourish'.

armA.definition: An irregular rising and falling in number or amount; variation.
armA.arabic: التغيير المستمر طالع نازل، زي سعر الذهب أو درجات الحرارة لما مش بتثبت.
examples: There was a sudden fluctuation in the temperature overnight.
The company suffered heavy losses due to rapid currency fluctuation.
Any slight fluctuation in interest rates could affect the property market.
armA.mnemonic: أولها 'Flu' 'أنفلونزا'.. لما يجيلك 'Flu' حرارتك بيحصلها 'Fluctuation' بتطلع وتنزل.

armB.definition: An irregular rising and falling in number or amount; variation.
armB.arabic: التغيير المستمر طالع نازل، زي سعر الذهب أو درجات الحرارة لما مش بتثبت.
examples: Prices change often.
There was a fluctuation in the temperature.
We noticed small fluctuations in his weight.
The company is worried about currency fluctuation.
Wild fluctuations in the stock market caused panic.
The sensor detects minute fluctuations in atmospheric pressure.
armB.mnemonic: أولها 'Flu' 'أنفلونزا'.. لما يجيلك 'Flu' حرارتك بيحصلها 'Fluctuation' بتطلع وتنزل.

armA.definition: Completely level or even with another surface; or having plenty of money.
armA.arabic: يا إما سطح متساوي وممسوح، يا إما واحد 'مريّش' ومعاه فلوس كتير.
examples: Make sure the shelf is flush with the wall.
He was feeling flush after payday.
The carpenter ensured the nails were flush with the wood.
armA.mnemonic: زي زرار الـ 'Flush' في الحمام بيبقى مساوي للسطح، أو لما المية تجري.. الشخص الـ 'Flush' الفلوس بتجري في إيده.

armB.definition: Completely level or even with another surface; or having plenty of money.
armB.arabic: يا إما سطح متساوي وممسوح، يا إما واحد 'مريّش' ومعاه فلوس كتير.
examples: The door is flat.
His face was red and flush.
Make sure the shelf is flush with the wall.
He was feeling flush after payday.
The carpenter ensured the nails were flush with the wood.
Flush with success, the team celebrated all night.
armB.mnemonic: زي زرار الـ 'Flush' في الحمام بيبقى مساوي للسطح، أو لما المية تجري.. الشخص الـ 'Flush' الفلوس بتجري في إيده.

armA.definition: To move through the air using wings or an aircraft.
armA.arabic: إنك تتحرك في الجو زي الطيور أو تسافر بالطيارة.
examples: Birds can fly.
I will fly to London next week.
The pilot flew the plane safely.
Time flies when you are having fun.
Sparks flew during the heated debate.
She decided to fly in the face of tradition.
armA.mnemonic: نفس الكلمة.. الطيارة بتعمل 'Fly' في السما.

armB.definition: To move through the air using wings or an aircraft.
armB.arabic: إنك تتحرك في الجو زي الطيور أو تسافر بالطيارة.
examples: Birds can fly.
I will fly to London next week.
He wants to learn how to fly a plane.
armB.mnemonic: افتكر كلمة الفراشة (butterfly) وهي بتطير (fly) في الهواء.

armA.definition: Lacking good sense or judgment; unwise.
armA.arabic: غير حكيم أو أحمق؛ يصف شخصاً أو تصرفاً يفتقر إلى حسن التقدير والتمييز.
examples: That was a foolish thing to do.
I felt foolish when I forgot his name.
It would be foolish to ignore the warnings of history.
armA.mnemonic: جاية من 'Fool' 'مغفل'.. الشخص الـ 'Fool' بيعمل تصرفات 'Foolish'.

armB.definition: Lacking good sense or judgment; unwise.
armB.arabic: شخص تصرفاته مش حكيمة أو غبية، أو قرار ملوش لازمة.
examples: That was a foolish thing to do.
I felt foolish when I forgot his name.
It is foolish to spend all your money on toys.
Don't be foolish, come down from the roof.
He realized the foolishness of his pride.
It would be foolish to ignore the warnings of history.
armB.mnemonic: جاية من 'Fool' 'مغفل'.. الشخص الـ 'Fool' بيعمل تصرفات 'Foolish'.

armA.definition: The lower extremity of the leg below the ankle.
armA.arabic: القدم. الجزء اللي تحت في الرجل اللي بتمشي عليه.
examples: My foot hurts.
He goes to school on foot.
The table is three feet long.
She tapped her foot impatiently.
He decided to foot the bill for dinner.
The mountain stands at the foot of the valley.
armA.mnemonic: كلمة 'Foot' بتفكرنا بـ 'Football'.. الكورة اللي بتلعبها برجلك.

armB.definition: The part of the body at the bottom of the leg on which a person or animal stands and walks.
armB.arabic: القدم. الجزء اللي تحت في الرجل اللي بتمشي عليه.
examples: My foot hurts.
He goes to school on foot.
She tapped her foot impatiently.
armB.mnemonic: كلمة 'Foot' بتفكرنا بـ 'Football'.. الكورة اللي بتلعبها برجلك.

armA.definition: To refuse to allow something; to order someone not to do something.
armA.arabic: يمنع أو يحرم حاجة بشكل قاطع، عكس يسمح.
examples: I forbid you to go.
International treaties forbid the use of chemical weapons.
Strict social codes forbid such behavior in public.
armA.mnemonic: كلمة 'For-bid'.. تخيل إنك بتقول لحد 'لأ' على الـ 'Bid' 'العرض' بتاعه.. يعني بتمنعه.

armB.definition: To refuse to allow something; to order someone not to do something.
armB.arabic: يمنع أو يحرم حاجة بشكل قاطع، عكس يسمح.
examples: I forbid you to go.
Smoking is forbidden here.
My parents forbid me from staying out late.
The law forbids the sale of alcohol to minors.
International treaties forbid the use of chemical weapons.
Strict social codes forbid such behavior in public.
armB.mnemonic: كلمة 'For-bid'.. تخيل إنك بتقول لحد 'لأ' على الـ 'Bid' 'العرض' بتاعه.. يعني بتمنعه.

armA.definition: A large area covered chiefly with trees and undergrowth.
armA.arabic: الغابة، مكان واسع وكبير كله شجر وحيوانات برية.
examples: Bears live in the forest.
We walked through the forest.
The forest is full of tall trees.
Forest fires are a major problem in summer.
The tropical rainforest is rich in biodiversity.
Sustainable forest management is crucial for the environment.
armA.mnemonic: مكان كله 'Rest' 'راحة' وهدوء بين الشجر في الـ 'Forest'.

armB.definition: A large area covered chiefly with trees and undergrowth.
armB.arabic: الغابة، مكان واسع وكبير كله شجر وحيوانات برية.
examples: Bears live in the forest.
We walked through the forest.
The forest is full of tall trees.
armB.mnemonic: مكان كله 'Rest' 'راحة' وهدوء بين الشجر في الـ 'Forest'.

armA.definition: To fail to remember something.
armA.arabic: ينسى.. لما المعلومة تروح من بالك أو ماتفتكرش تعمل حاجة.
examples: Don't forget your keys.
I forgot his name.
I will never forget this day.
He completely forgot about the meeting.
Let's forget our differences and work together.
She tried to forget the trauma of her childhood.
armA.mnemonic: عشان 'Get' 'تجيب' المعلومة تاني، لازم ماتعملش 'Forget' 'نسيان'.

armB.definition: To fail to remember something.
armB.arabic: ينسى.. لما المعلومة تروح من بالك أو ماتفتكرش تعمل حاجة.
examples: Don't forget your keys.
I will never forget this day.
Let's forget our differences and work together.
armB.mnemonic: عشان 'Get' 'تجيب' المعلومة تاني، لازم ماتعملش 'Forget' 'نسيان'.

armA.definition: To stop being angry with someone for something they have done.
armA.arabic: إنك تسامح حد وتنسى الغلط اللي عمله في حقك.
examples: Please forgive me.
She forgave him for being late.
It is hard to forgive someone who lied to you.
I can forgive the accident, but not the carelessness.
He begged her to forgive his indiscretion.
To forgive is divine, but to forget is often impossible.
armA.mnemonic: مكونة من 'For' و 'Give'.. كأنك بتعطي 'Give' السماح والعفو.

armB.definition: To stop being angry with someone for something they have done.
armB.arabic: إنك تسامح حد وتنسى الغلط اللي عمله في حقك.
examples: Please forgive me for not letting you know sooner.
It is hard to forgive someone who lied to you.
I can forgive the accident, but not the carelessness.
armB.mnemonic: مكونة من 'For' و 'Give'.. كأنك بتعطي 'Give' السماح والعفو.

armA.definition: To decide not to have or do something that you would like to have or do.
armA.arabic: تتنازل عن حاجة أو تسيبها بمزاجك، حتى لو كنت عايزها.
examples: I will not go.
She decided to forgo the trip.
I'll forgo dessert tonight.
He agreed to forgo his salary for a month.
The company decided to forgo the usual Christmas party.
She resolved to forgo all personal comforts to achieve her goal.
armA.mnemonic: كلمة 'For' 'لأجل' + 'Go' 'يذهب'.. كأنك بتقول 'Go' للحاجة دي عشان خاطر حاجة تانية 'تتخلى عنها'.

armB.definition: To decide not to have or do something that you would like to have or do.
armB.arabic: تتنازل عن حاجة أو تسيبها بمزاجك، حتى لو كنت عايزها.
examples: She decided to forgo the trip.
He agreed to forgo his salary for a month.
She resolved to forgo all personal comforts to achieve her goal.
armB.translations: يتخلى عن يمتنع عن يتنازل عن
armB.mnemonic: كلمة 'For' 'لأجل' + 'Go' 'يذهب'.. كأنك بتقول 'Go' للحاجة دي عشان خاطر حاجة تانية 'تتخلى عنها'.

armA.definition: In the past; in earlier times.
armA.arabic: سابقاً، يعني زمان أو في وقت فات، بنستخدمها لما نتكلم عن حاجة اتغيرت.
examples: The house was formerly a school.
He formerly worked in a bank.
This country was formerly known as Burma.
armA.mnemonic: جاية من 'Formal'.. لأ، جاية من 'Former' يعني السابق.

armB.definition: In the past; in earlier times.
armB.arabic: سابقاً، يعني زمان أو في وقت فات، بنستخدمها لما نتكلم عن حاجة اتغيرت.
examples: Not used in A1.
The house was formerly a school.
He formerly worked in a bank.
This country was formerly known as Burma.
Formerly, this procedure was quite dangerous.
The treatise was formerly attributed to Aristotle.
armB.mnemonic: جاية من 'Formal'.. لأ، جاية من 'Former' يعني السابق.

armA.definition: Inspiring fear or respect through being impressively large, powerful, intense, or capable.
armA.arabic: حاجة قوية جداً وليها هيبة، بتخليك تحس بالخوف أو الاحترام، زي خصم قوي أو مهمة صعبة.
examples: They faced a formidable enemy.
Completing the project was a formidable task.
She has a formidable reputation in the legal world.
armA.mnemonic: كلمة 'Formidable' فيها 'For' و 'Mid'.. تخيل 'Middle' الحلبة واقف فيها مصارع 'Formidable' مرعب.

armB.definition: Inspiring fear or respect through being impressively large, powerful, intense, or capable.
armB.arabic: حاجة قوية جداً وليها هيبة، بتخليك تحس بالخوف أو الاحترام، زي خصم قوي أو مهمة صعبة.
examples: He is a strong man.
The mountain looked big and scary.
They faced a formidable enemy.
Completing the project was a formidable task.
She has a formidable reputation in the legal world.
The team overcame formidable obstacles to win the championship.
armB.mnemonic: كلمة 'Formidable' فيها 'For' و 'Mid'.. تخيل 'Middle' الحلبة واقف فيها مصارع 'Formidable' مرعب.

armA.definition: A period of two weeks.
armA.arabic: فترة مدتها أسبوعان (14 يوماً)، وتُستخدم بكثرة في الإنجليزية البريطانية.
examples: We stayed there for a fortnight.
I will see you in a fortnight.
A fortnight ago, the situation was completely different.
armA.mnemonic: الكلمة مشتقة تاريخياً من 'fourteen nights' (أربعة عشر ليلة)، أي ما يعادل أسبوعين.

armB.definition: A period of two weeks.
armB.arabic: فترة مدتها أسبوعين '14 يوم'. كلمة مشهورة جداً في بريطانيا.
examples: I will see you in a fortnight.
We stayed there for a fortnight.
The magazine is published every fortnight.
They went on a fortnight's holiday to Spain.
A fortnight ago, the situation was completely different.
He pledged to return within a fortnight, bearing the necessary documents.
armB.mnemonic: هي اختصار لـ 'Fourteen Nights' 'أربعة عشر ليلة'.. يعني أسبوعين.

armA.definition: The remains of a prehistoric animal or plant found inside a rock.
armA.arabic: بقايا حيوان أو نبات عاش من ملايين السنين ومحفوظ جوه الصخور.
examples: We found a shell fossil on the beach.
The museum has a complete dinosaur fossil on display.
Each fossil provides valuable clues about life millions of years ago.
armA.mnemonic: اربطها بـ 'Fuel'.. لأن الـ 'Fossil' 'الحفرية' هي أصل الـ 'Fossil Fuel' 'الوقود الحفري'.

armB.definition: The remains of a prehistoric animal or plant found inside a rock.
armB.arabic: بقايا حيوان أو نبات عاش من ملايين السنين ومحفوظ جوه الصخور.
examples: Look at this old bone.
Dinosaurs are fossils now.
We found a shell fossil on the beach.
Palaeontologists study fossils to learn about the past.
He is an old fossil who refuses to use computers.
The sedimentary rock layer is rich in marine fossils.
armB.mnemonic: اربطها بـ 'Fuel'.. لأن الـ 'Fossil' 'الحفرية' هي أصل الـ 'Fossil Fuel' 'الوقود الحفري'.

armA.definition: The cardinal number equal to ten plus four; the number 14.
armA.arabic: العدد أربعة عشر (14).
examples: I have fourteen pens.
There are fourteen days in a fortnight.
The building has fourteen floors.
armA.mnemonic: أربعة 'Four' وعشرة 'teen'.. يبقى أربعتاشر

armB.definition: The cardinal number sum of ten and four.
armB.arabic: رقم أربعتاشر.
examples: I have fourteen pens.
There are fourteen days in a fortnight.
Fourteen people applied for the job.
The building has fourteen floors.
Fourteen points were discussed in the agenda.
The isotope Carbon-14 is used for dating.
armB.mnemonic: أربعة 'Four' وعشرة 'teen'.. يبقى أربعتاشر

armA.definition: A small part broken or separated off something.
armA.arabic: حتة صغيرة مكسورة من حاجة أكبر، زي شظية قزاز أو حتة فخار مكسورة.
examples: A fragment of glass.
He found a bone fragment.
The vase broke into fragments.
She heard only a fragment of the conversation.
Archaeologists found fragments of pottery.
The memory returned in fragmented, disjointed images.
armA.mnemonic: كلمة 'Fragile' 'قابل للكسر' لما تقع وتتكسر بتبقى 'Fragments' 'شظايا'.

armB.definition: A small part broken or separated off something, or an incomplete piece of something larger.
armB.arabic: حتة صغيرة مكسورة أو منفصلة عن حاجة أكبر (زي شظية أو كسرة)، أو جزء غير مكتمل من حاجة زي محادثة أو نص.
examples: She found a sharp glass fragment on the kitchen floor.
She heard only a fragment of the conversation.
The archaeologist carefully examined the pottery fragment.
armB.mnemonic: كلمة 'Fragile' (قابل للكسر) لما تقع وتتكسر بتبقى 'Fragments' (شظايا/كسر). الاتنين جايين من نفس المعنى المرتبط بالكسر.

armA.definition: To turn into ice; to preserve food by chilling it below zero; or to stop moving suddenly.
armA.arabic: المية تتحول لتلج، أو تثبت مكانك وماتتحركش خالص.
examples: You can freeze the leftover food.
Fear made him freeze in his tracks.
The bank decided to freeze the account due to suspicious activity.

armB.definition: To turn into ice; to stop moving suddenly.
armB.arabic: المية تتحول لتلج، أو تثبت مكانك وماتتحركش خالص.
examples: Water freezes at 0°C.
It's freezing outside.
You can freeze the leftover food.
The police shouted, 'Freeze!'
Fear made him freeze in his tracks.
The bank decided to freeze the account due to suspicious activity.

armA.definition: Located at or near the most forward part of something.
armA.arabic: حاجة موجودة قدام، زي الباب الأمامي أو الكرسي الأمامي.
examples: Open the front door.
I want the front seat.
The front page of the newspaper covers the story.
armA.mnemonic: افتكر مصطلح 'front desk' في الفندق؛ لأنه دايماً بيكون في أول المدخل من قدام (أمامي).

armB.definition: Located at or near the most forward part of something.
armB.arabic: حاجة موجودة قدام، زي الباب الأمامي أو الكرسي الأمامي.
examples: Open the front door.
I want the front seat.
The front page of the newspaper covers the story.
He sustained an injury to his front teeth.
The front runner in the election is popular.
They launched a full frontal attack.
armB.mnemonic: زي 'Front' 'مقدمة'.. صفة بتوصف أي حاجة إنها 'أمامية'.

armA.definition: Used to emphasize an adjective or statement, considered vulgar and offensive.
armA.arabic: كلمة بتستخدم عشان تأكد على قوة الصفة 'زي جداً' بس هي كلمة بذيئة وعيب.
examples: It is hot outside. (Standard equivalent)
That was crazy. (Standard equivalent)
I am so tired. (Standard equivalent)
It is absolutely freezing out there. (Standard equivalent)
It is fucking freezing out there!
I have absolutely no fucking idea what you are talking about.

armB.definition: Used to emphasize an adjective, adverb, or statement, considered vulgar and highly offensive.
armB.arabic: تُستخدم كأداة توكيد شديدة بمعنى «جداً» أو «للغاية»، وتُعد كلمة بذيئة ونابية للغاية.
examples: It is fucking freezing out there!
He was driving fucking fast down the narrow street.
That movie was fucking awful.

armA.definition: In a central or primary respect; essentially.
armA.arabic: بشكل أساسي وجوهري، يعني في أصل الموضوع مش في القشور.
examples: We are fundamentally different.
The system is fundamentally sound.
I fundamentally agree with your approach.
armA.mnemonic: جاية من 'Fund' 'أساس' أو 'Fundamental'.. الأساس اللي بيتبني عليه كل حاجة.

armB.definition: In a central or primary respect; essentially.
armB.arabic: بشكل أساسي وجوهري، يعني في أصل الموضوع مش في القشور.
examples: It is basically true.
We are fundamentally different.
The system is fundamentally sound.
Fundamentally, I agree with you.
These two theories are fundamentally incompatible.
The discovery fundamentally altered our understanding of physics.
armB.mnemonic: جاية من 'Fund' 'أساس' أو 'Fundamental'.. الأساس اللي بيتبني عليه كل حاجة.

armA.definition: The process of joining two or more things together to form a single entity.
armA.arabic: الاندماج أو الانصهار. لما تدمج حاجتين أو أكتر عشان يبقوا حاجة واحدة، زي في الطاقة النووية أو حتى في الأكل.
examples: We mix two things.
The restaurant serves fusion food.
Jazz fusion is a popular style of music.
The fusion of different cultures created a unique society.
Scientists are working on achieving sustainable nuclear fusion.
The show was a brilliant fusion of dance, theater, and acrobatics.
armA.mnemonic: الـ 'Fuse' 'فيوز' الكهرباء بيسيح.. الـ 'Fusion' هو 'الانصهار' أو دمج حاجات ببعض زي الأكل الـ 'Fusion'

armB.definition: The process of joining two or more things together to form a single entity, or a nuclear reaction where atomic nuclei combine.
armB.arabic: الاندماج أو الانصهار؛ دمج شيئين أو أكثر معًا ليصبحا شيئًا واحدًا، مثل اندماج الثقافات والأنماط الموسيقية، أو الانصهار النووي في الفيزياء.
examples: The fusion of different cultures created a unique society.
Scientists are working on achieving sustainable nuclear fusion.
The show was a brilliant fusion of dance, theater, and acrobatics.
armB.mnemonic: الـ 'Fuse' في الكهرباء بيسيح ويدمج.. والـ 'Fusion' هو الانصهار أو الاندماج، زي الأكل أو الموسيقى اللي فيها اندماج (Fusion).

armA.definition: The state or quality of being lighthearted, cheerful, or festive.
armA.arabic: حالة من المرح والبهجة والسعادة، زي جو العيد أو الاحتفالات.
examples: Her laughter added to the gaiety of the evening.
The festival was a scene of color and gaiety.
The gaiety of the carnival masked the underlying social tensions.
armA.mnemonic: جاية من 'Gay' 'بمعناها القديم: سعيد'.. الـ 'Gaiety' هي السعادة والمرح.

armB.definition: The state or quality of being lighthearted, cheerful, or festive.
armB.arabic: حالة من المرح والبهجة والسعادة، زي جو العيد أو الاحتفالات.
examples: The party was full of fun.
We heard the sounds of gaiety from the hall.
Her laughter added to the gaiety of the evening.
The festival was a scene of color and gaiety.
Despite the war, she maintained an air of forced gaiety.
The gaiety of the carnival masked the underlying social tensions.
armB.mnemonic: جاية من 'Gay' 'بمعناها القديم: سعيد'.. الـ 'Gaiety' هي السعادة والمرح.

armA.definition: A hinged barrier used to close an opening in a wall or fence.
armA.arabic: الباب الكبير اللي بيدخلك سور أو حديقة أو مكان مهم زي المطار.
examples: Open the gate.
Meet me at the gate.
They installed an electric gate.
armA.mnemonic: كلمة 'Gate' قريبة من 'Late'.. لو اتأخرت الـ 'Gate' هتتقفل.

armB.definition: A hinged barrier used to close an opening in a wall or fence.
armB.arabic: الباب الكبير اللي بيدخلك سور أو حديقة أو مكان مهم زي المطار.
examples: Open the gate.
Meet me at the gate.
The flight leaves from Gate 5.
They installed an electric gate.
The scandal was dubbed 'Moneygate'.
He vaulted over the iron gate with ease.
armB.mnemonic: كلمة 'Gate' قريبة من 'Late'.. لو اتأخرت الـ 'Gate' هتتقفل.

armA.definition: A polite, chivalrous, or honorable man with good manners.
armA.arabic: الراجل اللي أخلاقه عالية وبيحترم الناس وبيتعامل بذوق وأدب، اللي بنقول عليه 'جنتل'.
examples: An old gentleman helped me with my bags.
A true gentleman holds the door for others.
He behaved like a perfect gentleman throughout the evening.
armA.mnemonic: كلمة 'Gentle' يعني لطيف.. فالـ 'Gentleman' هو الراجل اللطيف المحترم في تعامله.

armB.definition: A polite, chivalrous, or honorable man with good manners.
armB.arabic: الراجل اللي أخلاقه عالية وبيحترم الناس وبيتعامل بذوق وأدب، اللي بنقول عليه 'جنتل'.
examples: He is a kind gentleman.
An old gentleman helped me with my bags.
A true gentleman holds the door for others.
He behaved like a perfect gentleman throughout the evening.
The dispute was settled in a gentleman's agreement.
His conduct was indicative of a gentleman of the old school.
armB.mnemonic: كلمة 'Gentle' يعني لطيف.. فالـ 'Gentleman' هو الراجل اللطيف المحترم في تعامله.

armA.definition: Relating to geometry, or characterized by regular lines and shapes.
armA.arabic: ليه علاقة بالأشكال الهندسية زي المربع والمثلث والخطوط المستقيمة.
examples: The building has a geometric design.
Islamic art is famous for its geometric patterns.
The population growth followed a geometric progression.
armA.mnemonic: 'Geo' أرض + 'Metric' قياس.. الهندسة هي قياس الأرض والأشكال.

armB.definition: Relating to geometry, or characterized by regular lines and shapes.
armB.arabic: ليه علاقة بالأشكال الهندسية زي المربع والمثلث والخطوط المستقيمة.
examples: The rug has shapes.
We learned about geometric shapes in school.
The building has a geometric design.
Islamic art is famous for its geometric patterns.
The artist uses bold geometric forms in his sculpture.
The population growth followed a geometric progression.
armB.mnemonic: 'Geo' أرض + 'Metric' قياس.. الهندسة هي قياس الأرض والأشكال.

armA.definition: A thing given willingly to someone without payment; a present.
armA.arabic: الهدية التي تُعطى لشخص من غير مقابل، وتُستخدم أيضاً بمعنى موهبة فطرية.
examples: This is a gift for you.
The watch was a gift from my father.
He has a gift for languages.
armA.mnemonic: جاية من 'Give' 'يعطي'.. الـ 'Gift' هي العطية أو الهدية.

armB.definition: A thing given willingly to someone without payment; a present.
armB.arabic: الهدية اللي بتديها لحد من غير مقابل.. وممكن تيجي بمعنى موهبة ربانية.
examples: This is a gift for you.
I got many gifts on my birthday.
He has a gift for languages.
The shop sells gift vouchers.
She is a gifted musician.
His speech was a gift to the opposition.
armB.mnemonic: جاية من 'Give' 'يعطي'.. الـ 'Gift' هي العطية أو الهدية.

armA.definition: The capacity to bend or alter shape under pressure without breaking; elasticity.
armA.arabic: المرونة أو القابلية للثني؛ القدرة على التحرك أو التمدد تحت الضغط دون أن ينكسر الشيء.
examples: The floor is hard; it has no give.
These new shoes have enough give to be comfortable.
There is no give in the rope; it is pulled tight.
armA.mnemonic: كلمة 'Give' معناها يعطي.. والشيء اللي فيه 'Give' 'مرونة' هو اللي 'بيديك' مساحة تتحرك وما بيعاندش معاك.

armB.definition: The capacity to bend or alter shape under pressure without breaking; elasticity.
armB.arabic: المرونة أو القابلية للثني. لما تقول إن الحاجة دي فيها 'Give' يعني مش ناشفة وبتتحرك معاك، زي المرتبة الطرية أو الجزمة الجلد.
examples: This bed is soft.
The floor is hard; it has no give.
These new shoes have enough give to be comfortable.
There is no give in the rope; it is pulled tight.
The bridge structure needs some give to withstand the wind.
The negotiations failed because there was no give on either side.
armB.mnemonic: كلمة 'Give' معناها يعطي.. والشيء اللي فيه 'Give' 'مرونة' هو اللي 'بيديك' مساحة تتحرك وما بيعاندش معاك.

armA.definition: To freely transfer the possession of something to someone.
armA.arabic: يعطي أو يدي حاجة لحد. زي لما تدي هدية لصاحبك.
examples: Please give me the book.
They give money to charity every year.
I will give you the keys tomorrow.
armA.mnemonic: كلمة 'Give' قريبة من 'Gift' 'هدية'.. لما تدي حد 'Gift' إنت بتعمل 'Give'.

armB.definition: To freely transfer the possession of something to someone.
armB.arabic: يعطي أو يدي حاجة لحد. زي لما تدي هدية لصاحبك.
examples: Please give me the book.
I will give you a call later.
They give money to charity every year.
The teacher gave us a lot of homework.
The sun gives off light and heat.
He gave himself up to the police after the incident.
armB.mnemonic: كلمة 'Give' قريبة من 'Gift' 'هدية'.. لما تدي حد 'Gift' إنت بتعمل 'Give'.

armA.definition: A steady radiance of light or heat.
armA.arabic: ضوء خافت ودافئ طالع من حاجة سخنة أو منورة، زي الجمر أو الوش المحمر من الفرحة.
examples: The fire has a warm glow.
The lamp gives a soft glow.
She felt a warm glow of happiness.
The city lights cast an orange glow on the clouds.
The healthy glow in her cheeks showed she was recovering.
The afterglow of the sunset lingered on the horizon.
armA.mnemonic: زي 'Slow'.. النور بيطلع 'Slow' وهادي في الـ 'Glow'.

armB.definition: A steady radiance of light or heat, or a warm feeling or healthy appearance.
armB.arabic: ضوء خافت ودافئ أو حرارة خفيفة مستمرة، وممكن يعبر كمان عن احمرار صحي في الوجه أو إحساس دافئ بالسعادة والرضا.
examples: The fire has a warm glow.
She felt a warm glow of happiness.
The city lights cast an orange glow on the clouds.
armB.mnemonic: زي 'Slow'.. النور بيطلع 'Slow' وهادي في الـ 'Glow'.

armA.definition: A sticky substance used for joining things together.
armA.arabic: المادة اللي بنستخدمها عشان نلزق الحاجات المكسورة أو الورق في بعضه.
examples: I need some glue for my project.
Use glue to stick the picture.
The glue takes an hour to dry.
He glued the broken pieces of the vase together.
Their shared history was the glue that held the team together.
The agreement served as the social glue for the community.
armA.mnemonic: كلمة 'Glue' قصيرة زي 'Gum'.. الـ 'Glue' هو اللي بيلزق الورق والخشب.

armB.definition: A sticky substance used for joining things together.
armB.arabic: المادة اللي بنستخدمها عشان نلزق الحاجات المكسورة أو الورق في بعضه.
examples: I need some glue for my project.
Use glue to stick the picture.
The glue takes an hour to dry.
armB.mnemonic: كلمة 'Glue' قصيرة زي 'Gum'.. الـ 'Glue' هو اللي بيلزق الورق والخشب.

armA.definition: To move from one place to another; to travel.
armA.arabic: يعني يتحرك من مكان لمكان تاني. زي لما تروح الشغل أو المدرسة.
examples: I go to school by bus.
Let's go to the park.
We plan to go abroad next year.
Everything went according to plan.
The prize goes to the best writer.
He decided to go against the prevailing wisdom.
armA.mnemonic: كلمة 'Go' شبه 'Goal'.. عشان تجيب 'Goal' لازم 'Go' 'تتحرك' ناحية المرمى.

armB.definition: To move from one place to another; to travel.
armB.arabic: يعني يتحرك من مكان لمكان تاني، زي لما تروح الشغل أو المدرسة.
examples: I go to school by bus.
Let's go to the park.
We plan to go abroad next year.
armB.mnemonic: كلمة 'Go' شبه 'Goal'.. عشان تجيب 'Goal' لازم 'Go' 'تتحرك' ناحية المرمى.

armA.definition: The player in sports like soccer whose job is to stop the ball from entering the goal.
armA.arabic: اللاعب اللي بيقف في الجون ومهمته يمنع الكورة تدخل الشبكة.
examples: The goalkeeper stopped the ball.
He wants to be a goalkeeper.
The goalkeeper made a great save.
Our team needs a better goalkeeper.
The goalkeeper's reflexes were tested throughout the match.
Tactically, the modern goalkeeper acts as an eleventh outfield player.
armA.mnemonic: هو الشخص اللي بيعمل 'Keep' 'حفاظ' على الـ 'Goal' 'المرمى' عشان مايدخلش فيه هدف.

armB.definition: The player in sports like soccer whose job is to stop the ball from entering the goal.
armB.arabic: اللاعب اللي بيقف في الجون ومهمته يمنع الكورة تدخل الشبكة.
examples: The goalkeeper stopped the ball.
The goalkeeper made a great save.
Our team needs a better goalkeeper.
armB.mnemonic: هو الشخص اللي بيعمل 'Keep' (حفاظ) على الـ 'Goal' (المرمى) عشان مايدخلش فيه هدف.

armA.definition: A farm animal with horns and a beard, kept for milk and meat.
armA.arabic: حيوان المعزة اللي بنربيه عشان اللبن واللحم.
examples: The goat eats grass.
We saw a goat on the farm.
Goat milk is very healthy.
The mountain goat climbed the steep rock.
He was acting the goat to make us laugh.
The scapegoat mechanism is a concept in anthropology.
armA.mnemonic: كلمة 'Goat' قريبة من 'Go at'.. المعزة بتنطح وبتهجم 'Go at' على أي حاجة.

armB.definition: A farm animal with horns and a beard, kept for milk and meat.
armB.arabic: حيوان المعزة اللي بنربيه عشان اللبن واللحم.
examples: The goat eats grass in the field.
We saw a goat on the farm.
The farmer keeps a goat for fresh milk.
armB.mnemonic: كلمة 'Goat' قريبة من 'Go at'.. المعزة بتنطح وبتهجم 'Go at' على أي حاجة.

armA.definition: The quality of being morally good.
armA.arabic: الطيبة والخير اللي في الشخص، أو الجودة اللي في الشيء.
examples: She is a good person.
Oh my goodness!
I trust in his goodness.
The vegetables are full of natural goodness.
She did it out of the goodness of her heart.
Philosophers have debated the inherent goodness of mankind for centuries.
armA.mnemonic: جاية من 'Good'.. الـ 'Goodness' هو الخير نفسه.

armB.definition: The quality of being morally good.
armB.arabic: الطيبة والخير اللي في الشخص، أو الجودة اللي في الشيء.
examples: I trust in his goodness.
The vegetables are full of natural goodness.
She did it out of the goodness of her heart.
armB.mnemonic: جاية من 'Good'.. الـ 'Goodness' هو الخير نفسه.

armA.definition: Taking place or progressing slowly or by degrees.
armA.arabic: حاجة بتحصل شوية بشوية، ببطء وعلى مراحل، مش فجأة مرة واحدة.
examples: The change was slow.
We saw a gradual change in the weather.
There has been a gradual improvement in his health.
The gradual decline of the empire took centuries.
She favored a gradual approach to reform rather than revolution.
The slope is so gradual that you hardly notice you are climbing.
armA.mnemonic: جاية من 'Grade' 'درجة'.. يعني بتطلع درجة درجة، مش مرة واحدة.

armB.definition: Taking place or progressing slowly or by degrees.
armB.arabic: حاجة بتحصل شوية بشوية، ببطء وعلى مراحل، مش فجأة مرة واحدة.
examples: There has been a gradual improvement in his health.
We saw a gradual change in the weather.
The slope is so gradual that you hardly notice you are climbing.
armB.mnemonic: جاية من 'Grade' 'درجة'.. يعني بتطلع درجة درجة، مش مرة واحدة.

armA.definition: Slowly, over a long period of time.
armA.arabic: تدريجياً، يعني واحدة واحدة مش مرة واحدة. زي لما الجو يبرد شوية بشوية.
examples: The weather gradually improved.
Her health is gradually getting better.
The sound gradually faded away into silence.
armA.mnemonic: جاية من 'Grade' 'درجة'.. يعني بتطلع السلم 'Grade' بـ 'Grade' 'درجة بدرجة' مش بتنط.

armB.definition: Slowly, over a long period of time.
armB.arabic: تدريجياً، يعني واحدة واحدة مش مرة واحدة. زي لما الجو يبرد شوية بشوية.
examples: It got dark slowly.
The car stopped slowly.
The weather gradually improved.
Her health is gradually getting better.
The sound gradually faded away into silence.
Old traditions are gradually dying out in the modern world.
armB.mnemonic: جاية من 'Grade' 'درجة'.. يعني بتطلع السلم 'Grade' بـ 'Grade' 'درجة بدرجة' مش بتنط.

armA.definition: A diagram showing the relationship between different measurements.
armA.arabic: رسم بياني يوضح العلاقة بين الأرقام والمعلومات.
examples: The graph shows our sales this year.
We plotted the results on a graph.
The data is represented in a bar graph.
armA.mnemonic: جزء من كلمة 'Graphic'.. الـ 'Graph' هو رسم توضيحي.

armB.definition: A diagram showing the relationship between different measurements.
armB.arabic: رسم بياني بيوضح العلاقة بين الأرقام والمعلومات.
examples: Look at the picture.
Draw a line on the paper.
The graph shows our sales this year.
We plotted the results on a graph.
The data is represented in a bar graph.
The exponential growth curve is clearly visible on the graph.
armB.mnemonic: جزء من كلمة 'Graphic'.. الـ 'Graph' هو رسم توضيحي.

armA.definition: To crush something into small particles; to rub surfaces together harshly.
armA.arabic: إنك تكسر حاجة وتخليها بودرة، أو تحك حاجتين في بعض جامد.
examples: We grind coffee beans.
Please grind the pepper.
Do not grind your teeth.
They grind the corn into flour.
The traffic ground to a halt.
He had an axe to grind with the administration.
armA.mnemonic: زي ما الـ 'Grinder' بتطحن البن، الـ 'Grind' هو الفعل نفسه.

armB.definition: To crush something into small particles; to rub surfaces together harshly.
armB.arabic: إنك تكسر حاجة وتخليها بودرة، أو تحك حاجتين في بعض جامد.
examples: They grind fresh coffee beans every morning.
Stress often causes people to grind their teeth at night.
Without immediate funding, the entire project will grind to a halt.
armB.mnemonic: زي ما الـ 'Grinder' بتطحن البن، الـ 'Grind' هو الفعل نفسه.

armA.definition: To increase in size or amount; to develop physically.
armA.arabic: يكبر وينمو، سواء للإنسان أو الزرع، أو حتى الفلوس والمشاريع لما تزيد.
examples: Plants need water and sunlight to grow.
Children grow quickly during their early years.
They grow fresh vegetables in their garden.
armA.mnemonic: اربطها بـ 'Grass' 'عشب'.. الـ 'Grass' بيحب 'Grow' في الجنينة.

armB.definition: To increase in size or amount; to develop physically.
armB.arabic: يكبر وينمو، سواء للإنسان أو الزرع، أو حتى الفلوس والمشاريع لما تزيد.
examples: Plants grow fast.
Children grow up quickly.
The economy is growing.
He grew a beard.
They grew apart over the years.
The problem grew out of a simple misunderstanding.
armB.mnemonic: اربطها بـ 'Grass' 'عشب'.. الـ 'Grass' بيحب 'Grow' في الجنينة.

armA.definition: An association of people for mutual aid or the pursuit of a common goal, especially a medieval association of craftsmen or merchants.
armA.arabic: جمعية أو نقابة كانت بتضم الحرفيين زمان (زي النجارين أو الحدادين) عشان يحموا مصالحهم، وتُطلق أيضاً على بعض الروابط المهنية الحديثة.
examples: He joined the merchant guild to trade freely in the city.
The writers' guild protects the legal rights of authors.
Modern professional associations function somewhat like a medieval guild.
armA.mnemonic: شبه 'Gold' (دهب).. عشان النقابات دي كانت بتتحكم في الفلوس والـ 'Gold' بتاع الصنعة.

armB.definition: An association of people for mutual aid or the pursuit of a common goal.
armB.arabic: جمعية أو نقابة كانت بتضم الحرفيين زمان 'زي النجارين أو الحدادين' عشان يحموا مصالحهم.
examples: A group of workers.
They formed a guild.
The writers' guild protects authors.
He joined the merchant guild to trade freely.
The medieval guild system controlled the quality of goods.
Modern professional associations function somewhat like a guild.
armB.mnemonic: شبه 'Gold' 'دهب'.. عشان النقابات دي كانت بتتحكم في الفلوس والـ 'Gold' بتاع الصنعة.

armA.definition: To suspend from above; or to kill by suspending by the neck.
armA.arabic: إنك تعلق حاجة على مسمار أو شماعة، وليها معنى تاني: يشنق.
examples: Please hang your coat on the hook.
We hang pictures on the wall.
In the past, the court could hang a person for serious crimes.
armA.mnemonic: زي الـ 'Hanger' 'الشماعة'.. بنعمل إيه فيها؟ بنـ 'Hang' الهدوم.

armB.definition: To suspend from above; or to kill by suspending by the neck.
armB.arabic: إنك تعلق حاجة على مسمار أو شماعة، وليها معنى تاني: يشنق.
examples: Hang your coat here.
We hang pictures on the wall.
The smoke hung in the air.
Don't hang up the phone yet.
His life hangs in the balance.
The prisoner was hanged for his crimes.
armB.mnemonic: زي الـ 'Hanger' 'الشماعة'.. بنعمل إيه فيها؟ بنـ 'Hang' الهدوم.

armA.definition: Intense dislike or ill will.
armA.arabic: كراهية شديدة.. شعور قوي جداً بالعداوة تجاه حد.
examples: I don't like war.
He looked at him with hate.
She felt no hatred towards her ex-husband.
The war was fueled by racial hatred.
His speech incited hatred against the minority group.
The feud was driven by a deep-seated hatred spanning generations.
armA.mnemonic: جاية من 'Hate' 'يكره'.. الـ 'Hatred' هو الاسم منها، الكراهية العميقة.

armB.definition: Intense dislike or ill will.
armB.arabic: كراهية شديدة.. شعور قوي جداً بالعداوة تجاه حد.
examples: She felt no hatred towards her ex-husband.
The war was fueled by racial hatred.
His speech incited hatred against the minority group.
armB.mnemonic: جاية من 'Hate' 'يكره'.. الـ 'Hatred' هو الاسم منها، الكراهية العميقة.

armA.definition: To possess, own, hold, or experience something.
armA.arabic: معناها يملك أو عنده حاجة. زي لما تقول 'أنا عندي عربية' أو 'عندي فكرة'.
examples: I have a cat.
Do you have any brothers or sisters?
We have a meeting at 10 AM.
You have to finish this report by tomorrow.
I have yet to see a better performance.
The committee has it in its power to change the rules.
armA.mnemonic: قريبة من كلمة 'هات' 'Hat' بالمصري.. لما تقول لحد 'هات' وتاخد الحاجة، بيبقى عندك 'You have' الحاجة دي.

armB.definition: To possess, own, hold, or experience something.
armB.arabic: معناها يملك أو عنده حاجة. زي لما تقول 'أنا عندي عربية' أو 'عندي فكرة'.
examples: I have a cat.
Do you have any brothers or sisters?
We have a meeting at 10 AM.
armB.mnemonic: قريبة من كلمة 'هات' 'Hat' بالمصري.. لما تقول لحد 'هات' وتاخد الحاجة، بيبقى عندك 'You have' الحاجة دي.

armA.definition: A male person or animal.
armA.arabic: كلمة بنستخدمها عشان نقصد بيها 'الذكر' سواء إنسان أو حيوان.
examples: Is the cat a he?
We don't know if the baby is a he or a she.
That dog is definitely a he.
The main character is a he, not a she.
The concept of the divine as a 'he' is debated.
Gender essentialism often focuses on the 'he' versus the 'she'.
armA.mnemonic: عكس 'هي' بالعربي.. 'He' يعني هو 'ذكر'، مش هي!

armB.definition: A male person or animal.
armB.arabic: كلمة تُستخدم للدلالة على شخص أو حيوان ذكر.
examples: Is the cat a he?
We don't know if the baby is a he or a she.
That dog is definitely a he.
armB.mnemonic: نطق كلمة 'he' يشبه كلمة 'هي' في العربية، لكن المعنى عكس ذلك تماماً: 'he' تعني هو أو ذكر.

armA.definition: An ornamental covering or band for the head, often worn on ceremonial occasions.
armA.arabic: غطاء للرأس بيكون مزخرف وشكله مميز، وغالباً بيتلبس في المناسبات الرسمية أو التقليدية.
examples: The bride wore a beautiful pearl headdress.
The museum displayed a rare ceremonial headdress.
Her heavy jeweled headdress was a symbol of her royal status.
armA.mnemonic: واضحة: 'Head' (رأس) و 'Dress' (لباس/زينة).. يعني زينة أو لباس مخصص للرأس.

armB.definition: An ornamental covering or band for the head, often worn on ceremonial occasions.
armB.arabic: غطاء للرأس بيكون مزخرف وشكله مميز، وغالباً بيتلبس في المناسبات الرسمية أو التقليدية.
examples: She wore a flower on her head.
The king wore a gold headdress.
The bride wore a beautiful pearl headdress.
Tribal leaders wore elaborate feather headdresses.
The museum displayed a rare ceremonial headdress.
Her heavy jeweled headdress was a symbol of her royal status.
armB.mnemonic: واضحة: 'Head' 'رأس' و 'Dress' 'فستان/لبس'.. يعني لبس للرأس.

armA.definition: A man who is in charge of a school; a principal.
armA.arabic: مدير المدرسة 'الناظر'. الشخص المسؤول عن المدرسة كلها.
examples: He is the boss of the school.
The headmaster spoke to the students.
I was sent to the headmaster's office.
The headmaster retired after 30 years of service.
The role of the headmaster has evolved into that of a CEO.
The draconian rules were enforced strictly by the new headmaster.
armA.mnemonic: هو الـ 'Master' والـ 'Head' 'الراس الكبيرة' في المدرسة

armB.definition: A man who is in charge of a school; a principal.
armB.arabic: مدير المدرسة 'الناظر'. الشخص المسؤول عن المدرسة كلها.
examples: The headmaster spoke to the students.
The headmaster retired after 30 years of service.
The role of the headmaster has evolved into that of a CEO.
armB.mnemonic: هو الـ 'Master' والـ 'Head' 'الراس الكبيرة' في المدرسة

armA.definition: To perceive a sound with your ears.
armA.arabic: تسمع صوت بودانك. زي لما تسمع موسيقى أو حد بيكلمك.
examples: I can hear a dog.
Did you hear the news?
I heard that you are moving.
He was heard to say that he would quit.
I won't hear of such a thing!
We have heard tell of his adventures.
armA.mnemonic: كلمة 'Hear' فيها كلمة 'Ear' 'أذن'.. إنت بتستخدم الـ 'Ear' عشان تعمل 'Hear'.

armB.definition: To perceive a sound with your ears.
armB.arabic: تسمع صوت بودانك. زي لما تسمع موسيقى أو حد بيكلمك.
examples: I can hear a dog barking outside.
Speak louder please, I cannot hear you.
Did you hear that strange noise?
armB.mnemonic: كلمة 'Hear' فيها كلمة 'Ear' 'أذن'.. إنت بتستخدم الـ 'Ear' عشان تعمل 'Hear'.

armA.definition: As a consequence; for this reason.
armA.arabic: بمعنى 'عشان كدة' أو 'وبالتالي'. بتستخدم لما تشرح نتيجة لحاجة.
examples: The cost of transport is high, hence the high prices.
He was a newcomer and hence had no enemies.
The evidence is false; hence, the conclusion is invalid.
armA.mnemonic: كلمة 'Hence' شبه 'Hens' 'فراخ'.. الفراخ هربت 'Hence' 'وبالتالي' مفيش بيض النهاردة.

armB.definition: As a consequence; for this reason.
armB.arabic: بمعنى 'عشان كدة' أو 'وبالتالي'. بتستخدم لما تشرح نتيجة لحاجة.
examples: Not typically used in A1 contexts.
It is late, hence we must go.
The cost of transport is high, hence the high prices.
He was a newcomer and hence had no enemies.
The evidence is false; hence, the conclusion is invalid.
The data was corrupted, hence the anomaly in the final report.
armB.mnemonic: كلمة 'Hence' شبه 'Hens' 'فراخ'.. الفراخ هربت 'Hence' 'وبالتالي' مفيش بيض النهاردة.

armA.definition: In, at, or to this place or position.
armA.arabic: هنا، في المكان اللي إحنا فيه دلوقتي.
examples: Come here.
I live near here.
Here is the money I owe you.
Look here, we need to solve this problem.
Here lies the difficulty of the situation.
Herein lies the proof of his innocence.
armA.mnemonic: نفس نطق 'Hear' يسمع.. أنا قادر أسمعك 'Here' في المكان ده.

armB.definition: In, at, or to this place or position.
armB.arabic: هنا، في المكان اللي إحنا فيه دلوقتي.
examples: Come here.
I live near here.
Here is the money I owe you.
armB.mnemonic: نفس نطق 'Hear' يسمع.. أنا قادر أسمعك 'Here' في المكان ده.

armA.definition: Passed from parents to children by genetic transmission, or inherited through family line such as a title or right.
armA.arabic: يُطلق على الشيء الذي ينتقل بالوراثة، سواء كان صفة أو مرضًا ينتقل جينيًا من الآباء للأبناء، أو منصبًا ولقبًا يتوارثه أفراد العائلة.
examples: It is a hereditary condition passed down through generations.
The monarchy is a hereditary institution.
Scientists identified the hereditary defect in the gene.
armA.mnemonic: جاية من 'Heir' 'وريث'.. يعني حاجة بتتورث في العيلة

armB.definition: Passed from parents to children via genes.
armB.arabic: حاجة وراثية.. بتتنقل من الأب والأم للأولاد
examples: Blue eyes are common in his family.
The king's title is hereditary.
Diabetes can be hereditary.
It is a hereditary condition passed down through generations.
The monarchy is a hereditary institution.
Scientists identified the hereditary defect in the gene.
armB.mnemonic: جاية من 'Heir' 'وريث'.. يعني حاجة بتتورث في العيلة

armA.definition: Used to refer to a thing or things belonging to or associated with a female person.
armA.arabic: ضمير ملكية بيعود عليها هي، يعني حاجة بتاعتها أو 'ملكها'.
examples: This bag is hers.
Is this seat yours or hers?
A friend of hers told me the news.
armA.mnemonic: كلمة 'Her' يعني لها، زودنا 's' الملكية بقت 'Hers' يعني 'ملكها'.

armB.definition: Used to refer to a thing or things belonging to or associated with a female person.
armB.arabic: ضمير ملكية بيعود عليها هي، يعني حاجة بتاعتها أو 'ملكها'.
examples: This bag is hers.
Is this seat yours or hers?
She has her own car, and he has his.
A friend of hers told me the news.
Her ideas are quite different from hers.
The decision was entirely hers to make.
armB.mnemonic: كلمة 'Her' يعني لها، زودنا 's' الملكية بقت 'Hers' يعني 'ملكها'.

armA.definition: To put something where it cannot be seen, or to go to a place where you cannot be seen.
armA.arabic: إنك تخبي حاجة أو تستخبى عشان محدش يشوفك.
examples: I hide under the bed.
He tried to hide his feelings from her.
The politician tried to hide the truth from the public.
armA.mnemonic: العب 'Hide and Seek' 'استغماية' واستخبى في الـ 'Hide' 'المخبأ'.

armB.definition: To put something where it cannot be seen.
armB.arabic: إنك تخبي حاجة أو تستخبى عشان محدش يشوفك.
examples: I hide under the bed.
She hid the money in a box.
Clouds hide the sun today.
He tried to hide his feelings from her.
The politician tried to hide the truth from the public.
The data was hidden within the complex code structure.
armB.mnemonic: العب 'Hide and Seek' 'استغماية' واستخبى في الـ 'Hide' 'المخبأ'.

armA.definition: A main road, especially one connecting major towns or cities.
armA.arabic: طريق واسع وسريع بيربط بين المدن، العربيات بتمشي فيه بسرعة عالية ومن غير إشارات توقف كتير.
examples: We took the highway to the beach.
The highway was closed due to an accident.
Driving on the highway requires full attention.
armA.mnemonic: هي 'High' 'عالي' و 'Way' 'طريق'.. طريق سريع بيخليك تمشي بـ 'High' speed.

armB.definition: A main road, especially one connecting major towns or cities.
armB.arabic: طريق واسع وسريع بيربط بين المدن، العربيات بتمشي فيه بسرعة عالية ومن غير إشارات توقف كتير.
examples: Cars drive fast on the highway.
We took the highway to the beach.
The highway was closed due to an accident.
Driving on the highway requires full attention.
The government plans to expand the interstate highway system.
The information superhighway transformed global communication.
armB.mnemonic: هي 'High' 'عالي' و 'Way' 'طريق'.. طريق سريع بيخليك تمشي بـ 'High' speed.

armA.definition: A naturally raised area of land, smaller than a mountain.
armA.arabic: مكان عالي عن الأرض بس أصغر من الجبل (تل أو تلة).
examples: The house is on a hill.
We climbed up the hill.
The car rolled down the steep hill.
armA.mnemonic: الـ 'Hill' 'التل' أصغر من الـ 'Mountain'.. زي الـ 'Heel' 'كعب' عالي شوية عن الأرض.

armB.definition: A naturally raised area of land, smaller than a mountain.
armB.arabic: مكان عالي عن الأرض بس أصغر من الجبل 'تل'.
examples: The house is on a hill.
We climbed up the hill.
The car rolled down the steep hill.
They hiked over the hills and far away.
It's an uphill battle to change their minds.
The ancient fort stood atop the strategic hill.
armB.mnemonic: الـ 'Hill' 'التل' أصغر من الـ 'Mountain'.. زي الـ 'Heel' 'كعب' عالي شوية عن الأرض.

armA.definition: With reference to past events; in the past.
armA.arabic: تاريخياً. يعني لما نتكلم عن حاجة حصلت زمان أو بحسب التاريخ.
examples: This is an old place.
Historically, men worked outside.
The city is historically significant.
Historically, inflation has been much higher.
The region has historically been a center of trade.
Historically accurate costumes are essential for this period drama.
armA.mnemonic: جاية من 'History' 'تاريخ'.. يعني بشكل تاريخي.

armB.definition: With reference to past events; throughout history or in the past.
armB.arabic: تاريخياً؛ يُستخدم للتعبير عن أحداث أو حقائق بالرجوع إلى الماضي أو على مر التاريخ.
examples: The region has historically been a center of trade.
The building is historically significant.
Interest rates are at a historically low level.
armB.mnemonic: جاية من 'History' (تاريخ).. والمقطع 'ally' بيحولها لظرف يعني 'بشكل تاريخي' أو 'تاريخياً'.

armA.definition: Until now or until the point in time under discussion.
armA.arabic: كلمة رسمية تعني «حتى الآن» أو «إلى هذه اللحظة»، وتُستخدم غالبًا في السياقات الأكاديمية والرسمية للإشارة إلى حالة كانت مستمرة حتى وقت محدد.
examples: The area was hitherto unknown to tourists.
We need to tackle problems that have hitherto been ignored.
The company has hitherto managed to avoid any major scandals.
armA.translations: حتى الآن إلى هذا الحد حتى ذلك الحين
armA.mnemonic: قسّم الكلمة إلى جزأين: 'Hither' (إلى هنا) + 'To' (حتى)؛ أي حرفيًا «حتى هنا»، والمقصود بها «حتى هذه اللحظة أو النقطة الزمنية».

armB.definition: Until now or until the point in time under discussion.
armB.arabic: كلمة فصحى شوية معناها 'لحد دلوقتي' أو 'إلى هذه اللحظة'، بتستخدم في السياقات الرسمية.
examples: Not used in A1 context.
Not used in A2 context.
Not used in B1 context.
The area was hitherto unknown to tourists.
We need to tackle problems that have hitherto been ignored.
Hitherto, the company has managed to avoid any major scandals.
armB.mnemonic: قسّمها: 'Hither' 'هنا' + 'To' 'إلى'.. يعني 'إلى هنا' أو 'لحد دلوقتي'.

armA.definition: A person who is sexually attracted to people of their own sex.
armA.arabic: الشخص المثلي جنسياً. اللي بينجذب عاطفياً وجنسياً لأشخاص من نفس نوعه.
examples: Love is universal.
Some people are homosexual.
Discrimination against homosexual people is illegal here.
He came out as homosexual to his family.
The study explored the biological basis of homosexual behavior in animals.
Historical perspectives on the homosexual identity have shifted dramatically.
armA.mnemonic: 'Homo' باللاتيني يعني 'نفس' 'Same'.. و 'Sexual' جنسي.. يعني ينجذب لنفس الجنس.

armB.definition: A person who is sexually attracted to people of their own sex.
armB.arabic: الشخص المثلي جنسياً؛ وهو من ينجذب عاطفياً وجنسياً لأشخاص من نفس جنسه.
examples: He lived openly as a homosexual at a time when society was deeply intolerant.
The activist was recognized as a prominent homosexual who fought bravely for civil rights.
The new legislation ensured that no homosexual could be denied housing based on sexual orientation.
armB.mnemonic: البادئة 'homo-' في اليونانية تعني 'نفس' (same)، و'sexual' تعني جنسي، فالمعنى شخص ينجذب جنسياً لمن هو من نفس جنسه.

armA.definition: Feeling or causing despair; having no expectation of success.
armA.arabic: فاقد الأمل، أو حالة ميئوس منها ومفيش فايدة فيها.
examples: He felt hopeless about the future.
It was a hopeless situation.
She gave a hopeless shrug of her shoulders.
armA.mnemonic: 'Hope' 'أمل' + 'Less' 'بدون'.. يعني مفيش أمل.

armB.definition: Feeling or causing despair; having no expectation of success.
armB.arabic: فاقد الأمل، أو حالة ميئوس منها ومفيش فايدة فيها.
examples: The situation is bad.
I am bad at math (hopeless at).
He felt hopeless about the future.
It was a hopeless situation.
She gave a hopeless shrug of her shoulders.
The doctor admitted the patient's condition was clinically hopeless.
armB.mnemonic: 'Hope' 'أمل' + 'Less' 'بدون'.. يعني مفيش أمل.

armA.definition: Having a high degree of heat or a high temperature.
armA.arabic: سخن أو حار. ممكن توصف الجو، أو الأكل السخن، أو الأكل الحراق 'سبايسي'.
examples: The tea is hot.
It is hot in the summer.
I like hot spicy food.
This is a hot topic right now.
She has a hot temper.
The competition is heating up.
armA.mnemonic: شبه 'Hat' 'طاقية'.. لما الجو يبقى 'Hot' والشمش حامية بنلبس 'Hat'.

armB.definition: Having a high degree of heat or a high temperature.
armB.arabic: سخن أو حار؛ يُستخدم لوصف الجو، أو الأشياء الساخنة، أو الأكل الحراق (سبايسي).
examples: The tea is hot.
It is hot in the summer.
Be careful with that hot pan.
armB.mnemonic: شبه كلمة 'Hat' (طاقية).. لما الجو يبقى 'Hot' والشمس حامية بنلبس 'Hat'.

armA.definition: Having or showing a modest or low estimate of one's own importance.
armA.arabic: شخص متواضع، مش شايف نفسه على الناس، وبسيط في تعامله.
examples: Despite his success, he remained humble.
He came from a humble background.
In my humble opinion, this is the best option.
armA.mnemonic: كلمة 'Humble' قريبة من 'Human' 'إنسان'.. الإنسان لازم يكون 'Humble' ومتواضع.

armB.definition: Having or showing a modest or low estimate of one's own importance.
armB.arabic: شخص متواضع، مش شايف نفسه على الناس، وبسيط في تعامله.
examples: He is a good man.
She is very humble.
Despite his success, he remained humble.
He came from a humble background.
In my humble opinion, this is the best option.
The humble abode belied the immense wealth of its owner.
armB.mnemonic: كلمة 'Humble' قريبة من 'Human' 'إنسان'.. الإنسان لازم يكون 'Humble' ومتواضع.

armA.definition: Causing laughter and amusement; comic.
armA.arabic: حاجة تضحك أو دمها خفيف.
examples: He told a humorous story.
The movie takes a humorous look at family life.
His speech was both insightful and humorous.
armA.mnemonic: جاية من 'Humor' 'فكاهة'.. الشخص الـ 'Humorous' هو اللي عنده حس فكاهي.

armB.definition: Causing laughter and amusement; comic.
armB.arabic: حاجة تضحك أو دمها خفيف.
examples: The book is funny.
He told a humorous story.
She has a humorous way of speaking.
The movie takes a humorous look at family life.
His speech was both insightful and humorous.
The author is known for his humorous observations of daily life.
armB.mnemonic: جاية من 'Humor' 'فكاهة'.. الشخص الـ 'Humorous' هو اللي عنده حس فكاهي.

armA.definition: A person or animal that hunts wild animals for food or sport.
armA.arabic: الصياد.. سواء كان إنسان بيصطاد حيوانات أو حيوان مفترس بيصطاد فريسة.
examples: The hunter has a dog.
Lions are great hunters.
The hunter tracked the deer through the forest.
He is a bargain hunter when shopping.
The ancient tribes were hunter-gatherers.
The corporate headhunter recruited the CEO from a rival firm.
armA.mnemonic: من الفعل 'Hunt' 'يصطاد'.. الـ 'Hunter' هو الصياد.

armB.definition: A person or animal that hunts wild animals for food or sport.
armB.arabic: الصياد؛ سواء كان شخصاً يصطاد الحيوانات أو حيواناً مفترساً يصطاد فريسته.
examples: The hunter tracked the deer through the forest.
A skilled hunter knows how to move quietly through the woods.
The leopard is a solitary hunter that stalks its prey at night.
armB.mnemonic: من الفعل 'hunt' (يصطاد) بإضافة اللاحقة '-er' لتكوين اسم الفاعل، فيكون 'hunter' هو الصياد.

armA.definition: A married man considered in relation to his spouse.
armA.arabic: الزوج.. الراجل المتجوز.
examples: This is my husband.
Her husband is a doctor.
She and her husband run a small business.
armA.mnemonic: الـ 'Husband' لازم يكون بينه وبين مراته 'Band' 'رابطة' قوية.

armB.definition: A married man considered in relation to his spouse.
armB.arabic: الزوج.. الراجل المتجوز.
examples: This is my husband.
Her husband is a doctor.
They live with her husband's parents.
She and her husband run a small business.
He was a devoted husband and father.
The archaic meaning of husband is to manage resources carefully.
armB.mnemonic: الـ 'Husband' لازم يكون بينه وبين مراته 'Band' 'رابطة' قوية.

armA.definition: A proposed explanation made on the basis of limited evidence as a starting point for further investigation.
armA.arabic: تفسير مبدئي أو تخمين علمي لسه محتاج إثبات 'فرضية'.
examples: The scientist formed a hypothesis.
Results supported the hypothesis.
We need to test this hypothesis experimentally.
armA.mnemonic: قريبة من 'Thesis' 'رسالة علمية'.. الـ 'Hypothesis' هي الفرضية اللي بتبني عليها الرسالة.

armB.definition: A proposed explanation made on the basis of limited evidence as a starting point for further investigation.
armB.arabic: تفسير مبدئي أو تخمين علمي لسه محتاج إثبات 'فرضية'.
examples: It is just an idea.
We have a new idea to test.
The scientist formed a hypothesis.
Results supported the hypothesis.
We need to test this hypothesis experimentally.
The null hypothesis was rejected due to statistical significance.
armB.mnemonic: قريبة من 'Thesis' 'رسالة علمية'.. الـ 'Hypothesis' هي الفرضية اللي بتبني عليها الرسالة.

armA.definition: A standard of perfection; a principle to be aimed at.
armA.arabic: المثل الأعلى أو النموذج اللي بنحاول نوصله.
examples: He considered justice to be the highest human ideal.
The small cottage represented her ideal of peaceful country living.
She worked hard to live up to that moral ideal.
armA.mnemonic: زي الصفة.. الـ 'Ideal' هو النموذج اللي مبني على 'Idea' 'فكرة' الكمال.

armB.definition: A standard of perfection; a principle to be aimed at.
armB.arabic: المثل الأعلى أو النموذج اللي بنحاول نوصله.
examples: He is my hero.
She has high hopes.
We share the same ideals.
He remained true to his ideals.
The party betrayed its socialist ideals.
The Platonic ideal of forms is complex.
armB.mnemonic: زي الصفة.. الـ 'Ideal' هو النموذج اللي مبني على 'Idea' 'فكرة' الكمال.

armA.definition: The action of identifying someone or something; an official document proving who you are.
armA.arabic: عملية التعرف على هوية شخص، أو الوثيقة 'البطاقة' اللي بتثبت مين هو.
examples: Show me your ID.
Do you have identification?
The identification of the plants was difficult.
He carried a card for identification.
The witness allowed for the positive identification of the suspect.
Her strong identification with the feminist movement influenced her writing.
armA.mnemonic: اختصارها 'ID'.. البطاقة اللي معاك في المحفظة.

armB.definition: The action of identifying someone or something; an official document proving who you are.
armB.arabic: عملية التعرف على هوية شخص، أو الوثيقة 'البطاقة' اللي بتثبت مين هو.
examples: Do you have identification?
The witness allowed for the positive identification of the suspect.
Her strong identification with the feminist movement influenced her writing.
armB.mnemonic: اختصارها 'ID'.. البطاقة اللي معاك في المحفظة.

armA.definition: Extremely large in size or scale.
armA.arabic: ضخم جداً أو هائل، سواء في الحجم أو الكمية.
examples: The pressure was immense.
He felt immense relief when he heard the news.
The universe is of immense complexity and scale.
armA.mnemonic: كلمة 'Immense' فيها 'Men'.. تخيل 'Men' 'رجال' كتير عددهم 'Immense' 'هائل'.

armB.definition: Extremely large in size or scale.
armB.arabic: ضخم جداً أو هائل، سواء في الحجم أو الكمية.
examples: The elephant is big.
The ocean is very big.
They made an immense amount of money.
The pressure was immense.
He felt immense relief when he heard the news.
The universe is of immense complexity and scale.
armB.mnemonic: كلمة 'Immense' فيها 'Men'.. تخيل 'Men' 'رجال' كتير عددهم 'Immense' 'هائل'.

armA.definition: Continuing without pause or interruption (usually something unpleasant).
armA.arabic: حاجة مستمرة مش بتقف ولا بتفصل، وغالباً بتكون حاجة مزعجة زي دوشة أو مطر.
examples: The noise never stops.
The incessant rain spoiled our picnic.
I am tired of his incessant complaining.
The incessant noise of the traffic kept me awake.
They faced incessant demands from the customers.
The incessant chatter of the monkeys echoed through the jungle.
armA.mnemonic: كلمة 'Cease' يعني يتوقف.. 'In-cessant' يعني لا يتوقف.

armB.definition: Continuing without pause or interruption (usually something unpleasant).
armB.arabic: حاجة مستمرة مش بتقف ولا بتفصل، وغالباً بتكون حاجة مزعجة زي دوشة أو مطر.
examples: The incessant rain spoiled our picnic.
The incessant noise of the traffic kept me awake.
They faced incessant demands from the customers.
armB.mnemonic: كلمة 'Cease' يعني يتوقف.. 'In-cessant' يعني لا يتوقف.

armA.definition: A unit of linear measure equal to one twelfth of a foot (2.54 cm).
armA.arabic: البوصة.. وحدة قياس طول صغيرة (حوالي 2.5 سم).
examples: He is six feet one inch tall.
Move it an inch to the left.
The car missed me by an inch.
armA.mnemonic: قريبة من 'Pinch' 'قرصة'.. المسافة الصغيرة قد القرصة.

armB.definition: A unit of linear measure equal to one twelfth of a foot (2.54 cm).
armB.arabic: البوصة.. وحدة قياس طول صغيرة 'حوالي ٢.٥ سم'.
examples: It is two inches long.
He is six feet one inch tall.
Move it an inch to the left.
The car missed me by an inch.
They fought for every inch of territory.
We are inching closer to a solution.
armB.mnemonic: قريبة من 'Pinch' 'قرصة'.. المسافة الصغيرة قد القرصة.

armA.definition: A slope, especially on a road or railway.
armA.arabic: منحدر أو مطلع، طريق مايل طالع أو نازل.
examples: Not used in A1.
The car went up the hill.
The road has a slight incline.
We walked up a steep incline.
The railway was built on a dangerous incline.
The geological survey measured the precise angle of the incline.
armA.mnemonic: الفعل 'Incline' يعني يميل.. فالاسم هو الميل أو المنحدر نفسه.

armB.definition: A slope, especially on a road or railway.
armB.arabic: منحدر أو مطلع، طريق مايل طالع أو نازل.
examples: The road has a slight incline.
We walked up a steep incline.
The railway was built on a dangerous incline.
armB.mnemonic: الفعل 'Incline' يعني يميل.. فالاسم هو الميل أو المنحدر نفسه.

armA.definition: Not staying the same in behavior or quality; contradictory.
armA.arabic: يعني مش ثابت على مبدأ أو مستوى واحد، النهاردة برأي وبكرة برأي تاني، أو النتائج كل مرة شكل.
examples: His work is not good.
The results are inconsistent.
He is inconsistent in his training.
The witness gave inconsistent statements to the police.
The policy is inconsistent with our values.
Her argument was logically inconsistent and fell apart under scrutiny.
armA.mnemonic: عكس 'Consistent' 'ثابت'.. الـ 'In' للنفي، يبقى 'Inconsistent' يعني شوية كدة وشوية كدة، مش ثابت على حال.

armB.definition: Not staying the same in behavior or quality; contradictory.
armB.arabic: يعني مش ثابت على مبدأ أو مستوى واحد، النهاردة برأي وبكرة برأي تاني، أو النتائج كل مرة شكل.
examples: The witness gave inconsistent statements to the police.
The policy is inconsistent with our values.
Her argument was logically inconsistent and fell apart under scrutiny.
armB.translations: غير متناسق متضارب متناقض غير متسق
armB.mnemonic: عكس 'Consistent' 'ثابت'.. الـ 'In' للنفي، يبقى 'Inconsistent' يعني شوية كدة وشوية كدة، مش ثابت على حال.

armA.definition: A conclusion reached on the basis of evidence and reasoning.
armA.arabic: الاستنتاج. لما توصل لمعلومة مش مكتوبة بشكل مباشر بس فهمتها من السياق أو الأدلة اللي قدامك.
examples: We can make an inference from the data.
She drew an inference from his silence that he was guilty.
Statistical inference allows us to draw conclusions about a population from a sample.
armA.mnemonic: جاية من 'In' + 'Refer'.. بترجع للمعلومات والأدلة اللي عندك عشان تطلع بـ 'Inference' 'استنتاج'.

armB.definition: A conclusion reached on the basis of evidence and reasoning.
armB.arabic: الاستنتاج. لما توصل لمعلومة مش مكتوبة بشكل مباشر بس فهمتها من السياق أو الأدلة اللي قدامك.
examples: That is a good guess.
We can make an inference from the data.
It's a logical inference based on the facts.
The detective made an inference about the killer's motive.
She drew an inference from his silence that he was guilty.
Statistical inference allows us to draw conclusions about a population from a sample.
armB.mnemonic: جاية من 'In' + 'Refer'.. بترجع للمعلومات والأدلة اللي عندك عشان تطلع بـ 'Inference' 'استنتاج'.

armA.definition: A general increase in prices and fall in the purchasing value of money.
armA.arabic: لما الأسعار بتزيد وقيمة الفلوس بتقل، ده اللي بنسميه التضخم الاقتصادي.
examples: Inflation makes food expensive.
The price went up because of inflation.
The government is trying to control inflation.
High inflation reduces the value of savings.
Inflationary pressures are affecting the global market.
Hyperinflation rendered the currency practically worthless.
armA.mnemonic: زي ما بتعمل 'Inflate' 'تنفخ' البالونة وتكبر.. الـ 'Inflation' هو إن الأسعار بتكبر وتتضخم.

armB.definition: A general increase in prices and fall in the purchasing value of money.
armB.arabic: لما الأسعار بتزيد وقيمة الفلوس بتقل، ده اللي بنسميه التضخم الاقتصادي.
examples: The government is trying to control inflation.
High inflation reduces the value of savings.
The price went up because of inflation.
armB.mnemonic: زي ما بتعمل 'Inflate' 'تنفخ' البالونة وتكبر.. الـ 'Inflation' هو إن الأسعار بتكبر وتتضخم.

armA.definition: Having great influence on someone or something; powerful and effective.
armA.arabic: مؤثر، يعني شخص أو شيء عنده قوة وقدرة إنه يغير في آراء الناس أو الأحداث.
examples: He is a big man.
TV is very influential.
She became an influential figure in the company.
His book was very influential in the 1990s.
They are the most influential group in the parliament.
The philosopher's influential treatise changed modern thought.
armA.mnemonic: جاية من 'Influence' 'تأثير'.. الشخص الـ 'Influential' هو اللي كلمته مسموعة.

armB.definition: Having great influence on someone or something; powerful and effective.
armB.arabic: مؤثر، يعني شخص أو شيء عنده قوة وقدرة إنه يغير في آراء الناس أو الأحداث.
examples: She became an influential figure in the company.
His book was very influential in the 1990s.
The philosopher's influential treatise changed modern thought.
armB.mnemonic: جاية من 'Influence' 'تأثير'.. الشخص الـ 'Influential' هو اللي كلمته مسموعة.

armA.definition: Clever, original, and inventive.
armA.arabic: شخص ذكي ومبتكر جداً، أو فكرة عبقرية وجديدة.
examples: It is a clever idea.
He found an ingenious way to fix it.
The device is simple but ingenious.
She is an ingenious cook who creates new recipes.
The engineer came up with an ingenious solution to the problem.
His ingenious plot twists kept the readers guessing until the end.
armA.mnemonic: فيها كلمة 'Genius' 'عبقري'.. الـ 'Ingenious' هو الشخص العبقري أو الفكرة العبقرية.

armB.definition: Clever, original, and inventive in finding new ways to do things or solve problems.
armB.arabic: شخص ذكي ومبتكر جداً، أو فكرة/اختراع يتسم بالعبقرية والابتكار.
examples: The engineer came up with an ingenious solution to the problem.
The device is simple but ingenious.
She is an ingenious cook who creates new recipes.
armB.mnemonic: فيها كلمة 'Genius' 'عبقري'.. الـ 'Ingenious' هو الشخص العبقري أو الفكرة العبقرية.

armA.definition: Lack of fairness or justice; an unfair act.
armA.arabic: الظلم، لما الحق يضيع أو حد يتعامل بطريقة مش عادلة.
examples: They fought against injustice.
It was a terrible injustice to put him in prison.
Social injustice is a major cause of unrest.
armA.mnemonic: 'In' 'نفي' + 'Justice' 'عدالة'.. يعني مفيش عدالة.

armB.definition: Lack of fairness or justice; an unfair act.
armB.arabic: الظلم، لما الحق يضيع أو حد يتعامل بطريقة مش عادلة.
examples: It is not fair.
He felt the injustice.
They fought against injustice.
It was a terrible injustice to put him in prison.
Social injustice is a major cause of unrest.
The novel exposes the gross injustices of the legal system.
armB.mnemonic: 'In' 'نفي' + 'Justice' 'عدالة'.. يعني مفيش عدالة.

armA.definition: An organization having a particular purpose, especially for science, education, or a profession.
armA.arabic: مؤسسة أو معهد متخصص في حاجة معينة زي التعليم أو البحث العلمي.
examples: She studies at a language institute.
The institute is near the city center.
He works for a research institute in London.
The Institute of Physics holds annual conferences.
They founded an institute dedicated to tropical diseases.
The institute's mandate covers both theoretical and applied sciences.
armA.mnemonic: شبه كلمة 'Institution' 'مؤسسة'.. مكان بنتعلم فيه زي الـ 'Institute' بتاع اللغات.

armB.definition: An organization having a particular purpose, especially for science, education, or a profession.
armB.arabic: مؤسسة أو معهد متخصص في مجال معين مثل التعليم أو البحث العلمي.
examples: He works for a research institute in London.
She decided to study English at a local language institute.
They founded an institute dedicated to medical research.
armB.mnemonic: شبه كلمة 'Institution' 'مؤسسة'.. مكان بنتعلم فيه زي الـ 'Institute' بتاع اللغات.

armA.definition: To combine two or more things to form a whole, or to become accepted as part of a group or community.
armA.arabic: إنك تدمج حاجات مع بعض عشان يعملوا نظام واحد متكامل، أو شخص يندمج في مجتمع جديد.
examples: We need to integrate the new software with the old system.
The policy aims to integrate immigrants into the community.
It takes time to integrate into a completely new culture.
armA.mnemonic: افتكر 'Integer' 'رقم صحيح'.. بتجمع الكسور والأجزاء عشان تعمل واحد صحيح 'Integrated'.

armB.definition: To combine two or more things to form a whole; to become part of a group.
armB.arabic: إنك تدمج حاجات مع بعض عشان يعملوا نظام واحد متكامل، أو شخص يندمج في مجتمع جديد.
examples: Mix the parts.
We work together.
The new student integrated well into the class.
We need to integrate the new software with the old system.
The policy aims to integrate immigrants into the community.
The architect integrated modern design with traditional materials.
armB.mnemonic: افتكر 'Integer' 'رقم صحيح'.. بتجمع الكسور والأجزاء عشان تعمل واحد صحيح 'Integrated'.

armA.definition: A person who is well-educated and enjoys serious study and thought.
armA.arabic: شخص مثقف جداً، بيحب القراية والتفكير في المواضيع العميقة.
