examples: He is a thinker.
She reads a lot like an intellectual.
The cafe was full of artists and intellectuals.
He considers himself an intellectual.
Leading intellectuals criticized the government policy.
The role of the public intellectual has diminished in modern society.

armB.definition: A person who is well-educated and enjoys serious study and thought.
armB.arabic: شخص مثقف جداً، بيحب القراية والتفكير في المواضيع العميقة.
examples: He considers himself an intellectual.
The role of the public intellectual has diminished in modern society.
As a young intellectual, he was deeply interested in politics and philosophy.

armA.definition: Allowing a two-way flow of information between a computer and a user, or involving active participation and communication between people.
armA.arabic: تفاعلي، يصف البرامج أو الوسائط التي تستجيب لأفعال المستخدم، أو الأنشطة والأساليب التي تتطلب مشاركة وتفاعلاً بين الأطراف.
examples: The museum has interactive displays for visitors.
The software provides an interactive user interface.
Teachers use interactive games to keep students engaged.
armA.mnemonic: 'Inter' تعني بين + 'Act' تعني فعل أو تصرف؛ المعنى فعل وتأثير متبادل بين طرفين.

armB.definition: Allowing a two-way flow of information between a computer and a user.
armB.arabic: تفاعلي، يعني مش بس تتفرج، لأ ده انت بتدوس وهو بيرد عليك، زي الألعاب أو الشاشات اللمس.
examples: This game is fun.
It is an interactive map.
The museum has interactive displays.
Interactive teaching methods help students learn.
The software provides an interactive user interface.
Highly interactive environments can increase user engagement significantly.
armB.mnemonic: 'Inter' 'بين' + 'Act' 'فعل'.. فعل مشترك بين طرفين.

armA.definition: Situated within or inside; relating to the inside.
armA.arabic: حاجة داخلية، جوه البيت أو المبنى، أو حتى جوه البلد.
examples: The inside is nice.
The interior walls are blue.
She is studying interior design.
The car has a leather interior.
The expedition explored the interior of the continent.
The Minister of the Interior announced new security measures.
armA.mnemonic: عكس 'Exterior' 'خارجي'.. 'In' يعني جوه، يبقى 'Interior' داخلي.

armB.definition: Situated within or inside; relating to the inside.
armB.arabic: حاجة داخلية، جوه البيت أو المبنى، أو حتى جوه البلد.
examples: The interior walls are blue.
She is studying interior design.
Large windows were installed to improve the interior lighting.
armB.mnemonic: عكس 'Exterior' 'خارجي'.. 'In' يعني جوه، يبقى 'Interior' داخلي.

armA.definition: Of or situated on the inside; existing within an organization or country.
armA.arabic: داخلي.. حاجة جوه الشيء أو جوه المؤسسة، مش ظاهرة للناس اللي بره.
examples: The doctor was worried about internal bleeding after the accident.
The company conducted an internal investigation into the incident.
We use an internal messaging system to communicate with colleagues.
armA.mnemonic: شبه 'Enter' 'يدخل'.. الـ 'Internal' هو الحاجة اللي جوه بعد ما تعمل Enter

armB.definition: Of or situated on the inside; existing within an organization or country.
armB.arabic: داخلي.. حاجة جوه الشيء أو جوه المؤسسة، مش ظاهرة للناس اللي بره.
examples: The box has parts inside.
She has internal pain.
We have an internal phone system.
The company conducted an internal investigation.
Internal bleeding can be life-threatening.
The minister of internal affairs addressed the nation.
armB.mnemonic: شبه 'Enter' 'يدخل'.. الـ 'Internal' هو الحاجة اللي جوه بعد ما تعمل Enter

armA.definition: To divide by passing or lying across; to cross each other.
armA.arabic: لما خطين أو طريقين يقطعوا بعض ويتقابلوا في نقطة واحدة.
examples: Two roads intersect near my house.
The two circles intersect at two points.
Our interests intersect in the field of technology.
armA.mnemonic: فيها 'Section' 'قسم'.. الـ 'Intersect' بيقسم الطريق نصين وهو بيعدي عليه.

armB.definition: To divide by passing or lying across; to cross each other.
armB.arabic: لما خطين أو طريقين يقطعوا بعض ويتقابلوا في نقطة واحدة.
examples: The lines cross here.
Two roads intersect near my house.
The path intersects with the main road.
The two circles intersect at two points.
Our interests intersect in the field of technology.
History and mythology often intersect in these ancient stories.
armB.mnemonic: فيها 'Section' 'قسم'.. الـ 'Intersect' بيقسم الطريق نصين وهو بيعدي عليه.

armA.definition: The act of becoming involved in a situation to improve it or prevent it from getting worse.
armA.arabic: التدخل في موقف معين عشان تحل مشكلة أو تمنعها إنها تكبر.
examples: The teacher's help was good.
We need police intervention here.
Early intervention can save lives.
The government's intervention stabilized the economy.
They staged an intervention to help him with his addiction.
Military intervention is often a last resort in diplomatic crises.
armA.mnemonic: جاية من 'Intervene'.. افتكر 'Enter' 'يدخل'.. إنك 'تدخل' عشان تصلح الوضع.

armB.definition: The act of becoming involved in a situation to improve it or prevent it from getting worse.
armB.arabic: التدخل في موقف معين عشان تحل مشكلة أو تمنعها إنها تكبر.
examples: Early intervention can save lives.
Military intervention is often a last resort in diplomatic crises.
They staged an intervention to help him with his addiction.
armB.mnemonic: جاية من 'Intervene'.. افتكر 'Enter' 'يدخل'.. إنك 'تدخل' عشان تصلح الوضع.

armA.definition: Close familiarity or friendship; closeness.
armA.arabic: القرب الشديد والعلاقة الخاصة جداً بين شخصين، زي الصحاب القريبين أو المتجوزين.
examples: True intimacy requires trust and honesty.
The cozy room created an atmosphere of intimacy.
Their relationship lacked emotional intimacy despite their years together.
armA.mnemonic: جاية من 'Intimate'.. يعني 'إنت ميت' في دباديب اللي بتحبه.. دي قمة الـ 'Intimacy'.

armB.definition: Close familiarity or friendship; closeness.
armB.arabic: القرب الشديد والعلاقة الخاصة جداً بين شخصين، زي الصحاب القريبين أو المتجوزين.
examples: They are good friends.
The family has a lot of love and intimacy.
She felt a sense of intimacy with her new friend.
True intimacy requires trust and honesty.
The cozy room created an atmosphere of intimacy.
Their relationship lacked emotional intimacy despite their years together.
armB.mnemonic: جاية من 'Intimate'.. يعني 'إنت ميت' في دباديب اللي بتحبه.. دي قمة الـ 'Intimacy'.

armA.definition: Belonging naturally to something; essential.
armA.arabic: حاجة أساسية وموجودة في طبيعة الشيء نفسه، مش مضافة عليه من بره، زي قيمة الدهب هي فيه هو.
examples: Gold has value.
It is an intrinsic part of the plan.
Trust is intrinsic to a good friendship.
The intrinsic value of the coin is low, but it is rare.
Maths is an intrinsic part of the school curriculum.
Freedom of speech is intrinsic to a democratic society.
armA.mnemonic: أولها 'In' 'داخل'.. الـ 'Intrinsic' هي القيمة اللي 'In' جوه الشيء نفسه مش جاية من بره.

armB.definition: Belonging naturally to something; essential.
armB.arabic: حاجة أساسية وموجودة في طبيعة الشيء نفسه، مش مضافة عليه من بره، زي قيمة الدهب هي فيه هو.
examples: Trust is intrinsic to a good friendship.
The intrinsic value of the coin is low, but it is rare.
Freedom of speech is intrinsic to a democratic society.
armB.mnemonic: أولها 'In' 'داخل'.. الـ 'Intrinsic' هي القيمة اللي 'In' جوه الشيء نفسه مش جاية من بره.

armA.definition: Based on feelings rather than facts or proof; easy to understand without instruction.
armA.arabic: حاجة بتفهمها بالإحساس أو بالبديهة من غير ما حد يشرحهالك، أو برنامج سهل الاستخدام.
examples: It feels right.
The game is easy and intuitive.
She has an intuitive understanding of animals.
The software is very intuitive to use.
He made an intuitive decision that saved the company.
Most people have an intuitive sense of right and wrong.
armA.mnemonic: جاية من 'Intuition' 'الحدس'.. يعني بتعتمد على إحساسك الداخلي.

armB.definition: Based on feelings rather than facts or proof; easy to understand without instruction.
armB.arabic: حاجة بتفهمها بالإحساس أو بالبديهة من غير ما حد يشرحهالك، أو برنامج وتصميم سهل الاستخدام.
examples: She has an intuitive understanding of animals.
The software is very intuitive to use.
He made an intuitive decision that saved the company.
armB.mnemonic: جاية من 'Intuition' 'الحدس'.. يعني بتعتمد على إحساسك الداخلي.

armA.definition: In every case or on every occasion; always.
armA.arabic: كلمة معناها إن الحاجة دي بتحصل علطول في كل مرة، من غير أي تغيير أو استثناء.
examples: She invariably forgets her keys when she leaves.
The most difficult questions are invariably asked at the end.
Such policies invariably lead to economic stagnation.
armA.mnemonic: جاية من 'Vary' يختلف.. و 'In' للنفي.. يعني 'Invariably' حاجة مش بتختلف أبداً.

armB.definition: In every case or on every occasion; always.
armB.arabic: كلمة معناها إن الحاجة دي بتحصل علطول في كل مرة، من غير أي تغيير أو استثناء.
examples: He is always late. (Simpler equivalent)
It happens every time. (Simpler equivalent)
The train is consistently late.
She invariably forgets her keys when she leaves.
Invariably, the most difficult questions are asked at the end.
Such policies invariably lead to economic stagnation.
armB.mnemonic: جاية من 'Vary' يختلف.. و 'In' للنفي.. يعني 'Invariably' حاجة مش بتختلف أبداً.

armA.definition: Impossible to see.
armA.arabic: حاجة مستحيل تشوفها بعينك، زي الهوا أو الأشباح.
examples: The wind is invisible.
Germs are invisible to the eye.
He felt invisible in the crowd.
The plane uses technology to be invisible to radar.
The invisible barrier between the two groups remained.
They discussed the concept of the 'invisible hand' in economics.
armA.mnemonic: 'Visible' يعني متشاف.. 'In' بتنفي.. يبقى 'Invisible' مش متشاف.

armB.definition: Impossible to see.
armB.arabic: حاجة مستحيل تشوفها بعينك، زي الهوا أو الأشباح.
examples: Germs are invisible to the eye.
He felt invisible in the crowd.
The plane uses technology to be invisible to radar.
armB.mnemonic: 'Visible' يعني متشاف.. 'In' بتنفي.. يبقى 'Invisible' مش متشاف.

armA.definition: Cause to be or remain alone or apart from others.
armA.arabic: تفصل شخص أو حاجة عن الباقيين وتخليه لوحده.
examples: You should isolate yourself if you have the flu.
They tried to isolate the problem to fix it.
Scientists managed to isolate the specific gene responsible for the disease.
armA.mnemonic: جاية من 'Island' 'جزيرة'.. لما تعمل 'Isolate' لحد بتخليه كأنه عايش في 'Island' لوحده.

armB.definition: Cause to be or remain alone or apart from others.
armB.arabic: تفصل شخص أو حاجة عن الباقيين وتخليه لوحده.
examples: He is alone in the room.
Doctors isolate sick patients.
They tried to isolate the problem to fix it.
You should isolate yourself if you have the flu.
The political regime sought to isolate the country from international influence.
Scientists managed to isolate the specific gene responsible for the disease.
armB.mnemonic: جاية من 'Island' 'جزيرة'.. لما تعمل 'Isolate' لحد بتخليه كأنه عايش في 'Island' لوحده.

armA.definition: A book in which you write personal experiences and thoughts, or a serious magazine or newspaper that deals with a particular subject.
armA.arabic: دفتر يوميات بتكتب فيه أحداث يومك ومشاعرك، أو مجلة علمية متخصصة بتنشر أبحاث ومقالات.
examples: I write in my journal every night.
He keeps a travel journal to remember his trips.
The scientist published his findings in a medical journal.
armA.mnemonic: كلمة 'Journal' جاية من 'Journey' 'رحلة'.. لأنك بتكتب فيها تفاصيل رحلة حياتك كل يوم.

armB.definition: A daily record of news and events of a personal nature; a diary.
armB.arabic: دفتر يوميات بتكتب فيه أحداث يومك ومشاعرك، أو مجلة علمية متخصصة بتنشر أبحاث.
examples: I write in my journal every night.
She bought a new journal for school.
He keeps a travel journal to remember his trips.
The scientist published his findings in a medical journal.
Reflective journaling can help improve mental health.
The academic journal requires a rigorous peer-review process.
armB.mnemonic: كلمة 'Journal' جاية من 'Journey' 'رحلة'.. لأنك بتكتب فيها تفاصيل رحلة حياتك كل يوم.

armA.definition: Based on or behaving according to what is morally right and fair.
armA.arabic: عادل أو منصف. بتوصف الشخص أو القرار اللي بيدي كل واحد حقه.
examples: He is a good man.
The rules are fair for everyone.
We need a fair solution to the problem.
It was a just decision by the judge.
They are fighting for a just cause.
A just society must protect its most vulnerable members.
armA.mnemonic: كلمة 'Just' جاية من 'Justice' 'عدالة'.. الشخص الـ 'Just' هو العادل.

armB.definition: Based on or behaving according to what is morally right and fair.
armB.arabic: عادل أو منصف. بتوصف الشخص أو القرار اللي بيدي كل واحد حقه.
examples: It was a just decision by the judge.
They are fighting for a just cause.
A just society must protect its most vulnerable members.
armB.mnemonic: كلمة 'Just' جاية من 'Justice' (عدالة).. فالشخص أو القرار الـ 'Just' هو العادل والمنصف.

armA.definition: To go down on your knees.
armA.arabic: تنزل على ركبك 'تركع'.
examples: Kneel down here.
He knelt to pray.
She knelt beside the bed.
They knelt in protest.
The knight knelt before the queen.
He knelt down to examine the footprints in the mud.
armA.mnemonic: جاية من 'Knee' ركبة.. يعني تنزل على الـ 'Knee'.

armB.definition: To go down on your knees.
armB.arabic: أن تنزل على ركبتيك (تركع أو تجثو).
examples: Kneel down on the cushion if the floor is too hard.
The protesters decided to kneel in silent demonstration.
You should kneel so the children can see your face clearly.
armB.mnemonic: جاية من كلمة 'Knee' (ركبة).. يعني تنزل على ركبتك.

armA.definition: To have information in your mind; to be aware of something; to be familiar with a person.
armA.arabic: يعني يكون عندك معلومة، أو تكون عارف شخص معين أو مكان.
examples: I know your name.
Do you know how to swim?
I do not know the answer.
armA.mnemonic: كلمة 'Know' نطقها زي 'No'.. بس المعنى إنك 'عارف' مش 'لأ'.

armB.definition: To have information in your mind; to be aware of something; to be familiar with a person.
armB.arabic: يعني يكون عندك معلومة، أو تكون عارف شخص معين أو مكان.
examples: I know your name.
Do you know how to swim?
She knows a lot about history.
I have known him for years.
He is known to be difficult.
They knew better than to argue.
armB.mnemonic: كلمة 'Know' نطقها زي 'No'.. بس المعنى إنك 'عارف' مش 'لأ'.

armA.definition: A room or building used for scientific research, experiments, or testing.
armA.arabic: المعمل أو المختبر اللي العلماء بيعملوا فيه أبحاث وتجارب.
examples: The scientist works in a laboratory.
They sent the sample to the laboratory for analysis.
We did a test in the laboratory.
armA.mnemonic: جاية من 'Labor' بمعنى 'عمل'.. الـ 'Laboratory' هو المكان المخصص للعمل والبحث العلمي.

armB.definition: A room or building used for scientific work.
armB.arabic: المعمل أو المختبر اللي العلماء بيعملوا فيه تجارب.
examples: This is a science lab.
We did a test in the laboratory.
The scientist works in a laboratory.
They sent the sample to the laboratory for analysis.
It was a controlled laboratory experiment.
The pharmaceutical company built a new research laboratory.
armB.mnemonic: جاية من 'Labor' 'عمل'.. الـ 'Laboratory' هو المكان اللي بيحصل فيه العمل العلمي.

armA.definition: A fine open fabric of cotton or silk; also a cord used to tie shoes.
armA.arabic: قماش الدانتيل المزخرف، أو الرباط اللي بنربط بيه الجزمة.
examples: Her dress has white lace.
Tie your shoe lace.
The curtains are made of lace.
She wore a black lace veil.
The drink was laced with poison (verb usage).
Intricate lace patterns were popular in the 19th century.
armA.mnemonic: زي 'Necklace' 'عقد'.. الـ 'Lace' زينة زي العقد، أو رباط.

armB.definition: A fine open fabric of cotton or silk; also a cord used to tie shoes.
armB.arabic: قماش الدانتيل المزخرف، أو الرباط اللي بنربط بيه الجزمة.
examples: Her wedding dress was decorated with delicate white lace.
The lace on his running shoe snapped when he pulled it.
Sunlight streamed into the room through the sheer lace curtains.
armB.mnemonic: زي 'Necklace' 'عقد'.. الـ 'Lace' زينة زي العقد، أو رباط.

armA.definition: The flat area between the waist and knees when seated; or one circuit of a track.
armA.arabic: ليها معنيين: حِجرك 'رجلك وانت قاعد'، أو لفة كاملة في التراك بتاع السباق.
examples: The cat slept on her lap.
The runner finished the final lap.
She lived her whole life in the lap of luxury.
armA.mnemonic: الـ 'Laptop' 'لابتوب' اتسمى كده عشان بيتحط على الـ 'Lap' 'الحجر'.

armB.definition: The flat area between the waist and knees when seated; or one circuit of a track.
armB.arabic: ليها معنيين: حِجرك 'رجلك وانت قاعد'، أو لفة كاملة في التراك بتاع السباق.
examples: Sit on my lap.
The cat slept on her lap.
The runner finished the final lap.
He is on the last lap of his training.
The waves gently lapped against the shore.
She lived her whole life in the lap of luxury.
armB.mnemonic: الـ 'Laptop' 'لابتوب' اتسمى كده عشان بيتحط على الـ 'Lap' 'الحجر'.

armA.definition: Recently; in the later stages of a period.
armA.arabic: في الفترة الأخيرة، أو في الجزء الأخير من حياته أو شغله.
examples: He has been ill latterly.
He worked as a clerk, and latterly as a manager.
Latterly, the company has focused on renewable energy.
armA.mnemonic: جاية من 'Later' 'بعدين'.. يعني في الفترة الأخيرة.

armB.definition: Recently; in the later stages of a period.
armB.arabic: في الفترة الأخيرة، أو في الجزء الأخير من حياته أو شغله.
examples: Not used in A1 contexts.
Not used in A2 contexts.
He has been ill latterly.
Latterly, she has become more interested in art.
He worked as a clerk, and latterly as a manager.
Latterly, the company has focused on renewable energy.
armB.mnemonic: جاية من 'Later' 'بعدين'.. يعني في الفترة الأخيرة.

armA.definition: To put something down gently or carefully; (of a bird) to produce an egg.
armA.arabic: تحط حاجة مكانها براحة، أو الفرخة لما تبيض.
examples: Please lay the book on the table.
Hens lay eggs.
They are going to lay a new carpet.
He laid his hand on my shoulder.
The company had to lay off workers.
Let's lay the groundwork for the negotiation.
armA.mnemonic: زي ما بتقول 'Lay down' يعني ارقد أو حط حاجة.. 'Lay' الكوبايه على المكتب براحة.

armB.definition: To put something down gently or carefully; (of a bird, reptile, or insect) to produce an egg.
armB.arabic: أن تضع شيئاً بحرص أو برفق في مكان ما، أو (للطيور والحشرات) أن تبيض.
examples: Please lay the book on the table.
Hens lay eggs.
They are going to lay a new carpet.
armB.mnemonic: اربط الفعل lay بكلمة layer (طبقة)؛ عندما تقوم بفعل lay فإنك تفرش شيئاً أو تضعه برفق كطبقة مستوية على السطح.

armA.definition: To show the way to a destination by going in front of or beside someone.
armA.arabic: تمشي قدام الناس عشان تدلهم على الطريق، أو تكون المسؤول عن مجموعة.
examples: This road leads to the city.
She leads the team.
He led us to a safe place.
Eating too much sugar can lead to health problems.
The investigation led to several arrests.
His charisma led him to become a powerful figure.

armB.definition: To show the way to a destination by going in front of or beside someone.
armB.arabic: تمشي قدام الناس عشان تدلهم على الطريق، أو تكون المسؤول عن مجموعة.
examples: Can you lead the way to the train station?
She will lead the group during the museum tour.
Eating too much sugar can lead to health problems.

armA.definition: To go away from a place; to let something remain in a particular state.
armA.arabic: تمشي وتسيب مكان، أو تسيب حاجة زي ما هي.
examples: I leave home at 8 AM.
Don't leave me alone.
Did you leave the door unlocked?
armA.mnemonic: كلمة 'Leave' شبه 'Live' 'يعيش' بس النطق مختلف.. عشان 'Live' 'تعيش' حياتك لازم أحياناً 'Leave' 'تغادر' أماكن معينة.

armB.definition: To go away from a place; to let something remain in a particular state.
armB.arabic: تمشي وتسيب مكان، أو تسيب حاجة زي ما هي.
examples: I leave home at 8 AM.
Don't leave me alone.
The train leaves in five minutes.
Did you leave the door unlocked?
Leave it to me, I'll handle it.
The scandal left his reputation in tatters.
armB.mnemonic: كلمة 'Leave' شبه 'Live' 'يعيش' بس النطق مختلف.. عشان 'Live' 'تعيش' حياتك لازم أحياناً 'Leave' 'تغادر' أماكن معينة.

armA.definition: Allowed by law; reasonable and acceptable.
armA.arabic: حاجة قانونية أو شرعية، أو حتى مبرر مقبول.. يعني مش حاجة شمال.
examples: Is this business legitimate?
He has a legitimate reason for being late.
They are the legitimate owners of the land.
The army restored the legitimate government.
She raised a legitimate concern about the budget.
The legitimacy of the election results was questioned by the opposition.
armA.mnemonic: قريبة من 'Legal' 'قانوني'.. الـ 'Legitimate' هو الشيء اللي القانون بيعترف بيه.

armB.definition: Allowed by law; reasonable and acceptable.
armB.arabic: حاجة قانونية أو شرعية، أو سبب منطقي ومبرر مقبول.
examples: He has a legitimate reason for being late.
She raised a legitimate concern about the budget.
They are the legitimate owners of the land.
armB.mnemonic: قريبة من 'Legal' (قانوني).. الـ 'Legitimate' هو الشيء اللي القانون بيعترف بيه ومقبول.

armA.definition: An organization or person that lends money.
armA.arabic: الشخص أو البنك اللي بيسلفك فلوس وعادة بياخد عليها فوايد.
examples: The lender requires collateral before approving the loan.
You must repay the lender according to the agreed schedule.
They decided to work with a private lender to finance the project.
armA.mnemonic: جاية من 'Lend' 'يسلف'.. الـ 'Lender' هو اللي بيسلف.

armB.definition: An organization or person that lends money.
armB.arabic: الشخص أو البنك اللي بيسلفك فلوس وعادة بياخد عليها فوايد.
examples: He gives money.
The bank is a lender.
You need to pay back the lender.
We found a lender for our new house mortgage.
The lender requires collateral for the loan.
Predatory lenders often target vulnerable communities with high interest rates.
armB.mnemonic: جاية من 'Lend' 'يسلف'.. الـ 'Lender' هو اللي بيسلف.

armA.definition: Not so great or important as the other or the rest.
armA.arabic: الأقل أو الأصغر في الأهمية أو الحجم مقارنة بحاجة تانية.
examples: We chose the lesser of two evils.
A lesser man would have given up.
The charge was reduced to a lesser offense.
armA.mnemonic: جاية من 'Less' 'أقل'.

armB.definition: Not so great or important as the other or the rest.
armB.arabic: الأقل أو الأصغر في الأهمية أو الحجم مقارنة بحاجة تانية.
examples: Not used in A1.
Not used in A2.
A lesser man would have given up.
They traveled to lesser known islands.
We chose the lesser of two evils.
The charge was reduced to a lesser offense.
armB.mnemonic: جاية من 'Less' 'أقل'.

armA.definition: To allow someone to do something or to allow something to happen.
armA.arabic: يدع أو يسمح. يعني تسيب حد يعمل حاجة أو تخلي حاجة تحصل
examples: Please let me help you.
Please let the dog out.
Don't let him drive your car.
armA.mnemonic: كلمة 'Let' شبه 'لِيت' 'يا ليت'.. لما تقول يا ليت كذا يحصل، يعني بتطلب السماح بحدوثه

armB.definition: To allow someone to do something or to allow something to happen.
armB.arabic: يدع أو يسمح. يعني تسيب حد يعمل حاجة أو تخلي حاجة تحصل
examples: Let me help you.
Please let the dog out.
Don't let him drive your car.
She decided to let the apartment to students.
Let's assume, for the sake of argument, that you are right.
He let slip that he was planning to resign.
armB.mnemonic: كلمة 'Let' شبه 'لِيت' 'يا ليت'.. لما تقول يا ليت كذا يحصل، يعني بتطلب السماح بحدوثه

armA.definition: Relating to the words or vocabulary of a language.
armA.arabic: معجمي.. حاجة ليها علاقة بالكلمات والمفردات في اللغة.
examples: English has a rich lexical variety.
The lexical density of this text is very high.
He analyzed the lexical structure of the poem.
armA.mnemonic: جاية من 'Lexicon' 'قاموس'.. يعني حاجة ليها علاقة بالكلمات اللي في القاموس.

armB.definition: Relating to the words or vocabulary of a language.
armB.arabic: معجمي.. حاجة ليها علاقة بالكلمات والمفردات في اللغة.
examples: Words have meaning.
We learned new words.
The dictionary explains the meaning.
English has a rich lexical variety.
The lexical density of this text is very high.
He analyzed the lexical structure of the poem.
armB.mnemonic: جاية من 'Lexicon' 'قاموس'.. يعني حاجة ليها علاقة بالكلمات اللي في القاموس.

armA.definition: The state of being responsible for something, especially by law; or a disadvantage.
armA.arabic: مسؤولية قانونية 'عليك فلوس أو حق'، أو حاجة بتسببلك مشاكل وبتعطلك.
examples: Not typically used in A1 contexts.
He admitted liability for the mistake.
The company has limited liability.
The old car became a liability.
They wanted to avoid any legal liability.
His outspoken nature was seen as a political liability.
armA.mnemonic: جاية من 'Liable' يعني مسؤول.. الـ 'Liability' هي المسؤولية دي، أو العبء اللي عليك.

armB.definition: The state of being responsible for something, especially by law; or a person or thing that causes problems or puts someone at a disadvantage.
armB.arabic: مسؤولية قانونية 'عليك فلوس أو حق'، أو حاجة بتسببلك مشاكل وبتعطلك.
examples: He admitted liability for the mistake.
They wanted to avoid any legal liability.
His outspoken nature was seen as a political liability.
armB.mnemonic: جاية من 'Liable' يعني مسؤول.. الـ 'Liability' هي المسؤولية دي، أو العبء اللي عليك.

armA.definition: Legally responsible for something; or likely to do/suffer something.
armA.arabic: إنك تكون مسؤول قانوناً عن حاجة لو حصلت غلطة، أو مُعرض إن حاجة وحشة تحصلك.
examples: Not typically used at A1.
If you break it, you might be liable.
The company is liable for the damage.
He is liable to get angry if you ask him that.
The court found him liable for negligence.
Areas near the river are liable to flooding during the monsoon.
armA.mnemonic: قريبة من 'Lie' 'يكذب'.. لو عملت 'Lie' هتكون 'Liable' للمساءلة القانونية.

armB.definition: Legally responsible for something; or likely to do/suffer something.
armB.arabic: إنك تكون مسؤول قانوناً عن حاجة لو حصلت غلطة، أو مُعرض إن حاجة وحشة تحصلك.
examples: The court found him liable for negligence.
The company is liable for the damage.
He is liable to get angry if you ask him that.
armB.mnemonic: قريبة من 'Lie' 'يكذب'.. لو عملت 'Lie' هتكون 'Liable' للمساءلة القانونية.

armA.definition: The state or fact of something being likely; probability.
armA.arabic: الاحتمالية، أي مدى إمكانية أو فرصة وقوع أمر ما.
examples: There is a strong likelihood that prices will rise.
In all likelihood, he will arrive tomorrow.
The likelihood of winning is small.
armA.mnemonic: جاية من 'Likely' 'مُحتمل'.. الـ 'Likelihood' هي نسبة الاحتمال دي.

armB.definition: The state or fact of something being likely; probability.
armB.arabic: الاحتمالية. يعني قد إيه ممكن الحاجة دي تحصل.
examples: Is there a chance?
There is a likelihood of rain.
The likelihood of winning is small.
In all likelihood, he will arrive tomorrow.
There is a strong likelihood that prices will rise.
The statistical likelihood of such an event occurring is infinitesimal.
armB.mnemonic: جاية من 'Likely' 'مُحتمل'.. الـ 'Likelihood' هي نسبة الاحتمال دي

armA.definition: To stay in a place longer than necessary because of a reluctance to leave.
armA.arabic: تفضل قاعد في مكان أو مكمل في حاجة وقت أطول من اللازم، بتتباطأ ومش عايز تمشي.
examples: Customers often linger over coffee for hours at the small cafe.
Do not linger in the hallway after the bell rings.
The pleasant scent of lavender will linger in the room all evening.
armA.mnemonic: كلمة 'Linger' فيها 'Long' 'طويل'.. يعني بتقعد وقت 'Longer' أطول.

armB.definition: To stay in a place longer than necessary because of a reluctance to leave.
armB.arabic: تفضل قاعد في مكان أو مكمل في حاجة وقت أطول من اللازم، بتتباطأ ومش عايز تمشي.
examples: He stayed late.
Don't wait too long.
The smell of coffee lingered in the kitchen.
She lingered after class to talk to the teacher.
Doubts lingered in his mind for days.
The last notes of the song lingered in the air before fading.
armB.mnemonic: كلمة 'Linger' فيها 'Long' 'طويل'.. يعني بتقعد وقت 'Longer' أطول.

armA.definition: The process of closing a business and selling its assets to pay debts.
armA.arabic: تصفية الشركة، يعني بيع كل ممتلكاتها عشان تسدد ديونها وتقفل.
examples: The company went into liquidation last year.
Creditors demanded the liquidation of the firm's assets.
Following the scandal, the board voted for the immediate liquidation of the subsidiary.
armA.mnemonic: جاية من 'Liquid' 'سائل'.. الـ 'Liquidation' يعني تسييل الأصول 'تحويلها لفلوس كاش'.

armB.definition: The process of closing a business and selling its assets to pay debts.
armB.arabic: تصفية الشركة، يعني بيع كل ممتلكاتها عشان تسدد ديونها وتقفل.
examples: The shop is closing.
Everything must go during the liquidation sale.
The company went into liquidation last year.
Creditors demanded the liquidation of the firm's assets.
The liquidation process can take several months to complete.
Following the scandal, the board voted for the immediate liquidation of the subsidiary.
armB.mnemonic: جاية من 'Liquid' 'سائل'.. الـ 'Liquidation' يعني تسييل الأصول 'تحويلها لفلوس كاش'.

armA.definition: Something heavy that is being carried or lifted.
armA.arabic: الحمولة أو العبء اللي بتشيله، سواء كان بضاعة على عربية أو ضغط شغل عليك.
examples: The load is heavy.
He carried a load of wood.
The truck has a full load.
I have a heavy workload this week.
The pillars bear the entire load of the roof.
He groaned under the psychic load of his guilt.
armA.mnemonic: الـ 'Loader' 'لَوْدَر' بيرفع الـ 'Load' 'الحمولة' التقيلة.

armB.definition: Something heavy that is being carried or lifted.
armB.arabic: الحمولة أو العبء اللي بتشيله، سواء كان بضاعة على عربية أو ضغط شغل عليك.
examples: The truck has a full load.
The pillars bear the entire load of the roof.
Talking to a friend helped ease the load.
armB.mnemonic: الـ 'Loader' 'لَوْدَر' بيرفع الـ 'Load' 'الحمولة' التقيلة.

armA.definition: A shaped mass of baked bread.
armA.arabic: رغيف العيش الكامل قبل ما يتقطع 'زي التوست أو الفينو'.
examples: I bought a loaf of bread.
She sliced the loaf.
A fresh loaf smells wonderful.
armA.mnemonic: كلمة 'Loaf' شبه 'Life'.. والعيش هو الـ 'Life' 'الحياة' عند ناس كتير.

armB.definition: A shaped mass of baked bread.
armB.arabic: رغيف العيش الكامل قبل ما يتقطع 'زي التوست أو الفينو'.
examples: I bought a loaf of bread.
We need two loaves.
She sliced the loaf.
A fresh loaf smells wonderful.
Meatloaf is a dish shaped like a loaf.
He spent the afternoon loafing around the house.
armB.mnemonic: كلمة 'Loaf' شبه 'Life'.. والعيش هو الـ 'Life' 'الحياة' عند ناس كتير.

armA.definition: A sum of money that is borrowed and expected to be paid back with interest.
armA.arabic: القرض.. مبلغ بتستلفه من البنك أو من شخص ولازم ترجعه تاني، غالباً بفوائد.
examples: I need money.
Can I get a loan from the bank?
He is paying back a student loan.
The bank approved her application for a car loan.
The company secured a bridge loan to cover immediate costs.
Predatory lending practices often involve loans with exorbitant interest rates.
armA.mnemonic: كلمة 'Loan' شبه 'لون'.. ممكن تقول 'أنا أخدت Loan عشان أدهن البيت لون جديد'

armB.definition: A sum of money that is borrowed and expected to be paid back with interest.
armB.arabic: القرض.. مبلغ بتستلفه من البنك أو من شخص ولازم ترجعه تاني، غالباً بفوائد.
examples: The bank approved her application for a car loan.
He is paying back a student loan.
The company secured a bridge loan to cover immediate costs.
armB.mnemonic: كلمة 'Loan' شبه 'لون'.. ممكن تقول 'أنا أخدت Loan عشان أدهن البيت لون جديد'

armA.definition: A mechanism for keeping a door or container fastened, usually operated by a key.
armA.arabic: القفل اللي بنقفل بيه الباب أو الشنطة عشان الأمان.
examples: I have a key for the lock.
The door has a strong lock.
He changed the lock on the front door.
She cut a lock of her hair as a keepsake.
The boat passed through the canal lock.
The wrestler put his opponent in a headlock.
armA.mnemonic: لو معاك 'Lock' 'قفل' قوي، فأنت عندك 'Luck' 'حظ' إن الحرامي مش هيعرف يدخل.

armB.definition: A mechanism for keeping a door or container fastened, usually operated by a key.
armB.arabic: القفل اللي بنقفل بيه الباب أو الشنطة عشان الأمان.
examples: I have a key for the lock.
The door has a strong lock.
He changed the lock on the front door.
armB.mnemonic: لو معاك 'Lock' 'قفل' قوي، فأنت عندك 'Luck' 'حظ' إن الحرامي مش هيعرف يدخل.

armA.definition: A master or ruler; a man of noble rank.
armA.arabic: سيد أو حاكم، أو شخصية نبيلة 'لورد'.
examples: Not typically used in A1 contexts.
The lord of the castle.
They prayed to the Lord.
He acted like the lord of the manor.
Good Lord, what happened?
The feudal system relied on the relationship between lord and vassal.

armB.definition: A man of noble rank or high social title; a master or ruler who holds power over others or over land.
armB.arabic: سيد أو حاكم، أو رجل من طبقة النبلاء يحمل لقباً رفيعاً (لورد).
examples: The feudal system relied on the relationship between lord and vassal.
He behaved like the lord of the manor whenever guests visited.
The king granted the loyal lord a large estate in the north.

armA.definition: Supreme power or rule; a title of respect used when speaking to or about a judge or nobleman.
armA.arabic: لقب احترام بيتقال للنبلاء أو القضاة في بريطانيا، معناه السيادة أو العظمة.
examples: Yes, your lordship.
He bowed to his lordship.
The lordship of the manor.
He lost his lordship over the lands.
We await Your Lordship's decision.
The concept of divine lordship was central to medieval theology.
armA.mnemonic: جاية من 'Lord'.. لقب للتعظيم.

armB.definition: Supreme power or rule; a title of respect used when speaking to or about a judge or nobleman.
armB.arabic: السيادة أو السلطة، وتُستخدم أيضاً كلقب احترام رسمي للنبلاء والقضاة في بريطانيا (مثل: صاحب السيادة).
examples: He bowed to his lordship.
He lost his lordship over the lands.
The concept of divine lordship was central to medieval theology.
armB.mnemonic: جاية من 'Lord'.. لقب للتعظيم.

armA.definition: To be unable to find something, or to fail to win a game, contest, or battle.
armA.arabic: يعني أن تضيع منك حاجة ولا تجدها، أو تخسر في لعبة أو مسابقة.
examples: Did you lose your keys?
I don't want to lose the game.
She is trying to lose weight.
armA.mnemonic: كلمة 'Lose' (يخسر/يضيع) شبه 'Loose' (واسع أو مفكوك).. لو الزرار 'Loose' ممكن يقع و 'Lose' تضيعه.

armB.definition: To be unable to find something; to fail to win.
armB.arabic: يعني 'تضيع' منك حاجة ومش لاقيها، أو 'تخسر' في لعبة أو ماتش.
examples: Did you lose your keys?
I don't want to lose the game.
She is trying to lose weight.
He might lose his job.
They began to lose hope.
The nuances were lost in translation.
armB.mnemonic: كلمة 'Lose' 'يخسر' شبه 'Loose' 'مفكوك'.. لو الزرار 'Loose' ممكن تقع و 'Lose' 'تضيعه'.

armA.definition: Mentally ill; very angry; or extremely enthusiastic.
armA.arabic: مجنون أو فاقد لصوابه، وفي الإنجليزية الأمريكية تأتي كثيراً بمعنى غاضب جداً، وتُستعمل أيضاً للتعبير عن شدة الشغف أو الهوس بشيء ما.
examples: He is mad at me.
Are you mad?
She is mad about football.
armA.mnemonic: كلمة 'Mad' يعني مجنون.. قريبة من 'Bad'.. لما حد يبقى 'Mad' مزاجه بيبقى 'Bad'.

armB.definition: Mentally ill; very angry; or extremely enthusiastic.
armB.arabic: مجنون أو عقله ضايع. وفي اللهجة الأمريكية بتيجي بمعنى غضبان جداً.
examples: He is mad at me.
Are you mad?
She is mad about football.
The noise was driving me mad.
It was a mad dash to the airport.
There is a method to his madness.
armB.mnemonic: كلمة 'Mad' يعني مجنون.. قريبة من 'Bad'.. لما حد يبقى 'Mad' مزاجه بيبقى 'Bad'.

armA.definition: To make someone extremely annoyed or angry; to drive insane.
armA.arabic: يعصب حد جداً ويطير عقله، أو يجننه.
examples: Don't make me mad.
The noise maddens him.
It maddens me when people are late.
The slow internet connection was maddening.
The injustice of the situation maddened the crowd.
To be ignored completely is enough to madden anyone.
armA.mnemonic: جاية من 'Mad' 'مجنون'.. الـ 'Madden' هو الفعل، يعني يجنن حد.

armB.definition: To make someone extremely annoyed or angry; to drive insane.
armB.arabic: يعصب حد جداً ويطير عقله، أو يجننه.
examples: To be ignored completely is enough to madden anyone.
Such persistent delays would madden even the most patient traveler.
It was an evasive tactic designed to madden his opponents.
armB.mnemonic: جاية من 'Mad' 'مجنون'.. الـ 'Madden' هو الفعل، يعني يجنن حد.

armA.definition: To form, construct, or create something.
armA.arabic: يصنع أو يعمل حاجة. زي لما تعمل كيكة أو تعمل دوشة.
examples: They make cars in this factory.
You need to make a decision.
Can you help me make dinner?
armA.mnemonic: كلمة 'Make' شبه 'Cake'.. يلا نعمل 'Make' a 'Cake'.

armB.definition: To form, construct, or create something.
armB.arabic: يصنع أو يعمل حاجة. زي لما تعمل كيكة أو تعمل دوشة.
examples: I make a cake.
She makes her bed every morning.
They make cars in this factory.
You need to make a decision.
We must make do with what we have.
The news made headlines around the world.
armB.mnemonic: كلمة 'Make' شبه 'Cake'.. يلا نعمل 'Make' a 'Cake'.

armA.definition: A person, company, or machine that makes something.
armA.arabic: الشخص أو المصنع اللي بيصنع أو بيخلق حاجة.
examples: He is a toy maker.
I bought a coffee maker.
She is a talented jewelry maker.
armA.mnemonic: من الفعل 'Make' 'يصنع'.. واضحة جداً.

armB.definition: A person, company, or machine that makes something.
armB.arabic: الشخص أو المصنع اللي بيصنع أو بيخلق حاجة.
examples: He is a toy maker.
I bought a coffee maker.
She is a talented jewelry maker.
He is a key decision-maker in the company.
The documentary features interviews with the filmmaker.
They believe in a divine Maker (God).
armB.mnemonic: من الفعل 'Make' 'يصنع'.. واضحة جداً.

armA.definition: The business of promoting and selling products or services.
armA.arabic: علم التسويق، يعني إزاي تروج للمنتج بتاعك وتخلي الناس تشتريه.
examples: Good marketing helps sell products.
She is the new marketing manager.
They launched a massive marketing campaign.
armA.mnemonic: جاية من كلمة 'Market' 'سوق'.. الـ 'Marketing' هو إنك تنزل بضاعتك الـ 'Market' وتعرف تبيعها.

armB.definition: The business of promoting and selling products or services.
armB.arabic: علم التسويق، يعني إزاي تروج للمنتج بتاعك وتخلي الناس تشتريه.
examples: He works in sales.
Good marketing helps sell products.
She is the new marketing manager.
They launched a massive marketing campaign.
Digital marketing has changed how companies reach customers.
The strategy relies on subtle viral marketing techniques.
armB.mnemonic: جاية من كلمة 'Market' 'سوق'.. الـ 'Marketing' هو إنك تنزل بضاعتك الـ 'Market' وتعرف تبيعها.

armA.definition: Relating to physical objects rather than the mind or spirit.
armA.arabic: حاجة مادية ملموسة، مش معنوية أو روحية.
examples: We live in a material world.
His material needs were met.
She is not interested in material possessions.
The storm caused significant material damage.
They focused on material gain rather than ethics.
Dialectical materialism is a philosophical concept.
armA.mnemonic: قريبة من 'Matter' 'مادة'.. الـ 'Material' هو الشيء المادي.

armB.definition: Relating to physical objects rather than the mind or spirit.
armB.arabic: مرتبط بالأشياء المادية الملموسة وليس بالأمور الروحية أو المعنوية.
examples: We live in a material world.
She is not interested in material possessions.
The storm caused significant material damage.
armB.mnemonic: قريبة من 'Matter' (مادة)، فالشيء الـ 'Material' هو الشيء المادي الملموس.

armA.definition: The elected head of a city, town, or other municipality.
armA.arabic: العمدة أو المحافظ، الشخص المنتخب اللي بيدير المدينة.
examples: The mayor opened the new park.
She is running for mayor this year.
We met the mayor of the town.
armA.mnemonic: الـ 'Mayor' هو الـ 'Major' 'الرئيسي' في المدينة.

armB.definition: The elected head of a city, town, or other municipality.
armB.arabic: العمدة أو المحافظ، الشخص المنتخب اللي بيدير المدينة.
examples: The mayor is happy.
We met the mayor of the town.
The mayor opened the new park.
She is running for mayor this year.
The mayor's jurisdiction ends at the city limits.
Corruption allegations plagued the mayor's administration.
armB.mnemonic: الـ 'Mayor' هو الـ 'Major' 'الرئيسي' في المدينة.

armA.definition: A professional soldier hired to serve in a foreign army.
armA.arabic: مرتزق.. جندي بيحارب عشان الفلوس بس، مش عشان وطنه ولا قضية.
examples: He fights for money.
The army hired mercenaries.
Mercenaries do not care about the cause.
He was accused of being a mercenary.
The government denied using mercenaries in the conflict.
Machiavelli warned princes against relying on mercenary troops.
armA.mnemonic: قريبة من 'Merchant' 'تاجر'.. الـ 'Mercenary' هو اللي بيحارب عشان الفلوس زي التاجر

armB.definition: A professional soldier hired to serve in a foreign army or private military force.
armB.arabic: مرتزق، وهو جندي محترف يقاتل لصالح دولة أو جهة أجنبية مقابل المال دون اعتبار لأي قضية وطنية.
examples: He was accused of being a mercenary.
A mercenary fights for financial gain rather than national loyalty.
The rebel leader hired an experienced mercenary to train his recruits.
armB.mnemonic: قريبة من كلمة Merchant (تاجر)؛ فالمرتزق (mercenary) يتاجر بسلاحه ويحارب من أجل المال فقط كأنه صفقة تجارية.

armA.definition: The chemical processes in a living thing that turn food into energy.
armA.arabic: عملية الحرق في الجسم.. إزاي جسمك بيحول الأكل لطاقة عشان تعيش
examples: Food gives us energy.
Exercise helps your body burn energy.
He has a very fast metabolism so he doesn't get fat.
Drinking water can boost your metabolism.
The drug interferes with the metabolism of certain vitamins.
Basal metabolism accounts for the majority of daily energy expenditure.
armA.mnemonic: افتكر 'Metal'.. جسمك بيحرق الأكل زي المكنة الـ 'Metal' عشان يطلع طاقة

armB.definition: The chemical processes in a living thing that turn food into energy.
armB.arabic: عملية الحرق في الجسم.. إزاي جسمك بيحول الأكل لطاقة عشان تعيش
examples: He has a very fast metabolism so he doesn't get fat.
Drinking water can boost your metabolism.
The drug interferes with the metabolism of certain vitamins.
armB.mnemonic: افتكر 'Metal'.. جسمك بيحرق الأكل زي المكنة الـ 'Metal' عشان يطلع طاقة

armA.definition: To move from one region or habitat to another.
armA.arabic: يعني يسيب بلده أو مكانه ويروح مكان تاني.. زي الطيور أو الناس
examples: Birds fly south.
Some birds migrate in winter.
My grandparents migrated to America.
Thousands of workers migrate to the city for jobs.
We need to migrate the data to a new server.
The tribe migrated across the continent over centuries.
armA.mnemonic: الطيور بتعمل 'Migration' يعني هجرة.. بتسيب مكان وتروح مكان

armB.definition: To move from one region or habitat to another, especially seasonally or in search of work, or to transfer computer data between systems.
armB.arabic: يعني يسيب بلده أو مكانه ويروح مكان تاني.. زي الطيور أو الناس، وتُستخدم أيضاً في مجال التقنية لنقل البيانات من نظام لآخر.
examples: Some birds migrate in winter.
Thousands of workers migrate to the city for jobs.
We need to migrate the data to a new server.
armB.mnemonic: الطيور بتعمل 'Migration' يعني هجرة.. بتسيب مكان وتروح مكان

armA.definition: The least or smallest amount or quantity possible.
armA.arabic: الحد الأدنى.. أقل كمية مسموح بيها.
examples: Ten is the minimum.
Keep noise to a minimum.
The temperature dropped to a minimum of zero.
This is the bare minimum we can accept.
Costs were kept to an absolute minimum.
The local minima in the graph indicate stability points.
armA.mnemonic: نفس فكرة 'Mini'.. الشيء الصغير.

armB.definition: The least or smallest amount or quantity possible.
armB.arabic: الحد الأدنى.. أقل كمية مسموح بيها.
examples: Keep noise to a minimum.
This is the bare minimum we can accept.
Costs were kept to an absolute minimum.
armB.mnemonic: نفس فكرة 'Mini'.. الشيء الصغير.

armA.definition: Wretchedly unhappy or uncomfortable.
armA.arabic: بائس أو تعيس جداً. حالته صعبة وحزين أوي.
examples: I feel sad.
The weather was cold and miserable.
He looked miserable sitting in the rain.
She has been making his life miserable.
The refugees were living in miserable conditions.
It was a miserable failure that cost the company millions.
armA.mnemonic: قريبة من 'Misery' 'بؤس'.. وشبه 'Bues' في رواية 'Les Misérables' 'البؤساء'

armB.definition: Wretchedly unhappy or uncomfortable.
armB.arabic: بائس أو تعيس جداً. حالته صعبة وحزين أوي.
examples: The weather was cold and miserable.
He looked miserable sitting in the rain.
She has been making his life miserable.
armB.mnemonic: قريبة من 'Misery' 'بؤس'.. وشبه 'Bues' في رواية 'Les Misérables' 'البؤساء'

armA.definition: To be wrong about something or to confuse someone with another person.
armA.arabic: إنك تفهم حاجة غلط، أو تشبه على حد وتفتكره حد تاني.
examples: Do not mistake kindness for weakness.
It is easy to mistake him for his brother.
Be careful not to mistake my silence for agreement.
armA.mnemonic: لو عملت 'Miss' 'فوتّ' الحقيقة و 'Take' 'أخدت' الظاهر.. يبقى إنت 'Mistake' 'أخطأت' في الحكم.

armB.definition: To be wrong about something or to confuse someone with another person.
armB.arabic: إنك تفهم حاجة غلط، أو تشبه على حد وتفتكره حد تاني.
examples: Don't mistake me.
I mistook him for his brother.
You are mistaking my silence for agreement.
If I am not mistaken, we have met before.
Do not mistake kindness for weakness.
He was mistaken in his belief that the economy would recover quickly.
armB.mnemonic: لو عملت 'Miss' 'فوتّ' الحقيقة و 'Take' 'أخدت' الظاهر.. يبقى إنت 'Mistake' 'أخطأت' في الحكم.

armA.definition: The ability to move freely or be easily moved.
armA.arabic: القدرة على الحركة أو التنقل بسهولة.
examples: He exercises to improve his mobility.
Social mobility allows people to improve their status.
The new job offers greater career mobility.
armA.mnemonic: جاية من 'Mobile' 'موبايل' لأنه جهاز محمول وبيتحرك معاك.. الـ 'Mobility' هي القدرة على الحركة.

armB.definition: The ability to move freely or be easily moved.
armB.arabic: القدرة على الحركة أو التنقل بسهولة.
examples: I can move well.
The car gives us freedom to move.
He exercises to improve his mobility.
Social mobility allows people to improve their status.
The new job offers greater career mobility.
Urban mobility solutions are essential for modern cities.
armB.mnemonic: جاية من 'Mobile' 'موبايل' لأنه جهاز محمول وبيتحرك معاك.. الـ 'Mobility' هي القدرة على الحركة.

armA.definition: To change something slightly, usually to improve it.
armA.arabic: تغير حاجة تغيير بسيط عشان تحسنها أو تخليها مناسبة أكتر.
examples: I change the plan.
Please modify the text.
We need to modify the design to make it safer.
The software was modified to suit our needs.
The proposals were significantly modified after the consultation.
Genetically modified crops are a subject of intense debate.
armA.mnemonic: فيها كلمة 'Mode'.. يعني بتغير الـ 'Mode' بتاع الحاجة وتعملها 'Modify'.

armB.definition: To change something slightly, usually to improve it.
armB.arabic: تغير حاجة تغيير بسيط عشان تحسنها أو تخليها مناسبة أكتر.
examples: Please modify the text before submitting it.
We need to modify the design to make it safer.
You may need to modify your diet to stay healthy.
armB.mnemonic: فيها كلمة 'Mode'.. يعني بتغير الـ 'Mode' بتاع الحاجة وتعملها 'Modify'.

armA.definition: One of a set of parts that can be connected or combined to build or complete something.
armA.arabic: وحدة أو جزء مستقل من نظام أكبر، زي وحدة دراسية في كورس أو قطعة في جهاز.
examples: We completed the first module of the training.
The spacecraft consists of a command module and a service module.
Each software module performs a separate function in the system.
armA.mnemonic: كلمة 'Model' 'نموذج'.. الـ 'Module' هو جزء صغير أو نموذج مصغر من نظام كبير.

armB.definition: One of a set of parts that can be connected or combined to build or complete something.
armB.arabic: وحدة أو جزء مستقل من نظام أكبر، زي وحدة دراسية في كورس أو قطعة في جهاز.
examples: This is a key module.
The course has three modules.
We completed the first module of the training.
The spacecraft consists of a command module and a service module.
The software is built from independent modules.
Modular construction allows for rapid assembly of the units.
armB.mnemonic: كلمة 'Model' 'نموذج'.. الـ 'Module' هو جزء صغير أو نموذج مصغر من نظام كبير.

armA.definition: To watch and check a situation carefully for a period of time.
armA.arabic: تراقب وتتابع حاجة باستمرار عشان تتأكد إن كل حاجة تمام.
examples: Watch the dog.
The nurse monitors him.
We need to monitor the situation.
The government monitors internet activity.
Scientists are monitoring the volcano.
They monitored the transmission for any anomalies.
armA.mnemonic: نفس الاسم.. الفعل 'Monitor' يعني يقوم بدور المراقب.

armB.definition: To watch and check a situation carefully for a period of time.
armB.arabic: تراقب وتتابع حاجة باستمرار عشان تتأكد إن كل حاجة تمام.
examples: We need to monitor the situation.
Doctors will monitor your heart rate during the test.
Teachers should monitor student progress throughout the term.
armB.mnemonic: نفس الاسم.. الفعل 'Monitor' يعني يقوم بدور المراقب.

armA.definition: A small to medium-sized primate that typically has a long tail.
armA.arabic: قرد.. حيوان ذكي بيعيش في الشجر وبيحب الموز.
examples: The monkey eats a banana.
I saw a monkey at the zoo.
Monkeys can climb trees very fast.
Stop acting like a monkey!
The research involved studying the behavior of rhesus monkeys.
He decided to stop monkeying around and get to work.

armB.definition: A small to medium-sized primate that typically has a long tail.
armB.arabic: قرد.. حيوان ذكي بيعيش في الشجر وبيحب الموز.
examples: The monkey eats a banana.
I saw a monkey at the zoo.
A monkey can climb trees very fast.

armA.definition: The state of being subject to death; the number of deaths in a given time.
armA.arabic: كون الإنسان بيموت 'الفناء'، أو عدد الوفيات في مكان معين.
examples: Death is certain.
Doctors study diseases to stop mortality.
The war caused high mortality.
Infant mortality has decreased significantly.
We all have to face our own mortality one day.
The study analyzed mortality rates across different demographics.
armA.mnemonic: جاية من 'Mortal' يعني 'فانٍ'.. وكلمة 'Murder' 'قتل' قريبة منها في الصوت.. كله ليه علاقة بالموت.

armB.definition: The state of being subject to death; the number of deaths in a given time or group.
armB.arabic: كون الإنسان بيموت (الفناء)، أو عدد ونسبة الوفيات في مكان أو فترة معينة.
examples: We all have to face our own mortality one day.
Infant mortality has decreased significantly over the past decade.
The hospital reported a sudden rise in mortality among elderly patients.
armB.mnemonic: جاية من 'Mortal' يعني 'فانٍ'.. وكلمة 'Murder' 'قتل' قريبة منها في الصوت.. كله ليه علاقة بالموت.

armA.definition: A small mammal with a pointed snout and a long tail, or a handheld device used to control a cursor on a computer screen.
armA.arabic: الحيوان الثديي الصغير ذو الذيل الطويل (الفأر)، أو جهاز التحكم بمؤشر شاشة الكمبيوتر (الماوس).
examples: The cat saw a mouse.
Click the left mouse button.
My wireless mouse needs new batteries.
armA.mnemonic: بالعربي بنقول عليه 'ماوس' برضه لما نقصد بتاع الكمبيوتر.

armB.definition: A small animal with a long tail, or a device to control a computer.
armB.arabic: يا إما الحيوان الصغير 'الفار'، يا إما الماوس بتاع الكمبيوتر.
examples: The cat saw a mouse.
Click the left mouse button.
We have mice in the basement.
My wireless mouse needs new batteries.
She was as quiet as a mouse.
The laboratory mouse is a standard model for genetic research.
armB.mnemonic: بالعربي بنقول عليه 'ماوس' برضه لما نقصد بتاع الكمبيوتر.

armA.definition: The opening in the face used for eating and speaking.
armA.arabic: الفم اللي بناكل وبنتكلم بيه.
examples: Open your mouth.
She covered her mouth when she sneezed.
Don't talk with your mouth full.
armA.mnemonic: نطقها قريب من 'Mouse' 'فأر' بس بالثاء.. الـ 'Mouth' هو الفم.

armB.definition: The opening in the face used for eating and speaking.
armB.arabic: الفم اللي بناكل وبنتكلم بيه.
examples: Open your mouth.
She covered her mouth when she sneezed.
Don't talk with your mouth full.
We stood at the mouth of the cave.
The river mouth is wide and muddy.
He was merely a mouthpiece for the regime.
armB.mnemonic: نطقها قريب من 'Mouse' 'فأر' بس بالثاء.. الـ 'Mouth' هو الفم.

armA.definition: An informal British word for mother.
armA.arabic: ماما أو أمي (الكلمة الشائعة غير الرسمية للأم في الإنجليزية البريطانية).
examples: I called my mum to tell her the good news.
I help my mum at home every weekend.
She lives in London with her mum and dad.
armA.mnemonic: تشبه كلمة 'ماما'، وهي الكلمة اليومية الشائعة للأم في بريطانيا بدلاً من mom الأمريكية.

armB.definition: Mother (British informal).
armB.arabic: ماما 'باللهجة البريطانية'.
examples: My mum is nice.
I help my mum at home.
Mum, can I go out?
New mums need support.
Mum's the word (idiom meaning keep quiet).
She has to juggle her career with being a mum.
armB.mnemonic: زي 'ماما' بس دلع شوية.

armA.definition: A fungal growth that typically takes the form of a domed cap on a stalk.
armA.arabic: نوع من الفطريات بيتاكل وشكله زي الشمسية، وممكن ينمو بسرعة جداً.
examples: I like mushroom soup.
We picked a wild mushroom in the forest.
She added some sliced mushrooms to the pizza.
New cafes began to mushroom all over the city.
The atomic bomb created a massive mushroom cloud.
The town's population mushroomed after the discovery of oil.
armA.mnemonic: الكلمة فيها 'Room' 'غرفة'.. شكل الـ 'Mushroom' عامل زي 'Room' صغيرة للكائنات الدقيقة.

armB.definition: A fungal growth that typically takes the form of a domed cap on a stalk.
armB.arabic: فِطر (عيش الغراب) له ساق وقبعة مستديرة، وتؤكل بعض أنواعه.
examples: I like mushroom soup.
We picked a wild mushroom in the forest.
He found a large white mushroom under the tree.
armB.mnemonic: الكلمة فيها 'Room' 'غرفة'.. شكل الـ 'Mushroom' عامل زي 'Room' صغيرة للكائنات الدقيقة.

armA.definition: A word used to call a person, place, or thing.
armA.arabic: الكلمة اللي بننادي بيها على أي شخص أو حاجة عشان نميزهم عن غيرهم.
examples: My name is Sarah.
What is the name of this street?
Please write your name on the form.
armA.mnemonic: كلمة 'Name' قريبة من 'نيم'.. اكتب الـ 'Name' بتاعك عشان محدش ينساه وهو 'نايم'.

armB.definition: A word used to call a person, place, or thing.
armB.arabic: الكلمة اللي بننادي بيها على أي شخص أو حاجة عشان نميزهم عن غيرهم.
examples: My name is Sarah.
What is the name of this street?
He made a name for himself in the music industry.
They decided to name the baby after his grandfather.
She dropped a few famous names to impress us.
The victim, who cannot be named for legal reasons, was safe.
armB.mnemonic: كلمة 'Name' قريبة من 'نيم'.. اكتب الـ 'Name' بتاعك عشان محدش ينساه وهو 'نايم'.

armA.definition: To tell a story or describe events.
armA.arabic: يحكي قصة أو يسرد أحداث بترتيب معين.
examples: He can tell a story.
She likes to narrate her day.
The film is narrated by a famous actor.
He narrated the events of the accident clearly.
The author chooses to narrate from the child's perspective.
The documentary narrates the decline of the Roman Empire.
armA.mnemonic: الراوي اسمه 'Narrator'.. يبقى الفعل 'Narrate' يعني يقوم بدور الراوي ويحكي.

armB.definition: To tell a story or describe events.
armB.arabic: يحكي قصة أو يسرد أحداثاً بترتيب معين.
examples: The author chooses to narrate from the child's perspective.
She was invited to narrate the documentary about marine life.
He agreed to narrate the audio version of the novel.
armB.mnemonic: الراوي اسمه 'Narrator'.. يبقى الفعل 'Narrate' يعني يقوم بدور الراوي ويحكي.

armA.definition: A large body of people united by common descent, history, culture, or language, inhabiting a particular country.
armA.arabic: مجموعة كبيرة من الناس عايشين في بلد واحدة وبيجمعهم تاريخ ولغة مشتركة.
examples: The whole nation watched the game.
We are a proud nation.
The president spoke to the nation.
The United Nations helps countries work together.
The nation's economy is recovering.
Nationalism is a strong feeling of pride in one's nation.
armA.mnemonic: زي 'National' 'قومي'.. الـ 'Nation' هي الناس اللي بيجمعهم تاريخ وأرض واحدة.

armB.definition: A large body of people united by common descent, history, culture, or language, inhabiting a particular country.
armB.arabic: مجموعة كبيرة من الناس عايشين في بلد واحدة وبيجمعهم تاريخ ولغة مشتركة.
examples: The whole nation watched the game.
We are a proud nation.
The president spoke to the nation.
armB.mnemonic: زي 'National' 'قومي'.. الـ 'Nation' هي الناس اللي بيجمعهم تاريخ وأرض واحدة.

armA.definition: A strong feeling of pride in and devotion to one's country, often accompanied by the belief in its superiority or the desire for self-governance.
armA.arabic: القومية؛ الشعور القوي بالانتماء للوطن وتفضيل مصلحته، أو الرغبة في الاستقلال الوطني.
examples: The war increased feelings of nationalism.
The rise of extreme nationalism worries many leaders.
Nineteenth-century nationalism reshaped the map of Europe.
armA.mnemonic: جاية من كلمة nation (أمة/دولة)، واللاحقة -ism بتدل على الفكر أو المذهب، فيبقى nationalism هو فكر الانتماء للأمة والاعتزاز بيها (القومية).

armB.definition: A strong feeling of pride in and devotion to one's country.
armB.arabic: القومية أو الشعور القوي بالانتماء للوطن وتفضيل مصلحته على أي دولة تانية.
examples: He loves his country.
Nationalism is strong there.
The war increased feelings of nationalism.
Economic nationalism protects local industries.
The rise of extreme nationalism worries many leaders.
Nineteenth-century nationalism reshaped the map of Europe.
armB.mnemonic: جاية من 'Nation' 'أمة/وطن'.. فالـ 'Nationalism' هي حب الأمة.

armA.definition: The branch of a nation's armed services that conducts military operations at sea.
armA.arabic: القوات البحرية، الجيش اللي بيحارب في البحر بالسفن والغواصات.
examples: He joined the navy.
The navy has many big ships.
She bought a navy blue coat.
My grandfather served in the Royal Navy during the war.
The government announced cuts to the navy budget.
Naval supremacy was key to the empire's expansion.
armA.mnemonic: جاية من 'Navigate' يعني يُبحر.. الـ 'Navy' هي القوة اللي بتتحكم في البحر.

armB.definition: The branch of a nation's armed services that conducts military operations at sea.
armB.arabic: القوات البحرية، الجيش اللي بيحارب في البحر بالسفن والغواصات.
examples: He decided to join the navy after finishing his studies.
My grandfather served in the navy during the war.
The government announced cuts to the navy budget.
armB.mnemonic: جاية من 'Navigate' يعني يُبحر.. الـ 'Navy' هي القوة اللي بتتحكم في البحر.

armA.definition: A person living near or next door to you.
armA.arabic: الشخص الذي يعيش بالقرب منك أو في المنزل المجاور لك (جار).
examples: He is my neighbour.
I helped my neighbour carry her bags.
Our new neighbour moved in yesterday.
armA.mnemonic: تخيل أن جارك (neighbour) يربي حصاناً يصدر صوت صهيل (neigh) كل صباح.

armB.definition: A person living near or next door to the speaker or person referred to.
armB.arabic: جارك اللي ساكن جنبك في البيت أو في الشارع.
examples: He is my neighbour.
Our neighbours are very friendly.
I helped my neighbour carry her bags.
We're having a dispute with the neighbours about the fence.
Love thy neighbour as thyself.
The policy of good neighbourliness is essential for peace.
armB.mnemonic: جارك 'Neighbour' ممكن يكون عنده حصان بيعمل صوت 'Neigh'.

armA.definition: The cardinal number 19.
armA.arabic: العدد تسعة عشر.
examples: She is nineteen years old.
There are nineteen students in the classroom.
He scored nineteen points in the match.
armA.mnemonic: Nine + Teen.

armB.definition: The cardinal number 19.
armB.arabic: العدد تسعة عشر.
examples: I have nineteen dollars.
There are nineteen students.
He scored nineteen points.
Nineteen people applied for the job.
Talk nineteen to the dozen (speak very fast).
The phenomenon was first observed in the nineteenth century.
armB.mnemonic: Nine + Teen.

armA.definition: A negative answer or decision.
armA.arabic: الرفض أو كلمة 'لا' نفسها لما نستخدمها كاسم، زي لما تقول 'أخدت لا كبيرة'.
examples: The answer is no.
I won't take no for an answer.
It was a definite no from the boss.

armB.definition: A negative answer or decision.
armB.arabic: الرفض أو كلمة 'لا' نفسها لما نستخدمها كاسم، زي لما تقول 'أخدت لا كبيرة'.
examples: The answer is no.
There were two nos and three yeses.
I won't take no for an answer.
It was a definite no from the boss.
The noes have it (in a vote).
His response was a categorical no.
armB.mnemonic: كلمة 'No' سهلة.. نون وواو 'نو'.. يعني لأ.

armA.definition: No person; no one.
armA.arabic: محدش.. ولا أي شخص.
examples: Nobody came to the party.
There was nobody at the desk.
Nobody else can do this job.
armA.mnemonic: 'No' 'لا' + 'Body' 'جسم'.. يعني ولا حد.

armB.definition: No person; no one.
armB.arabic: محدش.. ولا أي شخص.
examples: Nobody knows.
Nobody came to the party.
There was nobody at the desk.
Nobody else can do this job.
It's nobody's business but mine.
Nobody, not even the experts, predicted the crash.
armB.mnemonic: 'No' 'لا' + 'Body' 'جسم'.. يعني ولا حد.

armA.definition: A conception of or belief about something.
armA.arabic: فكرة أو معتقد معين عن حاجة، وأحياناً بتبقى فكرة مش دقيقة أوي.
examples: He has a vague notion of the plan.
She rejected the notion that girls are weaker.
The whole notion of democracy is complex.
armA.mnemonic: كلمة 'Notion' قريبة من 'Lotion' 'لوشن'.. فكرة إنك تحط 'Lotion' دي مجرد 'Notion' 'فكرة' عشان ترطب بشرتك.

armB.definition: A conception of or belief about something.
armB.arabic: فكرة أو معتقد معين عن حاجة، وأحياناً بتبقى فكرة مش دقيقة أوي.
examples: Not typically used in A1 contexts.
I have no notion of what you mean.
He has a vague notion of the plan.
She rejected the notion that girls are weaker.
The whole notion of democracy is complex.
He challenged the prevailing notions of his time.
armB.mnemonic: كلمة 'Notion' قريبة من 'Lotion' 'لوشن'.. فكرة إنك تحط 'Lotion' دي مجرد 'Notion' 'فكرة' عشان ترطب بشرتك.

armA.definition: Famous or well known, typically for some bad quality or deed.
armA.arabic: شخص أو مكان مشهور ومعروف، بس بحاجه وحشة أو سمعة مش تمام.
examples: The city is notorious for its traffic jams.
He was a notorious criminal in the area.
The company is notorious for paying low wages.
armA.mnemonic: عكس 'Glorious' مجيد.. هو مشهور بس بـ 'Notes' وملاحظات سلبية في ملفه.

armB.definition: Famous or well known, typically for some bad quality or deed.
armB.arabic: شخص أو مكان مشهور ومعروف، بس بحاجه وحشة أو سمعة مش تمام.
examples: He is a bad man.
That street is dangerous and notorious.
The city is notorious for its traffic jams.
He was a notorious criminal in the area.
The company is notorious for paying low wages.
The dictator was notorious for his suppression of free speech.
armB.mnemonic: عكس 'Glorious' مجيد.. هو مشهور بس بـ 'Notes' وملاحظات سلبية في ملفه.

armA.definition: A long written story, usually about imaginary characters and events.
armA.arabic: قصة طويلة مكتوبة في كتاب، فيها شخصيات وأحداث وتفاصيل كتير.
examples: She is writing a novel.
The novel is set in 19th century London.
His latest novel explores themes of war.
armA.mnemonic: الـ 'Novel' يعني رواية.. افتكر 'Nobel'.. نجيب محفوظ خد جايزة 'Nobel' عشان بيكتب 'Novel'.

armB.definition: A fictitious prose narrative of book length.
armB.arabic: قصة طويلة مكتوبة في كتاب، فيها شخصيات وأحداث وتفاصيل كتير.
examples: I read a novel.
It is a famous novel.
She is writing a novel.
The novel is set in 19th century London.
His latest novel explores themes of war.
The novel's complex narrative structure challenges the reader.
armB.mnemonic: الـ 'Novel' يعني رواية.. افتكر 'Nobel'.. نجيب محفوظ خد جايزة 'Nobel' عشان بيكتب 'Novel'.

armA.definition: A person who writes novels (long fiction books).
armA.arabic: الكاتب اللي بيألف روايات وقصص طويلة.
examples: He is a writer.
She wants to be a novelist.
The novelist wrote a famous book.
Many novelists struggle to get published.
The celebrated novelist won a literary prize.
His style as a novelist is characterized by intricate plotting.
armA.mnemonic: جاية من 'Novel' 'رواية'.. اللي بيكتب 'Novel' يبقى 'Novelist'.

armB.definition: A person who writes novels (long fiction books).
armB.arabic: الكاتب اللي بيألف روايات وقصص طويلة.
examples: She wants to be a novelist.
The celebrated novelist won a literary prize.
His style as a novelist is characterized by intricate plotting.
armB.mnemonic: جاية من 'Novel' 'رواية'.. اللي بيكتب 'Novel' يبقى 'Novelist'.

armA.definition: A substance that plants, animals, and people need to live and grow.
armA.arabic: المادة المغذية 'زي الفيتامينات والمعادن' اللي الجسم محتاجها عشان يكبر ويعيش.
examples: Milk has good things for you.
Plants need nutrients from the soil.
Vegetables are full of essential nutrients.
A lack of nutrients can cause illness.
The soil is rich in organic nutrients.
Micro-nutrients are vital for metabolic processes.
armA.mnemonic: جاية من 'Nutrition' 'تغذية'.. الـ 'Nutrient' هو العنصر اللي بيغذي.

armB.definition: A substance that plants, animals, and people need to live and grow.
armB.arabic: المادة المغذية (مثل الفيتامينات والمعادن) التي يحتاجها الجسم لينمو ويعيش بصحة جيدة.
examples: Calcium is an essential nutrient for building strong bones and teeth.
The plant struggled to grow because the soil lacked a vital nutrient.
Iron is an important nutrient that helps transport oxygen in the blood.
armB.mnemonic: جاية من 'Nutrition' (تغذية).. الـ 'Nutrient' هو العنصر اللي بيغذي الجسم.

armA.definition: Different from what is usual or expected; strange.
armA.arabic: حاجة غريبة أو مش عادية، أو رقم فردي 'زي 1، 3، 5'.
examples: He has an odd name.
It is odd that he didn't call.
I found an odd sock under the bed.
The numbers 1, 3, and 5 are odd numbers.
She does odd jobs around the neighborhood for extra money.
Against all odds, they managed to survive the disaster.
armA.mnemonic: مش 'Add' يضيف.. دي 'Odd' يعني حاجة غريبة ومش راكبة على بعضها.

armB.definition: Different from what is usual or expected; strange.
armB.arabic: حاجة غريبة أو مش عادية، أو رقم فردي (زي 1، 3، 5).
examples: He has an odd name.
It is odd that he didn't call.
The numbers 1, 3, and 5 are odd numbers.
armB.mnemonic: مش 'Add' يضيف.. دي 'Odd' يعني حاجة غريبة ومش راكبة على بعضها.

armA.definition: A distinctive smell, especially an unpleasant one.
armA.arabic: ريحة مميزة، وغالباً بتكون ريحة مش حلوة أو نفاذة.
examples: A bad smell.
The flower has a strong odour.
There is a strange odour in the room.
Body odour can be prevented with deodorant.
The chemical released a pungent odour.
The distinctive odour of ozone filled the laboratory after the experiment.
armA.mnemonic: قريبة من 'Odorless' 'بدون رائحة'.. الـ 'Odour' هي الريحة نفسها. أو افتكر 'Oh dear' 'يا خبر' لما تشم ريحة وحشة 'Odour'.

armB.definition: A distinctive smell, especially an unpleasant one.
armB.arabic: ريحة مميزة، وغالباً بتكون ريحة مش حلوة أو نفاذة.
examples: There is a strange odour in the room.
The chemical released a pungent odour.
The distinctive odour of ozone filled the laboratory after the experiment.
armB.mnemonic: قريبة من 'Odorless' 'بدون رائحة'.. الـ 'Odour' هي الريحة نفسها. أو افتكر 'Oh dear' 'يا خبر' لما تشم ريحة وحشة 'Odour'.

armA.definition: Causing someone to feel deeply hurt, upset, or angry.
armA.arabic: مهين أو جارح.. كلام أو تصرف بيزعل الناس ويجرح مشاعرهم.
examples: I found his joke very offensive.
He made offensive remarks about her appearance.
The content was deemed offensive to community standards.
armA.mnemonic: عكس 'Defensive' 'دفاعي'.. الـ 'Offensive' هو اللي بيبدأ بالهجوم أو الإهانة.

armB.definition: Causing someone to feel deeply hurt, upset, or angry.
armB.arabic: مهين أو جارح.. كلام أو تصرف بيزعل الناس ويجرح مشاعرهم.
examples: That is a bad word.
His smell was offensive.
I found his joke very offensive.
He made offensive remarks about her appearance.
The army launched a major offensive operation.
The content was deemed offensive to community standards.
armB.mnemonic: عكس 'Defensive' 'دفاعي'.. الـ 'Offensive' هو اللي بيبدأ بالهجوم أو الإهانة.

armA.definition: To leave something out or not include it.
armA.arabic: يحذف حاجة أو يشيلها، سواء بقصد أو من غير قصد.
examples: You can omit the salt if you want.
Please omit my name from the list.
Be careful not to omit any crucial details from your report.
armA.mnemonic: كلمة 'Omit' شبه 'Commit'.. 'Don't commit if you're going to omit details' 'متلتزمش لو ناوي تحذف تفاصيل'.

armB.definition: To leave something out or not include it.
armB.arabic: يحذف حاجة أو يشيلها، سواء بقصد أو من غير قصد.
examples: Do not skip names.
He left out a page.
You can omit the salt if you want.
Please omit my name from the list.
She omitted to mention that she was married.
Significant details were omitted from the final report.
armB.mnemonic: كلمة 'Omit' شبه 'Commit'.. 'Don't commit if you're going to omit details' 'متلتزمش لو ناوي تحذف تفاصيل'.

armA.definition: Forward in time or space; continuing ahead.
armA.arabic: من الوقت ده وطالع (فصاعداً)، أو باتجاه الأمام.
examples: The agreement applies from June onwards.
They marched onwards despite the fatigue.
The records from the 18th century onwards are well preserved.
armA.mnemonic: فيها 'On' و 'Ward' 'اتجاه'.. يعني مكمل في الاتجاه ده 'Onwards'.

armB.definition: Moving forward in time or space.
armB.arabic: من الوقت ده وطالع، أو للأمام.
examples: Go forward.
We walked on.
From today onwards, I will exercise.
The agreement applies from June onwards.
They marched onwards despite the fatigue.
The records from the 18th century onwards are well preserved.
armB.mnemonic: فيها 'On' و 'Ward' 'اتجاه'.. يعني مكمل في الاتجاه ده 'Onwards'.

armA.definition: Someone who competes against or fights another in a contest, game, or argument.
armA.arabic: الخصم أو المنافس.. الشخص اللي بيلعب ضدك في ماتش أو بيعاديك في رأي.
examples: She beat her opponent easily.
Respect your opponent in sports.
He is a formidable opponent in the courtroom.
armA.mnemonic: كلمة 'Opponent' من 'Oppose' يعارض.. يعني الشخص اللي واقف 'Opposite' 'عكسك' في اللعبة.

armB.definition: Someone who competes against or fights another in a contest, game, or argument.
armB.arabic: الخصم أو المنافس.. الشخص اللي بيلعب ضدك في ماتش أو بيعاديك في رأي.
examples: He is my opponent in the game.
She beat her opponent easily.
Respect your opponent in sports.
The politician criticized his opponent's policies.
He is a formidable opponent in the courtroom.
They are vocal opponents of the new legislation.
armB.mnemonic: كلمة 'Opponent' من 'Oppose' يعارض.. يعني الشخص اللي واقف 'Opposite' 'عكسك' في اللعبة.

armA.definition: An individual animal, plant, or single-celled life form.
armA.arabic: الكائن الحي، سواء كان إنسان أو حيوان أو نبات أو حتى بكتيريا.
examples: Not used in A1.
Humans are organisms.
Bacteria are tiny organisms.
The pond is full of living organisms.
The social structure behaves like a living organism.
Genetically modified organisms (GMOs) are controversial.
armA.mnemonic: جاية من كلمة 'Organ' 'عضو'.. لأن الكائن الحي مكون من أعضاء.

armB.definition: An individual animal, plant, or single-celled life form.
armB.arabic: الكائن الحي، سواء كان إنسان أو حيوان أو نبات أو حتى بكتيريا.
examples: Every living organism needs water to survive.
An amoeba is a single-celled organism.
The social structure behaves like a living organism.
armB.mnemonic: جاية من كلمة 'Organ' 'عضو'.. لأن الكائن الحي مكون من أعضاء.

armA.definition: The relative position or direction of something, a person's general attitude or beliefs, or introductory training for a new job or activity.
armA.arabic: الاتجاه أو الموضع النسبي لشيء، أو التوجه الفكري والميول، أو التدريب والبرنامج التعريفي عند بدء وظيفة أو دراسة جديدة.
examples: The building has an east-west orientation.
I have orientation for my new job today.
Birds use magnetic fields for orientation during migration.
armA.mnemonic: الـ 'Orient' هو 'الشرق'.. زمان كانوا بيعرفوا الاتجاهات من الشرق.. فالـ 'Orientation' هو تحديد الاتجاه

armB.definition: The relative position or direction of something; or introduction/training for a new job.
armB.arabic: التوجيه أو الاتجاه. وممكن تيجي بمعنى التدريب التعريفي اللي بتاخده في أول شغل جديد.
examples: Which way is North?
The map shows the orientation.
I have orientation for my new job today.
The building has an east-west orientation.
The company's marketing orientation has shifted towards digital.
Birds use magnetic fields for orientation during migration.
armB.mnemonic: الـ 'Orient' هو 'الشرق'.. زمان كانوا بيعرفوا الاتجاهات من الشرق.. فالـ 'Orientation' هو تحديد الاتجاه

armA.definition: The point or place where something begins, arises, or is derived.
armA.arabic: أصل الشيء، أو المكان أو النقطة التي يبدأ منها أو ينشأ عنها.
examples: What is the origin of this fruit?
The word has a Latin origin.
They studied the origin of the universe.
armA.mnemonic: جاية من 'Original' 'أصلي'.. فالـ 'Origin' هو الأصل.

armB.definition: The point or place where something begins, arises, or is derived.
armB.arabic: أصل الشيء، أو المكان/الزمن اللي ابتدى منه.
examples: Not typically used in A1 contexts.
What is the origin of this fruit?
The word has a Latin origin.
They studied the origin of the universe.
The conflict is of obscure origin.
Darwin wrote 'On the Origin of Species'.
armB.mnemonic: جاية من 'Original' 'أصلي'.. فالـ 'Origin' هو الأصل.

armA.definition: To move repeatedly back and forth at a regular speed, or to continually vary between two states, opinions, or conditions.
armA.arabic: يتأرجح أو يتحرك ذهابًا وإيابًا بانتظام (مثل بندول الساعة)، أو يتذبذب ويتردد بين حالتين أو رأيين.
examples: The swing started to oscillate slowly.
His mood seems to oscillate between happy and sad.
The stock market tends to oscillate wildly during crises.
armA.mnemonic: زي المروحة الـ 'Oscillator' اللي بتلف يمين وشمال.. هي بتعمل 'Oscillate' 'تذبذب'.

armB.definition: To move back and forth at a regular speed.
armB.arabic: يتأرجح أو يتحرك رايح جاي بانتظام، زي بندول الساعة.
examples: The fan moves side to side.
The swing started to oscillate slowly.
The pendulum oscillates every second.
His mood seems to oscillate between happy and sad.
The stock market tends to oscillate wildly during crises.
The electron's position oscillates within the magnetic field.
armB.mnemonic: زي المروحة الـ 'Oscillator' اللي بتلف يمين وشمال.. هي بتعمل 'Oscillate' 'تذبذب'.

armA.definition: The other one; a different or additional person or thing.
armA.arabic: الواحد التاني. بنستخدمها لما نكون بنختار بين حاجتين أو أكتر ونشاور على التاني.
examples: I have two cats. One is black, the other is white.
One or the other must be correct.
He lifted one arm and then the other.

armB.definition: The other one; a different or additional person or thing.
armB.arabic: الواحد التاني. بنستخدمها لما نكون بنختار بين حاجتين أو أكتر ونشاور على التاني.
examples: I have two cats. One is black, the other is white.
Some people like tea, others prefer coffee.
One or the other must be correct.
Treat others as you would like to be treated.
He lifted one arm and then the other.
The twins are so alike that it is hard to tell one from the other.
armB.mnemonic: زي الـ 'Adjective' بالظبط.. 'Other' يعني التاني.

armA.definition: A sudden occurrence of something unwelcome, such as war or disease.
armA.arabic: تفشّي أو اندلاع؛ بداية مفاجئة لشيء غير مرغوب فيه كمرض أو حرب.
examples: The outbreak of war changed everything.
The government tried to contain the cholera outbreak.
Epidemiologists traced the source of the viral outbreak to a local market.
armA.mnemonic: 'Out' (بره) + 'Break' (كسر).. كأن المرض كسر الحواجز وخرج 'Out' وانتشر فجأة في كل مكان.

armB.definition: A sudden occurrence of something unwelcome, such as war or disease.
armB.arabic: تفشي أو اندلاع. لما حاجة وحشة زي مرض أو حرب تبدأ فجأة وتنتشر.
examples: The war started.
Everyone got sick suddenly.
Doctors are fighting the outbreak of the flu.
The outbreak of war changed everything.
The government tried to contain the cholera outbreak.
Epidemiologists traced the source of the viral outbreak to a local market.
armB.mnemonic: 'Out' 'بره' + 'Break' 'كسر'.. المرض كسر الحواجز وخرج 'Out' وانتشر في كل مكان

armA.definition: Extend over so as to cover partly.
armA.arabic: لما حاجتين يغطوا على بعض جزئياً، زي وقت الشغل لما يدخل في وقت الراحة.
examples: The roof tiles overlap to keep rain out.
Their responsibilities overlap, causing confusion in the department.
The historical eras overlap, making precise dating difficult.
armA.mnemonic: 'Over' فوق + 'Lap' حِجر.. كأن حاجة قعدت على 'Lap' التانية وغطتها.

armB.definition: Extend over so as to cover partly.
armB.arabic: لما حاجتين يغطوا على بعض جزئياً، زي وقت الشغل لما يدخل في وقت الراحة.
examples: The papers are on top of each other.
The roof tiles overlap to keep rain out.
My holiday overlaps with yours by two days.
There is some overlap between the two courses.
Their responsibilities overlap, causing confusion in the department.
The historical eras overlap, making precise dating difficult.
armB.mnemonic: 'Over' فوق + 'Lap' حِجر.. كأن حاجة قعدت على 'Lap' التانية وغطتها.

armA.definition: To catch up with and pass while traveling in the same direction.
armA.arabic: لما عربية تعدي عربية تانية وتسبقها.. أو لما تتفوق على حد في منافسة.
examples: Don't overtake on a bend.
The red car overtook the blue bus.
It's dangerous to overtake on this narrow road.
Germany overtook Japan in car production.
Panic began to overtake the crowd.
He was suddenly overtaken by a sense of impending doom.
armA.mnemonic: مكونة من 'Over' 'فوق/أمام' و 'Take' 'ياخد'.. يعني تاخد مكان قدامه وتسبقه.

armB.definition: To catch up with and pass someone or something while traveling in the same direction, or to become greater in number, amount, or success than a competitor.
armB.arabic: لما تعدي عربية تانية أو شخص وتسبقه، أو لما تتفوق على منافس في سباق أو عمل وتتخطاه.
examples: It is dangerous to overtake on this narrow road.
The company hopes to overtake its main rival in sales by next year.
Panic began to overtake the crowd.
armB.mnemonic: مكونة من 'over' (فوق / للأمام) و 'take' (يأخذ)؛ يعني تأخذ مكانًا أمامه وتسبقه.

armA.definition: A castrated bull used as a draft animal.
armA.arabic: الثور اللي بيستخدموه في الحقل لجر المحراث.
examples: The ox is a symbol of strength.
They roasted a whole ox for the feast.
The yoke was heavy on the neck of the ox.
armA.mnemonic: حيوان قوي بيجر المحراث.. كلمة قصيرة 'Ox' بس بتوصف حيوان ضخم.

armB.definition: A castrated bull used as a draft animal.
armB.arabic: الثور اللي بيستخدموه في الحقل لجر المحراث.
examples: The ox is big.
The ox pulls the cart.
Farmers use oxen to plow fields.
The ox is a symbol of strength.
They roasted a whole ox for the feast.
The yoke was heavy on the neck of the ox.
armB.mnemonic: حيوان قوي بيجر المحراث.. كلمة قصيرة 'Ox' بس بتوصف حيوان ضخم.

armA.definition: The inner surface of the hand, or a tropical tree with long leaves.
armA.arabic: ليها معنيين: يا إما كف الإيد من جوه، يا إما شجرة النخيل.
examples: Show me your palm.
There is a palm tree in the garden.
She read my fortune in my palm.
Coconut palms grow near the beach.
He held the secret in the palm of his hand.
The magician palmed the coin skillfully.
armA.mnemonic: حرف الـ L فيها سايلنت 'لا ينطق'، بتتنطق 'بام' زي صوت الخبطة بكف الإيد.

armB.definition: The inner surface of the hand between the wrist and the fingers, or a tropical tree with a crown of large leaves.
armB.arabic: ليها معنيين: يا إما كف الإيد من جوه (باطن اليد)، يا إما شجرة النخيل.
examples: He held the gold coin tightly in his palm.
She read my fortune in my palm.
We rested under the shade of a tall palm on the beach.
armB.mnemonic: حرف الـ L فيها سايلنت 'لا ينطق'، بتتنطق 'بام' زي صوت الخبطة بكف الإيد.

armA.definition: A father or mother.
armA.arabic: الأب أو الأم، الشخص المسئول عن تربية الأطفال.
examples: My parents are nice.
She lives with her parents.
Being a single parent is hard work.
The school invited the parents to a meeting.
The company was sold to its parent company.
Good parenting requires patience and consistency.
armA.mnemonic: الـ 'Parents' هما الـ 'Pair' 'الزوجين' اللي خلفوك.

armB.definition: A father or mother.
armB.arabic: الأب أو الأم، الشخص المسئول عن تربية الأطفال.
examples: Being a single parent is hard work.
Every parent wants to protect their child.
