As a parent, he spends a lot of time with his daughter.
armB.mnemonic: الـ 'Parents' هما الـ 'Pair' 'الزوجين' اللي خلفوك.

armA.definition: A group of people elected to make and change the laws of a country.
armA.arabic: المجلس التشريعي المنتخب لوضع وتعديل قوانين الدولة، مثل مجلس النواب أو الشعب.
examples: Parliament passed the new bill yesterday.
The dissolution of parliament triggered an election.
She wants to work in parliament.
armA.mnemonic: كلمة عالمية 'برلمان'.. المكان اللي بيتكلموا فيه 'Parler بالفرنسي يعني يتكلم'.

armB.definition: A group of people elected to make and change the laws of a country.
armB.arabic: المكان اللي فيه الناس اللي انتخبناهم عشان يحطوا القوانين ويغيروها، زي مجلس الشعب.
examples: The parliament makes laws.
She wants to work in parliament.
The members of parliament met today.
Parliament passed the new bill yesterday.
The dissolution of parliament triggered an election.
Parliamentary sovereignty is a cornerstone of the constitution.
armB.mnemonic: كلمة عالمية 'برلمان'.. المكان اللي بيتكلموا فيه 'Parler بالفرنسي يعني يتكلم'.

armA.definition: A word formed from a verb (e.g., 'going', 'gone') used as an adjective or to form verb tenses.
armA.arabic: مصطلح في القواعد، زي اسم الفاعل 'playing' أو اسم المفعول 'played' في الإنجليزي.
examples: Learn the verb forms.
Use the right participle.
The past participle of 'eat' is 'eaten'.
Adjectives often come from participles like 'boring' or 'bored'.
Dangling participles are a common grammatical error.
The perfect participle indicates an action completed before another.
armA.mnemonic: شبه كلمة 'Participate' 'يشارك'.. لأن الـ 'Participle' بيشارك صفات الفعل والاسم.

armB.definition: A word formed from a verb (e.g., 'going', 'gone') used as an adjective or to form verb tenses.
armB.arabic: مصطلح في القواعد، زي اسم الفاعل 'playing' أو اسم المفعول 'played' في الإنجليزي.
examples: The past participle of 'eat' is 'eaten'.
The perfect participle indicates an action completed before another.
Use the right participle.
armB.translations: اسم الفاعل أو المفعول نعت فعلي
armB.mnemonic: شبه كلمة 'Participate' 'يشارك'.. لأن الـ 'Participle' بيشارك صفات الفعل والاسم.

armA.definition: Having or expressing devotion to and vigorous support for one's country.
armA.arabic: شخص وطني وبيحب بلده جدًا ومستعد يدافع عنها، أو ما يعبّر عن حب الوطن والولاء له.
examples: People felt very patriotic during the Olympics.
Wearing the flag is a patriotic gesture.
The speech stirred patriotic fervor in the crowd.
armA.mnemonic: جاية من 'Patriot'.. يعني محب لوطنه

armB.definition: Having or expressing devotion to and vigorous support for one's country.
armB.arabic: شخص وطني وبيحب بلده جدًا ومستعد يدافع عنها
examples: He loves his country.
It is a patriotic song.
People felt very patriotic during the Olympics.
Wearing the flag is a patriotic gesture.
The speech stirred patriotic fervor in the crowd.
His motives were purely patriotic, not political.
armB.mnemonic: جاية من 'Patriot'.. يعني محب لوطنه

armA.definition: To give money for goods or services.
armA.arabic: تدفع فلوس عشان تشتري حاجة أو تسدد ديون.
examples: I pay for the food.
Can I pay by credit card?
He forgot to pay the electricity bill.
It pays to be honest in business.
We will have to pay the penalty for this delay.
The investment eventually paid huge dividends.
armA.mnemonic: عشان تشتري 'Buy' لازم تدفع 'Pay'.

armB.definition: To give money for goods or services.
armB.arabic: تدفع فلوس عشان تشتري حاجة أو تسدد ديون.
examples: I pay for the food.
Can I pay by credit card?
He forgot to pay the electricity bill.
armB.mnemonic: عشان تشتري 'Buy' لازم تدفع 'Pay'.

armA.definition: A person who is the same age or has the same social position or abilities as you.
armA.arabic: الشخص اللي زيك بالظبط، سواء في السن أو المقام أو الشغل. يعني زميلك أو نظيرك.
examples: He is my peer at school.
She wants to be liked by her peers.
Children often learn a lot from their peer group.
The article was subject to peer review before publication.
He was respected by his peers in the scientific community.
The peerage system in Britain is quite complex.
armA.mnemonic: كلمة 'Peer' قريبة من 'Pair' 'زوج'.. يعني انتوا اتنين زي بعض بالظبط.

armB.definition: A person who is the same age or has the same social position or abilities as you.
armB.arabic: الشخص اللي زيك بالظبط، سواء في السن أو المقام أو الشغل. يعني زميلك أو نظيرك.
examples: He is considered an intellectual peer by the top researchers in his field.
She found it easier to discuss her problems with a peer rather than an adult.
Each new employee is paired with an experienced peer who can offer advice and support.
armB.mnemonic: كلمة 'Peer' قريبة من 'Pair' 'زوج'.. يعني انتوا اتنين زي بعض بالظبط.

armA.definition: A thin wooden stick with a black or colored center used for writing or drawing.
armA.arabic: القلم الرصاص اللي بنكتب ونرسم بيه وممكن نمسحه بالأستيكة.
examples: I have a red pencil.
Can I borrow your pencil?
Sharpen your pencil before the test.
armA.mnemonic: شبه 'Pen' 'قلم' بس بنزود 'Cil'.. قلم رصاص يعني 'Pencil'.

armB.definition: A thin wooden stick with a black or colored center used for writing or drawing.
armB.arabic: القلم الرصاص اللي بنكتب ونرسم بيه وممكن نمسحه بالأستيكة.
examples: I have a red pencil.
Can I borrow your pencil?
Sharpen your pencil before the test.
The sketch was drawn in pencil.
He penciled in a meeting for next Tuesday.
The graphite core of the pencil varies in hardness.
armB.mnemonic: شبه 'Pen' 'قلم' بس بنزود 'Cil'.. قلم رصاص يعني 'Pencil'.

armA.definition: At an angle of 90 degrees to a line or surface.
armA.arabic: عمودي، يعني عامل زاوية 90 درجة 'قائمة' مع الأرض أو خط تاني.
examples: The wall is straight up.
Draw a line down the page.
The street is perpendicular to the beach.
Ensure the post is perpendicular to the ground.
The force acts in a direction perpendicular to the surface.
Perpendicular Gothic architecture emphasizes vertical lines.
armA.mnemonic: كلمة طويلة واقفة زي العمود.. 'Perpendicular' يعني عمودي.

armB.definition: At an angle of 90 degrees to a line or surface.
armB.arabic: عمودي، يعني عامل زاوية 90 درجة (قائمة) مع خط أو سطح آخر.
examples: The street is perpendicular to the beach.
Ensure the post is perpendicular to the ground.
The force acts in a direction perpendicular to the surface.
armB.mnemonic: كلمة طويلة واقفة زي العمود.. 'Perpendicular' يعني عمودي.

armA.definition: To carry out or commit a harmful, illegal, or immoral action.
armA.arabic: أن ترتكب أو تقترف جريمة أو عملاً ضاراً أو غير أخلاقي.
examples: Who would perpetrate such a terrible act?
A small group of conspirators planned to perpetrate fraud on a massive scale.
Security analysts warned that hostile actors could perpetrate cyberattacks against vital infrastructure.
armA.mnemonic: قريبة من 'Perpetual' 'دائم'.. المجرم بيعمل 'Perpetrate' لجرائم بتسيب أثر دائم.

armB.definition: To carry out or commit a harmful, illegal, or immoral action.
armB.arabic: إنك ترتكب جريمة أو تعمل مصيبة.
examples: He did a bad thing.
They perpetrate crimes.
Who would perpetrate such a terrible act?
The gang perpetrated a series of robberies.
Violence perpetrated against innocent civilians is unacceptable.
The fraud was perpetrated by a trusted employee over many years.
armB.mnemonic: قريبة من 'Perpetual' 'دائم'.. المجرم بيعمل 'Perpetrate' لجرائم بتسيب أثر دائم.

armA.definition: The action of persuading someone to do or believe something.
armA.arabic: فن إقناع الناس برأيك أو جعلهم يقومون بشيء معين بالكلام المقنع والمنطق.
examples: It took a lot of persuasion to get him to agree.
The power of persuasion is a key skill in sales.
She used persuasion to get what she wanted.
armA.mnemonic: الفعل 'Persuade'.. افتكر 'Pursue' يطارد.. بتفضل ورا الشخص لحد ما تقنعه.

armB.definition: The action of persuading someone to do or believe something.
armB.arabic: فن إقناع الناس برأيك أو إنهم يعملوا حاجة معينة بالكلام الحلو والمنطق.
examples: He is good at talking.
She used persuasion to get what she wanted.
It took a lot of persuasion to get him to agree.
The power of persuasion is a key skill in sales.
She has great powers of persuasion over the committee.
He is of a different political persuasion than his parents.
armB.mnemonic: الفعل 'Persuade'.. افتكر 'Pursue' يطارد.. بتفضل ورا الشخص لحد ما تقنعه.

armA.definition: To relate to or be connected with.
armA.arabic: يخص أو يتعلق بـ. بتستخدم لما تقول إن الموضوع ده يخص كذا.
examples: This is about you.
The rules pertain to everyone.
The documents pertain to the sale of the house.
We only discussed matters pertaining to the project.
The evidence does not pertain to the case at hand.
Issues pertaining to ethics are often complex.
armA.mnemonic: شبه 'Contain' بس دي 'Pertain'.. الموضوع ده بـ 'Pertain' ليك يعني يخصك.

armB.definition: To relate to or be connected with.
armB.arabic: يخص أو يتعلق بـ. بتستخدم لما تقول إن الموضوع ده يخص كذا.
examples: The rules pertain to everyone.
The documents pertain to the sale of the house.
The evidence does not pertain to the case at hand.
armB.mnemonic: شبه 'Contain' بس دي 'Pertain'.. الموضوع ده بـ 'Pertain' ليك يعني يخصك.

armA.definition: A person engaged or learned in philosophy, especially as an academic discipline.
armA.arabic: الفيلسوف، الشخص اللي بيفكر في أسئلة وجودية عميقة زي معنى الحياة والحقيقة.
examples: Plato was a philosopher.
The philosopher wrote many books about life.
As a moral philosopher, he debates ethics.
armA.mnemonic: هي كلمة 'فيلسوف' بالعربي.. جاية من 'Philosophy' 'فلسفة'.

armB.definition: A person engaged or learned in philosophy, especially as an academic discipline.
armB.arabic: الفيلسوف، الشخص اللي بيفكر في أسئلة وجودية عميقة زي معنى الحياة والحقيقة.
examples: Plato was a philosopher.
She wants to be a philosopher.
The philosopher wrote many books about life.
Greek philosophers asked questions about the universe.
As a moral philosopher, he debates ethics.
The philosopher's treatise challenged the prevailing ontological theories.
armB.mnemonic: هي كلمة 'فيلسوف' بالعربي.. جاية من 'Philosophy' 'فلسفة'.

armA.definition: A small group of words standing together as a conceptual unit.
armA.arabic: عبارة، يعني مجموعة كلمات جنب بعض بتدي معنى، بس مش جملة كاملة.
examples: Translate this phrase.
He used a funny phrase.
The phrase 'climate change' is common now.
armA.mnemonic: كلمة 'Phrase' قريبة من 'Fries'.. زي ما الـ 'Fries' بتيجي مجموعة صوابع، الـ 'Phrase' مجموعة كلمات.

armB.definition: A small group of words standing together as a conceptual unit.
armB.arabic: عبارة، يعني مجموعة كلمات جنب بعض بتدي معنى، بس مش جملة كاملة.
examples: A useful phrase.
Translate this phrase.
He used a funny phrase.
The phrase 'climate change' is common now.
She has a nice turn of phrase.
The legal phraseology was difficult to decipher.
armB.mnemonic: كلمة 'Phrase' قريبة من 'Fries'.. زي ما الـ 'Fries' بتيجي مجموعة صوابع، الـ 'Phrase' مجموعة كلمات.

armA.definition: A thin piece of metal with a sharp point at one end and a round head.
armA.arabic: الدبوس اللي بنستخدمه عشان نثبت الورق أو القماش.
examples: I need a pin for this paper.
She wore a pin on her jacket.
Be careful, the pin is sharp.
He removed the safety pin from the grenade.
The strategy hinges on this linchpin.
It was so quiet you could hear a pin drop.
armA.mnemonic: زي 'Pen' 'قلم' في النطق شوية بس أقصر.. الدبوس 'Pin' رفيع وبيشك.

armB.definition: A thin piece of metal with a sharp point at one end and a round head.
armB.arabic: الدبوس اللي بنستخدمه عشان نثبت الورق أو القماش.
examples: Be careful, the pin is sharp.
She used a pin to fasten the papers together.
It was so quiet you could hear a pin drop.
armB.mnemonic: زي 'Pen' 'قلم' في النطق شوية بس أقصر.. الدبوس 'Pin' رفيع وبيشك.

armA.definition: A person who brings a case against another in a court of law.
armA.arabic: الشخص اللي بيرفع قضية على حد تاني في المحكمة 'المدعي'.
examples: The burden of proof lies with the plaintiff.
The judge ruled in favor of the plaintiff after reviewing the evidence.
The lawyer advised the plaintiff to accept the settlement offer.
armA.mnemonic: جاية من 'Complain' 'يشتكي'.. الـ 'Plaintiff' هو اللي بيقدم الشكوى للمحكمة.

armB.definition: A person who brings a case against another in a court of law.
armB.arabic: الشخص اللي بيرفع قضية على حد تاني في المحكمة 'المدعي'.
examples: He went to court.
The man sued his boss.
The lawyer spoke for the accuser.
The plaintiff is asking for a lot of money.
The burden of proof lies with the plaintiff.
The plaintiff's counsel argued that the contract was breached.
armB.mnemonic: جاية من 'Complain' 'يشتكي'.. الـ 'Plaintiff' هو اللي بيقدم الشكوى للمحكمة.

armA.definition: A person who writes poems.
armA.arabic: الشخص الموهوب اللي بيكتب شعر وقصائد، وبيعرف يعبر عن مشاعره بكلام موزون وجميل.
examples: He is a famous poet.
Shakespeare is a well-known poet and playwright.
She dreams of becoming a published poet.
armA.mnemonic: الـ 'Poet' بيكتب 'Poetry'.. زي أحمد شوقي كده، فنان في الكلام والشعر.

armB.definition: A person who writes poems.
armB.arabic: الشخص الموهوب اللي بيكتب شعر وقصائد، وبيعرف يعبر عن مشاعره بكلام موزون وجميل.
examples: He is a famous poet.
The poet wrote about love.
Shakespeare is a well-known poet and playwright.
She dreams of becoming a published poet.
The poet's work explores themes of loss and redemption.
Critics hailed him as the most visionary poet of his generation.
armB.mnemonic: الـ 'Poet' بيكتب 'Poetry'.. زي أحمد شوقي كده، فنان في الكلام والشعر.

armA.definition: A person who is professionally involved in politics, especially as a holder of an elected office.
armA.arabic: الشخص اللي بيشتغل في السياسة زي الوزير أو عضو البرلمان.
examples: The politician gave a speech.
She wants to be a politician.
Politicians debate new laws in parliament.
He is a very popular local politician.
The scandal ruined the politician's career.
A shrewd politician knows how to manipulate public opinion.
armA.mnemonic: جاية من 'Politics' 'سياسة'.. والـ 'Politician' هو رجل السياسة.

armB.definition: A person who is professionally involved in politics, especially as a holder of an elected office.
armB.arabic: الشخص اللي بيشتغل في السياسة زي الوزير أو عضو البرلمان.
examples: The politician gave a speech.
She wants to be a politician.
He is a very popular local politician.
armB.mnemonic: جاية من 'Politics' 'سياسة'.. والـ 'Politician' هو رجل السياسة.

armA.definition: A small type of horse, often used for children to ride.
armA.arabic: حصان حجمه صغير، مش مُهر 'ابن الحصان' لكن هو نوع سلالته كده قصيرة، ولطيف جداً مع الأطفال.
examples: I want to ride a pony.
The pony is eating an apple.
She learned to ride on a small pony.
The children brushed the pony's hair gently.
Shetland ponies are known for their strength despite their size.
The equestrian center specializes in breeding pedigree ponies.
armA.mnemonic: كلمة 'Pony' قريبة من 'Bonny'.. يعني جميل وصغير، أو افتكر تسريحة شعر 'Ponytail' 'ذيل الحصان'.

armB.definition: A small type of horse, often used for children to ride.
armB.arabic: حصان حجمه صغير، مش مُهر 'ابن الحصان' لكن هو نوع سلالته كده قصيرة، ولطيف جداً مع الأطفال.
examples: She learned to ride on a small pony.
I want to ride a pony.
The pony is eating an apple.
armB.mnemonic: كلمة 'Pony' قريبة من 'Bonny'.. يعني جميل وصغير، أو افتكر تسريحة شعر 'Ponytail' 'ذيل الحصان'.

armA.definition: The state of having or owning something, or an item that is owned.
armA.arabic: امتلاك الشيء أو حيازته، أو الشيء نفسه الذي يمتلكه الشخص (مقتنى أو ممتلكات).
examples: The house is in his possession.
The team kept possession of the ball for most of the game.
The manuscript is the library's most prized possession.
armA.mnemonic: اربطها بكلمة 'Boss'.. الـ 'Boss' هو اللي عنده الـ 'Possession' والسيطرة على الشركة.

armB.definition: The state of having or owning something, or an item that is owned.
armB.arabic: امتلاك الشيء، أو الشيء نفسه اللي إنت بتمتلكه 'ممتلكات'.
examples: I have a book in my bag.
The house is in his possession.
She lost all her possessions in the fire.
The team kept possession of the ball for most of the game.
He was arrested for illegal possession of a weapon.
The manuscript is the library's most prized possession.
armB.mnemonic: اربطها بكلمة 'Boss'.. الـ 'Boss' هو اللي عنده الـ 'Possession' والسيطرة على الشركة.

armA.definition: A person who owns something or has a particular quality.
armA.arabic: الشخص الذي يملك شيئاً (مثل مال أو عقار) أو يتصف بميزة أو موهبة معينة؛ مالك أو صاحب.
examples: She is the proud possessor of a new home.
He was the possessor of a rare talent for music.
By law, the possessor of the land has certain rights.
armA.mnemonic: جاية من 'Possess' 'يملك'.. الـ 'Possessor' هو المالك.

armB.definition: A person who owns something or has a particular quality.
armB.arabic: الشخص اللي بيملك حاجة، سواء فلوس أو بيت أو حتى موهبة.
examples: He is the owner.
The possessor of the car must sign here.
She is the proud possessor of a new home.
The possessor of the ticket wins the prize.
He was the possessor of a rare talent for music.
By law, the possessor of the land has certain rights.
armB.mnemonic: جاية من 'Possess' 'يملك'.. الـ 'Possessor' هو المالك.

armA.definition: A thing suggested or assumed as true as the basis for reasoning.
armA.arabic: افتراض أو مُسلَّمة بنعتبرها صح عشان نبني عليها نظرية أو نقاش.
examples: It is an idea.
We start with this thought.
The theory is based on a simple postulate.
Euclid's postulates are famous in geometry.
We must accept this postulate to continue the argument.
The entire economic model rests on a flawed postulate.
armA.mnemonic: حاجة إنت بـ 'Post' 'بتحطها' كأساس للنقاش.

armB.definition: A thing suggested or assumed as true as the basis for reasoning.
armB.arabic: افتراض أو مُسلَّمة بنعتبرها صح عشان نبني عليها نظرية أو نقاش.
examples: The theory is based on a simple postulate.
We must accept this postulate to continue the argument.
The entire economic model rests on a flawed postulate.
armB.mnemonic: حاجة إنت بـ 'Post' 'بتحطها' كأساس للنقاش.

armA.definition: A unit of weight (16 oz) or the currency of the UK.
armA.arabic: وحدة ميزان 'الرطل'، أو عملة بريطانيا 'الجنيه الإسترليني'.
examples: It costs one pound.
I bought a pound of apples.
The pound is strong against the dollar.
He gained a few pounds over the holidays.
The dog was taken to the pound.
They pounded on the door with their fists.
armA.mnemonic: شبه 'Sound'.. صوت الـ 'Sound' بتاع العملة المعدنية وهي بتقع، ده صوت الـ 'Pound'.

armB.definition: A unit of weight (16 oz) or the currency of the UK.
armB.arabic: وحدة ميزان 'الرطل'، أو عملة بريطانيا 'الجنيه الإسترليني'.
examples: It costs one pound.
I bought a pound of apples.
The pound is strong against the dollar.
armB.mnemonic: شبه 'Sound'.. صوت الـ 'Sound' بتاع العملة المعدنية وهي بتقع، ده صوت الـ 'Pound'.

armA.definition: Dealing with things sensibly and realistically based on practical considerations.
armA.arabic: عملي وواقعي، بيفكر في الحلول اللي تنفع تتنفذ وتجيب نتيجة مش بس نظريات وأحلام.
examples: Not used in A1.
We need a pragmatic plan.
He is a pragmatic man who solves problems quickly.
We need to take a pragmatic approach to this issue.
The party adopted a more pragmatic stance on taxation.
Her pragmatic philosophy allowed her to navigate the complex political landscape.
armA.mnemonic: شبه 'Program'.. الشخص الـ 'Pragmatic' ماشي بنظام وخطوات عملية زي الـ 'Program'.

armB.definition: Dealing with things sensibly and realistically based on practical considerations.
armB.arabic: عملي وواقعي، بيفكر في الحلول اللي تنفع تتنفذ وتجيب نتيجة مش بس نظريات وأحلام.
examples: We need to take a pragmatic approach to this issue.
The party adopted a more pragmatic stance on taxation.
He is a pragmatic man who solves problems quickly.
armB.mnemonic: شبه 'Program'.. الشخص الـ 'Pragmatic' ماشي بنظام وخطوات عملية زي الـ 'Program'.

armA.definition: A measure taken in advance to prevent something dangerous or unpleasant.
armA.arabic: إجراء بتاخده بدري عشان تمنع أي مشكلة أو خطر ممكن يحصل.
examples: As a precaution, I locked the door before leaving the house.
The team took every precaution to ensure the laboratory was safe.
Wearing a seatbelt is a simple precaution that can save your life.
armA.mnemonic: جاية من 'Caution' 'حذر'.. و 'Pre' 'قبل'.. يعني بتاخد حذرك من قبل ما المشكلة تحصل.

armB.definition: A measure taken in advance to prevent something dangerous or unpleasant.
armB.arabic: إجراء بتاخده بدري عشان تمنع أي مشكلة أو خطر ممكن يحصل.
examples: Take precaution.
Safety is a good precaution.
We took every precaution to be safe.
As a precaution, I locked the door.
You must take precautions against fire.
The evacuation was purely a precautionary measure.
armB.mnemonic: جاية من 'Caution' 'حذر'.. و 'Pre' 'قبل'.. يعني بتاخد حذرك من قبل ما المشكلة تحصل.

armA.definition: An earlier event or action that is regarded as an example or guide for similar situations.
armA.arabic: حدث سابق بيتاخد كمثال أو قاعدة نمشي عليها بعد كده، خصوصاً في القانون.
examples: This is a new thing.
It never happened before like this.
This decision sets a bad precedent for the future.
There is no historical precedent for this crisis.
The judge's ruling established a legal precedent.
Breaking with precedent, the committee voted to release the confidential files.
armA.mnemonic: نفس فكرة 'Pre'.. دي 'السابقة' اللي بنقيس عليها أي حاجة جديدة.

armB.definition: An earlier event or action that is regarded as an example or guide for similar situations.
armB.arabic: حدث سابق بيتاخد كمثال أو قاعدة نمشي عليها بعد كده، خصوصاً في القانون.
examples: The judge's ruling established a legal precedent.
There is no historical precedent for this crisis.
This decision sets a bad precedent for the future.
armB.mnemonic: نفس فكرة 'Pre'.. دي 'السابقة' اللي بنقيس عليها أي حاجة جديدة.

armA.definition: Done, made, or acting suddenly or without careful consideration.
armA.arabic: لما تاخد قرار بسرعة من غير تفكير، بيبقى قرار متهور.
examples: It was a quick decision.
Please do not be too hasty.
His precipitate action caused a lot of trouble.
We must avoid any precipitate decisions.
The precipitate withdrawal of troops led to chaos.
Such precipitate behavior is unbecoming of a diplomat.
armA.mnemonic: قريبة من 'Precipitation' 'هطول المطر'.. زي المطر لما ينزل فجأة، القرار الـ 'Precipitate' بيجي بسرعة ومن غير تفكير.

armB.definition: Done, made, or acting suddenly or without careful consideration.
armB.arabic: لما تاخد قرار أو تصرف بسرعة من غير تفكير، بيبقى تصرف متهور أو متسرع.
examples: His precipitate action caused a lot of trouble.
We must avoid any precipitate decisions.
The precipitate withdrawal of troops led to chaos.
armB.mnemonic: قريبة من 'Precipitation' 'هطول المطر'.. زي المطر لما ينزل فجأة، القرار الـ 'Precipitate' بيجي بسرعة ومن غير تفكير.

armA.definition: An idea or theory on which a statement or action is based.
armA.arabic: فكرة أساسية أو فرضية بتبني عليها كلامك أو خطتك.
examples: The idea is simple.
We started with a basic plan.
His argument is based on a false idea.
The whole movie is based on a strange premise.
The premise of the debate was that all people are equal.
If we accept the major premise, the conclusion follows inevitably.
armA.mnemonic: قريبة من كلمة 'Promise' في النطق، بس المعنى مختلف.. الـ 'Premise' هو الوعد المنطقي اللي بتبني عليه النتيجة.

armB.definition: An idea or theory on which a statement or action is based.
armB.arabic: فكرة أساسية أو فرضية بتبني عليها كلامك أو خطتك.
examples: The whole movie is based on a strange premise.
The premise of the debate was that all people are equal.
If we accept the major premise, the conclusion follows inevitably.
armB.mnemonic: قريبة من كلمة 'Promise' في النطق، بس المعنى مختلف.. الـ 'Premise' هو الوعد المنطقي اللي بتبني عليه النتيجة.

armA.definition: The office, function, or term of a president.
armA.arabic: الفترة اللي بيحكم فيها الرئيس، أو المنصب نفسه بتاع رئيس الجمهورية أو الشركة.
examples: He wants to be president.
The presidency is a big job.
During his presidency, many laws were changed.
She is a candidate for the presidency.
The presidency of the European Union rotates every six months.
Historians are re-evaluating the impact of his presidency.
armA.mnemonic: من 'President' 'رئيس'.. الفترة أو المنصب اللي بياخده الرئيس.

armB.definition: The office, function, or term of a president.
armB.arabic: الفترة اللي بيحكم فيها الرئيس، أو المنصب نفسه بتاع رئيس الجمهورية أو الشركة.
examples: During his presidency, many laws were changed.
She is a candidate for the presidency.
Historians are re-evaluating the impact of his presidency.
armB.mnemonic: من 'President' 'رئيس'.. الفترة أو المنصب اللي بياخده الرئيس.

armA.definition: The son of a king or queen, or a male member of a royal family.
armA.arabic: أمير؛ ابن الملك أو الملكة، أو عضو ذكر من العائلة المالكة.
examples: The prince lives in a castle.
The crown prince is next in line to the throne.
He acted like a charming prince.
armA.mnemonic: كلمة 'Prince' سهلة.. افتكر 'Princess' 'أميرة' والـ 'Prince' 'أمير'.

armB.definition: The son of a king or queen.
armB.arabic: الأمير، ابن الملك أو الملكة.
examples: The prince lives in a castle.
The prince married the girl.
Prince William visited the school.
He acted like a charming prince.
Machiavelli wrote a book called 'The Prince'.
The crown prince is next in line to the throne.
armB.mnemonic: كلمة 'Prince' سهلة.. افتكر 'Princess' 'أميرة' والـ 'Prince' 'أمير'.

armA.definition: The person with the highest authority (e.g., school head); or the original sum of money invested.
armA.arabic: مدير المدرسة أو الشخص المسؤول، وممكن تيجي بمعنى رأس المال الأصلي في البنك.
examples: The school principal is nice.
I was sent to the principal's office.
The principal announced the new rules.
You must pay back the principal plus interest.
The principals in the deal met to sign the contract.
The bond guarantees the return of the principal upon maturity.
armA.mnemonic: الـ 'Prince' الأمير هو الـ 'Principal' يعني الريس أو المدير.

armB.definition: The person with the highest authority in an organization or school; or an original sum of money invested or lent, distinguished from interest.
armB.arabic: مدير المدرسة أو الشخص المسؤول؛ وتأتي أيضاً في السياق المالي بمعنى رأس المال الأصلي المقترض أو المستثمر (دون الفوائد).
examples: The principal announced the new rules.
You must pay back the principal plus interest.
The bond guarantees the return of the principal upon maturity.
armB.translations: مدير مدرسة شخص مسؤول رأس المال
armB.mnemonic: الـ 'Prince' الأمير هو الـ 'Principal' يعني الريس أو المدير.

armA.definition: A thing given as a reward to the winner of a competition.
armA.arabic: المكافأة أو الهدية اللي بتاخدها لما تكسب في مسابقة أو تعمل إنجاز.
examples: She won the first prize.
The prize was a new car.
He received a cash prize for his essay.
armA.mnemonic: كلمة 'Prize' 'جائزة' شبه 'Price' 'سعر'.. بس الـ 'Prize' قيمتها المعنوية أغلى من أي 'Price'.

armB.definition: A thing given as a reward to the winner of a competition.
armB.arabic: المكافأة أو الهدية اللي بتاخدها لما تكسب في مسابقة أو تعمل إنجاز.
examples: She won the first prize.
The prize was a new car.
He received a cash prize for his essay.
The Nobel Prize is famous worldwide.
The painting is a prized possession of the museum.
They prized the box open with a tool (verb usage).
armB.mnemonic: كلمة 'Prize' 'جائزة' شبه 'Price' 'سعر'.. بس الـ 'Prize' قيمتها المعنوية أغلى من أي 'Price'.

armA.definition: An official public announcement or declaration; a proclamation.
armA.arabic: إعلان رسمي أو بيان عام يُوجَّه إلى الناس والجمهور.
examples: The king issued a royal proclaim granting amnesty to the prisoners.
The council read a public proclaim before the citizens gathered in the square.
The governor signed a formal proclaim to establish the annual holiday.
armA.mnemonic: الـ 'Pro' 'الشخص المحترف' بيعمل 'Claim' 'ادعاء' بصوت عالي.. ده 'Proclaim' 'إعلان'.

armB.definition: To announce something publicly or officially.
armB.arabic: يعلن حاجة بشكل رسمي أو قدام الناس كلها.
examples: He will proclaim the winner.
They proclaim peace.
The president proclaimed a holiday.
She proclaimed her innocence to everyone.
The manifesto proclaimed a new era of freedom.
He was proclaimed King after the victory.
armB.mnemonic: الـ 'Pro' 'الشخص المحترف' بيعمل 'Claim' 'ادعاء' بصوت عالي.. ده 'Proclaim' 'إعلان'.

armA.definition: An estimate of a future situation; or an image shown on a screen.
armA.arabic: توقع للمستقبل، أو عرض صورة على شاشة 'إسقاط ضوئي'.
examples: Look at the picture on the wall.
The movie projection started late.
The map uses a special projection.
Sales projections for next year look good.
Population projections indicate a decline in growth.
Psychological projection is a defense mechanism.
armA.mnemonic: جاية من 'Project' 'مشروع' أو 'يعرض'.. الـ 'Projection' هو عرض الصورة أو عرض توقعاتك للمستقبل.

armB.definition: An estimate or forecast of a future situation based on current trends, or the act of casting an image onto a surface.
armB.arabic: تَقْدِير أو تَوَقُّع لموقف مستقبلي بناءً على المعطيات الحالية، أو عَرْض صورة على شاشة (إسقاط ضوئي).
examples: The company's financial projection indicates steady revenue growth over the next five years.
The movie projection started late due to a technical glitch in the booth.
Psychological projection is a defense mechanism where people blame others for their own insecurities.
armB.mnemonic: جاية من 'Project' 'مشروع' أو 'يعرض'.. الـ 'Projection' هو عرض الصورة أو عرض توقعاتك للمستقبل.

armA.definition: Acting with or showing care and thought for the future.
armA.arabic: يعني حكيم وعاقل.. بيفكر كويس قبل ما ياخد قرار
examples: Be careful with money.
It is good to save money.
It is prudent to save some of your salary.
A prudent decision helped the company survive.
It would be prudent to consult a lawyer before signing.
The government followed a prudent fiscal policy.
armA.mnemonic: الشخص الـ 'Prudent' مش 'Rude'.. هو عاقل وحكيم وبيفكر قبل ما يتصرف

armB.definition: Acting with or showing care and thought for the future.
armB.arabic: يعني حكيم وعاقل.. بيفكر كويس قبل ما ياخد قرار
examples: It would be prudent to consult a lawyer before signing.
The government followed a prudent fiscal policy.
A prudent decision helped the company survive.
armB.mnemonic: الشخص الـ 'Prudent' مش 'Rude'.. هو عاقل وحكيم وبيفكر قبل ما يتصرف

armA.definition: A small animal with long ears and soft fur that lives in a hole in the ground.
armA.arabic: الأرنب، الحيوان المعروف بودانه الطويلة والفرو الناعم.
examples: The rabbit eats a carrot.
I have a pet rabbit.
The magician pulled a rabbit out of the hat.
Wild rabbits can damage crops.
He rabbited on about his problems (slang).
The dog chased the rabbit into its burrow.
armA.mnemonic: كلمة 'Rabbit' قريبة من 'Robot'.. تخيل 'Robot' على شكل أرنب.

armB.definition: A small animal with long ears and soft fur that lives in a hole in the ground.
armB.arabic: الأرنب، الحيوان المعروف بودانه الطويلة والفرو الناعم.
examples: I have a pet rabbit.
The magician pulled a rabbit out of the hat.
The dog chased the rabbit into its burrow.
armB.mnemonic: كلمة 'Rabbit' قريبة من 'Robot'.. تخيل 'Robot' على شكل أرنب.

armA.definition: The distance from the center of a circle to its edge.
armA.arabic: المسافة من نص الدايرة لحد الحرف بتاعها، أو المنطقة اللي حوالين مكان معين في حدود مسافة محددة.
examples: Draw a circle.
Measure the radius.
The police searched within a five-mile radius.
The radius of the wheel is 10 inches.
They deliver within a ten-mile radius of the store.
The explosion affected everything within a 500-meter radius.
armA.mnemonic: قريبة من 'Radio' 'راديو'.. إشارة الـ 'Radio' بتغطي 'Radius' مسافة معينة حوالين المحطة.

armB.definition: The distance from the center of a circle to its edge, or a circular area of a specified distance around a central point.
armB.arabic: المسافة من نص الدايرة لحد الحرف بتاعها (نصف القطر)، أو المنطقة الدائرية اللي حوالين مكان معين في حدود مسافة محددة.
examples: The radius of the wheel is 10 inches.
The police searched within a five-mile radius.
They deliver within a ten-mile radius of the store.
armB.mnemonic: قريبة من 'Radio' 'راديو'.. إشارة الـ 'Radio' بتغطي 'Radius' مسافة معينة حوالين المحطة.

armA.definition: Violent, uncontrollable anger.
armA.arabic: الغضب الشديد جداً الذي يفقد فيه الشخص السيطرة على أعصابه وتصرفاته.
examples: Her face turned red with rage.
He flew into a rage when he saw the damage.
His speech was fueled by a righteous rage against injustice.
armA.mnemonic: قريبة في النطق من كلمة 'Red' (أحمر)؛ تذكر أن وجه الشخص في حالة 'rage' يصبح أحمر من شدة الغضب.

armB.definition: Violent, uncontrollable anger.
armB.arabic: الغضب الشديد جداً اللي الواحد بيفقد فيه السيطرة على أعصابه.
examples: He was full of rage.
Her face turned red with rage.
Road rage is a serious problem.
He flew into a rage when he saw the damage.
The storm raged for three days.
His speech was fueled by a righteous rage against injustice.
armB.mnemonic: قريبة من 'Red' 'أحمر'.. لما الواحد يبقى في حالة 'Rage' وشه بيحمر من الغضب

armA.definition: To force someone to have sex against their will.
armA.arabic: يغتصب، يعني يعتدي على حد جنسياً بالقوة.
examples: Not used in A1.
Not used in A2.
He tried to rape her.
Soldiers were accused of raping civilians.
The country was raped of its natural resources.
The invaders pillaged and raped as they advanced.

armB.definition: To force someone to have sex against their will.
armB.arabic: يغتصب؛ أي يعتدي على شخص جنسياً بالإكراه ودون موافقته.
examples: He was convicted of attempting to rape a student.
Under the law, it is a severe crime to rape someone.
The commander warned the soldiers not to rape or loot in captured territory.

armA.definition: An instrument with a sharp blade or combination of blades, used to remove unwanted hair.
armA.arabic: الموس أو الماكينة اللي بنستخدمها عشان نحلق الشعر.
examples: He uses a razor.
I bought a new razor.
Be careful, the razor is sharp.
He cut himself with the razor while shaving.
Occam's razor is a philosophical principle.
The debate was balanced on a razor's edge.
armA.mnemonic: الـ 'Razor' بتعمل 'Raise' 'إزالة' للشعر من جدره.

armB.definition: An instrument with a sharp blade or combination of blades, used to remove unwanted hair.
armB.arabic: أداة ذات شفرة حادة أو مجموعة شفرات تُستخدم لحلاقة وإزالة الشعر (موس أو ماكينة حلاقة).
examples: Be careful, the razor is sharp.
He cut himself with the razor while shaving.
I bought a new razor.
armB.mnemonic: صوت كلمة razor يشبه كلمة erase (يمسح)؛ تذكر أن الـ razor يمسح الشعر ويزيله تماماً.

armA.definition: A rule or directive made and maintained by an authority.
armA.arabic: القاعدة أو القانون اللي بتحطه الحكومة أو الإدارة عشان تنظم الأمور.
examples: Follow the rule.
School regulations are strict.
Safety regulations must be obeyed.
The new government regulations affect small businesses.
Compliance with environmental regulations is mandatory.
The deregulation of the market removed many old regulations.
armA.mnemonic: جاية من 'Regular'.. الـ 'Regulation' هي القوانين اللي بتخلي الأمور تمشي بشكل 'Regular' 'منتظم'

armB.definition: A rule or directive made and maintained by an authority.
armB.arabic: القاعدة أو القانون اللي بتحطه الحكومة أو الإدارة عشان تنظم الأمور.
examples: The new safety regulation requires all factory workers to wear protective gear.
Under current banking regulation, institutions must report large international transfers.
The airline was fined for violating a federal aviation regulation.
armB.mnemonic: جاية من 'Regular'.. الـ 'Regulation' هي القوانين اللي بتخلي الأمور تمشي بشكل 'Regular' 'منتظم'

armA.definition: To feel or show great joy or delight.
armA.arabic: إنك تفرح جداً وتبتهج بحاجة حلوة حصلت.
examples: We are happy.
They smiled with joy.
Everyone rejoiced at the good news.
The whole country rejoiced when the war ended.
I rejoice to see you looking so well.
We rejoice in the triumph of truth over falsehood.
armA.mnemonic: 'Re' + 'Joy' 'فرحة'.. 'Rejoice' يعني تعيش الـ 'Joy' 'الفرحة'.

armB.definition: To feel or show great joy or delight.
armB.arabic: إنك تفرح جداً وتبتهج بحاجة حلوة حصلت.
examples: I rejoice to see you looking so well.
We rejoice in the triumph of truth over falsehood.
They rejoice at every small victory achieved by the team.
armB.mnemonic: 'Re' + 'Joy' (فرحة) — تذكّر أن كلمة rejoice تعني أن تشعر بالفرح والبهجة (joy).

armA.definition: A feeling of reassurance and relaxation following release from anxiety or distress.
armA.arabic: الشعور بالراحة والاطمئنان بعد ما كان فيه قلق أو وجع وراح.
examples: I feel good now.
It is a relief to be home.
The medicine gave him some relief from the pain.
It was a huge relief to hear that they were safe.
The organization provides famine relief in war zones.
The comic scenes provided some necessary light relief in the tragedy.
armA.mnemonic: شبه 'Leaf' 'ورقة شجر'.. تخيل إنك في الصحراء ولقيت شجرة، ضلها هيديك 'Relief' 'راحة' من الشمس

armB.definition: A feeling of reassurance and relaxation following release from anxiety or distress.
armB.arabic: الشعور بالراحة والاطمئنان بعد ما كان فيه قلق أو وجع وراح.
examples: It was a huge relief to hear that they were safe.
The medicine gave him some relief from the pain.
The organization provides famine relief in war zones.
armB.mnemonic: شبه 'Leaf' 'ورقة شجر'.. تخيل إنك في الصحراء ولقيت شجرة، ضلها هيديك 'Relief' 'راحة' من الشمس

armA.definition: To voluntarily give up or let go of something.
armA.arabic: يعني تتنازل عن حاجة أو تسيبها بمزاجك.. زي السلطة أو حق ليك
examples: He was forced to relinquish control of the company.
She refused to relinquish her claim to the property.
He had to relinquish his grip on the railing to jump safely.
armA.mnemonic: اربطها بـ 'Release'.. إنك تسيب الحاجة وتتخلى عنها

armB.definition: To voluntarily give up or let go of something.
armB.arabic: يعني تتنازل عن حاجة أو تسيبها بمزاجك.. زي السلطة أو حق ليك
examples: He gave up his seat.
She let go of the bag.
The king gave up his throne.
He was forced to relinquish control of the company.
She refused to relinquish her claim to the property.
He relinquished his grip on the rope and fell.
armB.mnemonic: اربطها بـ 'Release'.. إنك تسيب الحاجة وتتخلى عنها

armA.definition: A successful way of curing an illness or dealing with a problem.
armA.arabic: علاج لمرض أو حل لمشكلة بتواجهك.
examples: Sleep is a good help.
Tea with honey is a home remedy.
We need to find a remedy for this mistake.
There is no simple remedy for unemployment.
Herbal remedies are becoming popular again.
The contract provides a legal remedy for breach of terms.
armA.mnemonic: شبه كلمة 'Ramada'.. تخيل إنك رايح فندق رمادا كـ 'Remedy' 'علاج' للاستجمام.

armB.definition: A successful way of curing an illness or dealing with a problem.
armB.arabic: علاج لمرض أو حل لمشكلة بتواجهك.
examples: Tea with honey is a home remedy.
There is no simple remedy for unemployment.
The contract provides a legal remedy for breach of terms.
armB.mnemonic: شبه كلمة 'Ramada'.. تخيل إنك رايح فندق رمادا كـ 'Remedy' 'علاج' للاستجمام.

armA.definition: Situated far from the main centers of population; distant.
armA.arabic: مكان بعيد ومنعزل، أو التحكم عن بعد 'زي الريموت'.
examples: They live in a remote village.
There is a remote chance of winning.
Where is the remote control?
armA.mnemonic: الـ 'Remote' كنترول بيخليك تتحكم في التلفزيون وإنت 'Remote' 'بعيد' عنه.

armB.definition: Situated far from the main centers of population; distant.
armB.arabic: مكان بعيد ومنعزل، أو التحكم عن بعد 'زي الريموت'.
examples: Where is the remote control?
They live in a remote village.
I work remotely from home.
There is a remote chance of winning.
The concept seemed remote from reality.
Accessing remote servers requires secure authentication.
armB.mnemonic: الـ 'Remote' كنترول بيخليك تتحكم في التلفزيون وإنت 'Remote' 'بعيد' عنه.

armA.definition: A severe or formal rebuke or disapproval.
armA.arabic: توبيخ شديد ورسمي، زي لما مدير يهزأ موظف عشان غلطة كبيرة.
examples: She received a written reprimand from her boss.
The committee issued a formal reprimand to the member.
He faced a severe reprimand for his bad behavior.

armB.definition: A severe or formal rebuke or disapproval.
armB.arabic: توبيخ شديد ورسمي، زي لما مدير يهزأ موظف عشان غلطة كبيرة.
examples: He got a scolding.
The teacher gave him a reprimand.
She received a written reprimand from her boss.
He faced a severe reprimand for his bad behavior.
The committee issued a formal reprimand to the member.
His career ended after a public reprimand for misconduct.

armA.definition: A state in which supreme power is held by the people and their elected representatives, rather than by a monarch.
armA.arabic: دولة نظام الحكم فيها جمهوري، يعني الشعب بيختار الرئيس والممثلين بتوعه، مش ملكية.
examples: The president of the republic gave a speech.
They fought to establish a republic.
The transition from monarchy to republic was bloody.
armA.mnemonic: زي 'Republic'.. 'جمهورية'.. 'Public' يعني عامة الشعب، فالـ 'Republic' حكم الشعب.

armB.definition: A state in which supreme power is held by the people and their elected representatives.
armB.arabic: دولة نظام الحكم فيها جمهوري، يعني الشعب بيختار الرئيس والممثلين بتوعه، مش ملكية.
examples: I live in a republic.
France is a republic.
The president of the republic gave a speech.
They fought to establish a republic.
The transition from monarchy to republic was bloody.
Plato's 'Republic' explores the definition of justice.
armB.mnemonic: زي 'Republic'.. 'جمهورية'.. 'Public' يعني عامة الشعب، فالـ 'Republic' حكم الشعب.

armA.definition: Bitter indignation at having been treated unfairly.
armA.arabic: استياء أو مرارة.. شعور بالزعل المكتوم عشان حاسس إنك اتظلمت.
examples: Her resentment towards her boss grew every day.
The decision caused deep resentment among the staff.
He harbored a lingering resentment over the way he was dismissed.
armA.mnemonic: 'Re' 'تاني' + 'Sent' 'أرسل'.. كأن المشاعر السلبية بتتبعتلك تاني وتاني فبتحس بـ 'Resentment'.

armB.definition: Bitter indignation at having been treated unfairly.
armB.arabic: استياء أو مرارة.. شعور بالزعل المكتوم عشان حاسس إنك اتظلمت.
examples: He is angry.
She felt sad and angry.
He felt some resentment at being left out.
Her resentment towards her boss grew every day.
The decision caused deep resentment among the staff.
He harbored a lingering resentment over the way he was dismissed.
armB.mnemonic: 'Re' 'تاني' + 'Sent' 'أرسل'.. كأن المشاعر السلبية بتتبعتلك تاني وتاني فبتحس بـ 'Resentment'.

armA.definition: Strong determination to do something.
armA.arabic: العزيمة والإصرار القوي إنك تعمل حاجة وماتتراجعش عنها.
examples: He wants to win.
She showed strong will.
I admire your resolve to finish the job.
The difficulty of the task tested his resolve.
Her resolve weakened after the bad news.
They defended their position with unwavering resolve.
armA.mnemonic: زي 'Solve' 'يحل'.. الـ 'Resolve' هو الإصرار اللي بيخليك تلاقي حل لأي مشكلة.

armB.definition: Strong determination to do something.
armB.arabic: العزيمة والإصرار القوي إنك تعمل حاجة وماتتراجعش عنها.
examples: The difficulty of the task tested his resolve.
Her resolve weakened after the bad news.
They defended their position with unwavering resolve.
armB.mnemonic: زي 'Solve' 'يحل'.. الـ 'Resolve' هو الإصرار اللي بيخليك تلاقي حل لأي مشكلة.

armA.definition: To find a solution to a problem or to decide firmly.
armA.arabic: إنك تلاقي حل لمشكلة، أو تاخد قرار حاسم بخصوص حاجة.
examples: They managed to resolve their differences.
The committee met to resolve the crisis.
We must resolve this matter immediately.
armA.mnemonic: كلمة 'Re-solve' كأنك بتحل المشكلة تاني 'Solve' لحد ما تخلص منها تماماً.

armB.definition: To find a solution to a problem or to decide firmly.
armB.arabic: إنك تلاقي حل لمشكلة، أو تاخد قرار حاسم بخصوص حاجة.
examples: I want to solve the problem.
We need to fix this issue.
They managed to resolve their differences.
The committee met to resolve the crisis.
We must resolve this matter immediately.
The mixture resolved into two distinct layers.
armB.mnemonic: كلمة 'Re-solve' كأنك بتحل المشكلة تاني 'Solve' لحد ما تخلص منها تماماً.

armA.definition: Separately or individually and in the order already mentioned.
armA.arabic: تعني 'على التوالي'. تُستخدم عند ذكر قائمتين لربط كل عنصر في القائمة الأولى بالعنصر المقابل له في القائمة الثانية بالترتيب نفسه.
examples: They won first and second prize respectively.
The cups are red and blue, for tea and coffee respectively.
The growth rates for the three sectors were 2%, 5%, and 1% respectively.
armA.mnemonic: جاية من 'Respect' بمعنى مراعاة الترتيب؛ كل عنصر يحترم دوره في الترتيب 'على التوالي'.

armB.definition: Separately or individually and in the order already mentioned.
armB.arabic: يعني 'على التوالي'. بنستخدمها لما نذكر قايمتين وعايزين نقول إن العنصر الأول في القايمة الأولى يخص العنصر الأول في القايمة التانية وهكذا.
examples: Not used in A1 contexts.
Not used in A2 contexts.
They won first and second prize respectively.
The cups are red and blue, for tea and coffee respectively.
Inputs A and B correspond to outputs X and Y respectively.
The growth rates for the three sectors were 2%, 5%, and 1% respectively.
armB.mnemonic: جاية من 'Respect' بمعنى مراعاة الترتيب.. كل واحد بيحترم دوره في الطابور 'على التوالي'.

armA.definition: The action of delaying or slowing the progress or development of something.
armA.arabic: عملية تأخير أو إبطاء النمو أو التقدم في حاجة معينة.
examples: The growth was slow.
Cold causes the retardation of plant growth.
The medicine caused a retardation of the disease.
Lack of funds led to the retardation of the project.
The retardation of the engine timing helped reduce emissions.
Severe malnutrition can result in physical and mental retardation.
armA.mnemonic: جاية من 'Retard' يعني يبطأ.. عكس 'Accelerate' يسرع.. فالكلمة معناها التباطؤ.

armB.definition: The action of delaying or slowing the progress or development of something.
armB.arabic: عملية تأخير أو إبطاء نمو شيء ما أو تقدمه.
examples: Extreme cold causes a significant retardation of plant growth.
Lack of funds led to the retardation of the project.
Engineers calculated the rate of retardation during the train's emergency stop.
armB.mnemonic: جاية من 'Retard' يعني يبطأ.. عكس 'Accelerate' يسرع.. فالكلمة معناها التباطؤ.

armA.definition: To echo or resound repeatedly; to have a continuing and widespread effect.
armA.arabic: الصوت لما يتردد ويعمل صدى قوي، أو خبر ينتشر ويعمل ضجة.
examples: The sound hit the wall.
The loud noise made the room shake.
The drum beat reverberated through the hall.
Her voice reverberated around the empty church.
The scandal reverberated through the political world.
The economic crash will reverberate for decades to come.
armA.translations: يتردد صداه / يدوي / يُحدِث صدى واسعاً
armA.mnemonic: فيها جزء 'Vibrate' 'يهتز'.. الصوت لما يـ 'Reverberate' بيعمل اهتزاز وصدى في المكان.

armB.definition: To echo or resound repeatedly; to have a continuing and widespread effect.
armB.arabic: الصوت لما يتردد ويعمل صدى قوي، أو خبر وحدث ينتشر ويترك أثراً واسعاً وعواقب ممتدة.
examples: The loud drumbeats will reverberate through the ancient stone cathedral.
Her piercing voice can reverberate around the empty auditorium without any amplification.
The economic crash will reverberate for decades to come.
armB.translations: يتردد صداه يدوي يُحدِث صدى واسعاً
armB.mnemonic: فيها جزء 'Vibrate' 'يهتز'.. الصوت لما يـ 'Reverberate' بيعمل اهتزاز وصدى في المكان.

armA.definition: To sit on and control the movement of an animal or vehicle.
armA.arabic: يركب ويسوق حاجة زي العجلة أو الحصان أو الموتوسيكل.
examples: I can ride a bike.
You can ride a horse at the farm.
Many students ride the bus to school every day.
armA.mnemonic: زي الاسم.. 'Ride' يعني يركب على الطريق 'Road'.

armB.definition: To sit on and control the movement of an animal or vehicle.
armB.arabic: يركب ويسوق حاجة زي العجلة أو الحصان أو الموتوسيكل.
examples: I can ride a bike.
He rides a horse every weekend.
They rode the bus into town.
She rode the elevator to the top floor.
He is riding high on his recent success.
The ship rode the waves gracefully.
armB.mnemonic: زي الاسم.. 'Ride' يعني يركب على الطريق 'Road'.

armA.definition: A long, narrow raised part of a surface, especially a high edge of a hill or mountain.
armA.arabic: حافة طويلة وضيقة ومرتفعة، غالباً ما تكون قمة سلسلة تلال أو جبال.
examples: The climbers traversed the narrow ridge carefully.
You can see the ocean from the ridge.
The geological formation features a prominent limestone ridge running north to south.
armA.mnemonic: كلمة 'Ridge' شبه 'Bridge' (كوبري).. تخيل الـ 'Ridge' كأنه كوبري طبيعي عالي بين الجبال.

armB.definition: A long, narrow raised part of a surface, especially a high edge of a hill.
armB.arabic: حافة طويلة وضيقة ومرتفعة، غالباً بتكون قمة سلسلة جبال.
examples: The mountain has a high top.
We walked along the top of the hill.
The path follows the ridge of the mountains.
You can see the ocean from the ridge.
The climbers traversed the narrow ridge carefully.
The geological formation features a prominent limestone ridge running north to south.
armB.mnemonic: كلمة 'Ridge' شبه 'Bridge' 'كوبري'.. تخيل الـ 'Ridge' كأنه كوبري طبيعي عالي بين الجبال.

armA.definition: To make a clear resonant sound; to call by telephone.
armA.arabic: إنك تتصل بحد بالتليفون، أو صوت الجرس لما يرن.
examples: Ring the bell.
I will ring you later.
The phone rang twice.
His words rang true.
The church bells rang out in celebration.
The whole room rang with their laughter.
armA.mnemonic: التليفون بيعمل 'Ring'.. يعني بيرن.

armB.definition: To make a clear resonant sound; to call by telephone.
armB.arabic: إنك تتصل بحد بالتليفون، أو صوت الجرس لما يرن.
examples: Please ring the bell if you need assistance.
I will ring you as soon as I get home.
Did you hear the telephone ring?
armB.mnemonic: التليفون بيعمل 'Ring'.. يعني بيرن.

armA.definition: To move upwards; to increase in amount or level.
armA.arabic: يتحرك لفوق أو يزيد، زي الشمس لما تشرق أو الأسعار لما تغلى.
examples: Prices rise every year.
Smoke started to rise from the fire.
Everyone should rise when the judge enters.
armA.mnemonic: زي 'Rice' الرز.. الرز لما بيستوي حجمه بيزيد و 'Rise' في الحلة.

armB.definition: To move upwards; to increase in amount or level.
armB.arabic: يتحرك لفوق أو يزيد، زي الشمس لما تشرق أو الأسعار لما تغلى.
examples: The sun rises in the east.
Prices rise every year.
Smoke started to rise from the fire.
Everyone should rise when the judge enters.
She rose to the challenge and succeeded.
Empires rise and fall throughout history.
armB.mnemonic: زي 'Rice' الرز.. الرز لما بيستوي حجمه بيزيد و 'Rise' في الحلة.

armA.definition: Made of or resembling rubber.
armA.arabic: مصنوع من المطاط أو شبيه به في المرونة.
examples: He wears rubber boots.
Use rubber gloves to protect your hands.
This device utilizes a rubber seal to prevent leakage.

armB.definition: Made of or resembling rubber.
armB.arabic: وصف لأي حاجة مصنوعة من المطاط أو شبهه في المرونة.
examples: He wears rubber boots.
She bought a rubber ball.
Use rubber gloves to protect your hands.
The chicken was overcooked and had a rubbery texture.
The government imposed tariffs on rubber goods.
This device utilizes a rubber seal to prevent leakage.

armA.definition: To give up something important or valuable for the sake of other considerations.
armA.arabic: إنك تقدم حاجة أو تتنازل عنها عشان حد تاني أو عشان هدف أكبر.
examples: He gave up his time.
She sacrificed her holiday to help.
I am not willing to sacrifice my principles.
They sacrificed everything for their children's education.
The company sacrificed quality for speed.
He sacrificed his political career to stand by his beliefs.
armA.mnemonic: كلمة 'Sacrifice' قريبة من 'Sacred' 'مقدس'.. عشان زمان كانوا بيضحوا بحاجات مقدسة للآلهة.

armB.definition: To give up something important or valuable for the sake of other considerations.
armB.arabic: إنك تقدم حاجة أو تتنازل عنها عشان حد تاني أو عشان هدف أكبر.
examples: I am not willing to sacrifice my principles.
Parents often sacrifice their personal comfort for their children.
The company refused to sacrifice quality for speed.
armB.mnemonic: كلمة 'Sacrifice' قريبة من 'Sacred' 'مقدس'.. عشان زمان كانوا بيضحوا بحاجات مقدسة للآلهة.

armA.definition: A seat fastened on the back of a horse or other animal for riding.
armA.arabic: السرج. المقعد الجلد اللي بيتحط على ضهر الحصان عشان تركب عليه.
examples: She adjusted the saddle before riding.
He bought a new leather saddle for his horse.
The cowboy spent long hours in the saddle.
armA.mnemonic: 'Saddle' قريبة من 'Sit'.. هو المكان اللي بتعمل فيه 'Sit' على الحصان.

armB.definition: A seat fastened on the back of a horse or other animal for riding.
armB.arabic: السرج. المقعد الجلد اللي بيتحط على ضهر الحصان عشان تركب عليه.
examples: The horse has a saddle.
He put the saddle on the pony.
My bicycle saddle is uncomfortable.
She adjusted the saddle before riding.
The cowboy spent days in the saddle.
He was saddled with debts he couldn't repay.
armB.mnemonic: 'Saddle' قريبة من 'Sit'.. هو المكان اللي بتعمل فيه 'Sit' على الحصان.

armA.definition: A large sheet of fabric used to catch the wind and move a boat.
armA.arabic: القماش الكبير اللي في المركب اللي الهوا بيزقه عشان المركب تمشي (الشراع).
examples: The boat has a white sail.
They hoisted the sail to catch the wind.
The ship proceeded under sail.
armA.mnemonic: كلمة 'Sail' نفس نطق 'Sale' 'بيع'.. بس دي 'Sail' شراع في البحر.

armB.definition: A large sheet of fabric used to catch the wind and move a boat.
armB.arabic: القماش الكبير اللي في المركب اللي الهوا بيزقه عشان المركب تمشي.
examples: The boat has a white sail.
We went for a sail on the lake.
They hoisted the sail to catch the wind.
The ship proceeded under sail.
The wind tore the mainsail.
He is an expert in the mechanics of sail.
armB.mnemonic: كلمة 'Sail' نفس نطق 'Sale' 'بيع'.. بس دي 'Sail' في البحر.

armA.definition: A man whose job is to sell goods or services, either in a store or by visiting customers.
armA.arabic: رجل وظيفته بيع البضائع أو الخدمات للعملاء ومحاولة إقناعهم بالشراء (بائع أو مندوب مبيعات).
examples: He is a car salesman.
A door-to-door salesman visited us.
The salesman used persuasive techniques to close the deal.
armA.mnemonic: مكوّنة من كلمتين: 'sales' (مبيعات) و 'man' (رجل)، أي الرجل المتخصص في المبيعات وإقناع الزبائن.

armB.definition: A man whose job is to sell products.
armB.arabic: الشخص اللي شغلته يعرض عليك منتجات ويقنعك تشتريها.
examples: He is a car salesman.
The salesman helped me.
A door-to-door salesman visited us.
He is a successful insurance salesman.
The salesman used persuasive techniques to close the deal.
Arthur Miller's 'Death of a Salesman' is a critique of the American Dream.
armB.mnemonic: 'Sales' 'مبيعات' و 'Man' 'رجل'.. الراجل بتاع الـ 'Sales' اللي بيقنعك تشتري.

armA.definition: Two slices of bread with food like cheese or meat between them.
armA.arabic: السندوتش، عيش جواه جبنة أو لحمة أو أي أكل.
examples: I ate a sandwich.
She made a cheese sandwich.
Can I have a ham sandwich?
armA.mnemonic: هي هي بالعربي 'سندوتش'.

armB.definition: Two slices of bread with food like cheese or meat between them.
armB.arabic: السندوتش، عيش جواه جبنة أو لحمة أو أي أكل.
examples: I ate a sandwich.
She made a cheese sandwich.
Can I have a ham sandwich?
We stopped for a quick sandwich.
I was sandwiched between two large men on the bus.
The sandwich generation cares for both children and aging parents.
armB.mnemonic: هي هي بالعربي 'سندوتش'.

armA.definition: A mark left on the skin after a wound, burn, or sore has healed.
armA.arabic: العلامة أو الأثر الذي يتبقى على الجلد بعد التئام الجرح أو الحرق.
examples: The cut left a small scar on his chin.
The surgery will leave a permanent scar.
The traumatic experience left a deep emotional scar.
armA.mnemonic: زي 'Scary' (مخيف).. افتكر إن الجرح ساب علامة 'Scar' شكلها بيخوف.

armB.definition: A mark left on the skin where a wound, burn, or sore has not healed completely.
armB.arabic: العلامة اللي بتفضل على الجلد بعد ما الجرح يخف.
examples: He has a mark on his face.
The cut left a small scar.
She has a scar on her knee from falling.
The surgery will leave a permanent scar.
The war left deep emotional scars on the survivors.
The landscape bore the scars of industrial mining.
armB.mnemonic: زي 'Scary' مخيف.. الجرح ساب علامة 'Scar' شكلها ممكن يكون بيخوف.

armA.definition: A large-scale systematic plan or arrangement for attaining some particular object, or a clever and often secret or dishonest plot.
armA.arabic: خطة أو نظام، وغالباً بتكون خطة سرية أو مكيدة، أو مشروع منظم.
examples: The government introduced a new pension scheme.
He devised a clever scheme to make money.
The whole scheme collapsed when the investors pulled out.
armA.mnemonic: الـ 'Scheme' هو 'Schema' أو خطة.. بس ساعات بتكون خطة شريرة.

armB.definition: A large-scale systematic plan or arrangement for attaining some particular object.
armB.arabic: خطة أو نظام، وغالباً بتكون خطة سرية أو مكيدة، أو مشروع منظم.
examples: They have a plan.
What is the color scheme?
The government introduced a new pension scheme.
He devised a clever scheme to make money.
The whole scheme collapsed when the investors pulled out.
She was unaware of the Machiavellian schemes of her rivals.
armB.mnemonic: الـ 'Scheme' هو 'Schema' أو خطة.. بس ساعات بتكون خطة شريرة.

armA.definition: A grant or payment made to support a student's education.
armA.arabic: منحة دراسية.. فلوس بتدفع للطالب المتفوق عشان يكمل تعليمه.
examples: She won a scholarship to study at the university.
The scholarship covers his tuition fees.
She applied for a sports scholarship at the university.
armA.mnemonic: جاية من 'Scholar' 'طالب علم'.. الـ 'Scholarship' هي الفلوس اللي بياخدها الـ 'Scholar' عشان يدرس.

armB.definition: A grant or payment made to support a student's education.
armB.arabic: منحة دراسية.. فلوس بتدفع للطالب المتفوق عشان يكمل تعليمه.
examples: He got money for school.
She won a scholarship.
The scholarship covers his tuition fees.
She applied for a sports scholarship at the university.
The professor was renowned for his impeccable scholarship.
This book represents a significant contribution to biblical scholarship.
armB.mnemonic: جاية من 'Scholar' 'طالب علم'.. الـ 'Scholarship' هي الفلوس اللي بياخدها الـ 'Scholar' عشان يدرس.

armA.definition: Matter that settles to the bottom of a liquid.
armA.arabic: المادة الصلبة زي الرمل أو التراب اللي بتنزل وتستقر في قاع السائل زي الميه أو القهوة.
examples: The wine has some sediment at the bottom of the bottle.
Rivers carry sediment to the ocean.
Geologists study layers of sediment to understand Earth's history.
armA.mnemonic: كلمة 'Sediment' بتبدأ بـ 'Sit'.. دي الحاجات اللي بتعمل 'Sit' وبتقعد في قاع الكباية أو النهر.

armB.definition: Matter that settles to the bottom of a liquid.
armB.arabic: المادة الصلبة زي الرمل أو التراب اللي بتنزل وتستقر في قاع السائل زي الميه أو القهوة.
examples: There is dirt at the bottom of the cup.
Sand settles as sediment in the water.
The wine has some sediment at the bottom of the bottle.
Rivers carry sediment to the ocean.
Geologists study layers of sediment to understand Earth's history.
The centrifuge is used to separate the blood cells from the sediment.
armB.mnemonic: كلمة 'Sediment' بتبدأ بـ 'Sit'.. دي الحاجات اللي بتعمل 'Sit' وبتقعد في قاع الكباية أو النهر.

armA.definition: To attempt to find something or someone, or to ask for something.
armA.arabic: إنك تدور على حاجة أو تسعى عشان توصل لهدف معين.
examples: You should seek medical advice if pain persists.
Many people seek asylum in safer countries.
We seek to improve our services.
armA.mnemonic: اربطها بكلمة 'Sick' 'مريض'.. لما تكون 'Sick' لازم 'Seek' 'تطلب/تبحث عن' مساعدة الدكتور.

armB.definition: To attempt to find something or someone, or to ask for something.
armB.arabic: إنك تدور على حاجة أو تسعى عشان توصل لهدف معين.
examples: They seek a new home.
We seek to improve our services.
You should seek medical advice if pain persists.
Many people seek asylum in safer countries.
He sought to clarify his position on the matter.
The organization seeks to promote global peace and stability.
armB.mnemonic: اربطها بكلمة 'Sick' 'مريض'.. لما تكون 'Sick' لازم 'Seek' 'تطلب/تبحث عن' مساعدة الدكتور.

armA.definition: A sudden attack of illness, or the action of capturing something by force.
armA.arabic: ليها معنيين: نوبة مرضية 'زي الصرع'، أو مصادرة شيء بالقوة 'زي الشرطة لما تصادر مخدرات'
examples: He is sick.
The police took the drugs.
The patient suffered a seizure.
The seizure of the ship caused tension.
Epileptic seizures can be controlled with medication.
The Fourth Amendment protects against unreasonable search and seizure.
armA.mnemonic: جاية من 'Seize' يعني يمسك بقوة.. المرض 'Seizes' الجسم فجأة

armB.definition: A sudden attack of illness, or the action of capturing something by force.
armB.arabic: ليها معنيين: نوبة مرضية 'زي الصرع'، أو مصادرة شيء بالقوة 'زي الشرطة لما تصادر مخدرات'
examples: The patient suffered a seizure.
The seizure of the ship caused tension.
The Fourth Amendment protects against unreasonable search and seizure.
armB.mnemonic: جاية من 'Seize' يعني يمسك بقوة.. المرض 'Seizes' الجسم فجأة

armA.definition: To give something in exchange for money.
armA.arabic: يبيع. تدي حد حاجة وتاخد مكانها فلوس.
examples: I want to sell my car.
Do you sell milk?
They sell clothes online.
The book sold a million copies.
He sold his soul for money.
The idea sold me on the project.
armA.mnemonic: عكس 'Buy'.. البياع بيعمل 'Sell' عشان ياخد فلوس.

armB.definition: To give something in exchange for money.
armB.arabic: يبيع. تدي حد حاجة وتاخد مكانها فلوس.
examples: I want to sell my car.
Do you sell milk?
They sell clothes online.
armB.mnemonic: عكس 'Buy'.. البياع بيعمل 'Sell' عشان ياخد فلوس.

armA.definition: A person who sells something.
armA.arabic: الشخص اللي بيبيع حاجة 'البائع'.
examples: He is a fruit seller.
The seller wants a high price.
This book is a best-seller.
The market is full of buyers and sellers.
It's a seller's market right now.
The seller warrants that the goods are free from defects.
armA.mnemonic: من الفعل 'Sell' 'يبيع'.. يبقى 'Seller' البائع.

armB.definition: A person who sells something.
armB.arabic: الشخص اللي بيبيع حاجة 'البائع'.
examples: He is a fruit seller.
The seller wants a high price.
The buyer and the seller agreed on a fair price.
armB.mnemonic: من الفعل 'Sell' 'يبيع'.. يبقى 'Seller' البائع.

armA.definition: To cause something to go or be taken to a destination.
armA.arabic: إنك تبعت حاجة لحد، سواء رسالة أو طرد.
examples: I send a letter to my friend.
She sent me a birthday gift.
Please send the report by email.
They sent their children to boarding school.
The explosion sent debris flying everywhere.
The news sent shockwaves through the community.
armA.mnemonic: كلمة 'Send' قريبة من 'السند'.. لما تبعت رسالة لحد كأنك بتبعتله 'سند' أو خبر.

armB.definition: To cause something to go or be taken to a destination.
armB.arabic: إنك تبعت حاجة لحد، سواء رسالة أو طرد أو شخص لمكان معين.
examples: Please send the report by email.
I send a letter to my friend every month.
Can you send me the address?
armB.mnemonic: كلمة 'Send' قريبة من 'السند'.. لما تبعت رسالة لحد كأنك بتبعتله 'سند' أو خبر.

armA.definition: Capacity for sexual feelings; a person's sexual orientation.
armA.arabic: الميول الجنسية للشخص أو قدرته على الشعور بالمشاعر دي.
examples: Love is part of life.
He is comfortable with his identity.
They discussed human sexuality in biology class.
Art often explores themes of sexuality.
The book examines the repression of female sexuality.
Freud's theories on infant sexuality were controversial.

armB.definition: Capacity for sexual feelings, or a person's sexual orientation and expression.
armB.arabic: الميول الجنسية للشخص أو قدرته وطبيعته في التعبير عن المشاعر الجنسية.
examples: They discussed human sexuality in biology class.
Art often explores themes of sexuality.
The book examines the repression of female sexuality.

armA.definition: To move quickly back and forth or up and down, or to cause something to do this.
armA.arabic: يهز حاجة جامد، زي لما تهز إزازة الدوا قبل ما تاخده، أو تهز إيد حد للسلام.
examples: You must shake the bottle well before use.
We shake hands whenever we greet each other.
Cold weather can make you shake all over.
armA.mnemonic: افتكر مشروب المشروب الشهير 'ميلك شيك' (Milkshake)؛ اسمه جاي من إنهم بيهزوا (shake) الحليب والمكونات جامد مع بعض علشان يمتزجوا.

armB.definition: To move something violently back and forth or up and down.
armB.arabic: يهز حاجة جامد، زي لما تهز إزازة الدوا قبل ما تاخده، أو تهز إيد حد للسلام.
examples: Shake the bottle before use.
We shake hands when we meet.
She was shaking with cold.
The explosion shook the whole building.
I can't seem to shake off this cold.
The news deeply shook the foundations of the organization.
armB.mnemonic: زي لما تكون بردان وبتعمل 'Shake' 'بتترعش' من البرد.

armA.definition: A flat board attached to a wall or in a cupboard for holding things.
armA.arabic: الرف اللي بنحط عليه الكتب أو الحاجات عشان ننظمها.
examples: The book is on the shelf.
Please put the cup on the top shelf.
We need to buy a new shelf for the kitchen.
armA.mnemonic: 'Shelf' شبه 'Self'.. حط كتبك اللي بتعبر عن الـ 'Self' 'نفسك' على الـ 'Shelf'.

armB.definition: A flat board attached to a wall or in a cupboard for holding things.
armB.arabic: الرف اللي بنحط عليه الكتب أو الحاجات عشان ننظمها.
examples: The book is on the shelf.
Please put the cup on the top shelf.
We need to buy a new shelf for the kitchen.
The supermarket shelves were empty.
The project has been put on the shelf for now.
The continental shelf is rich in oil resources.
armB.mnemonic: 'Shelf' شبه 'Self'.. حط كتبك اللي بتعبر عن الـ 'Self' 'نفسك' على الـ 'Shelf'.

armA.definition: To give out or reflect a bright light; to be very good at something.
armA.arabic: يا إما حاجة بتنور وتلمع، يا إما حد بيتألق وبيبقى شاطر جداً في حاجة.
examples: The stars shine brightly in the clear night sky.
This competition is a great chance for you to shine.
Please shine a light on the path so we do not trip.

armB.definition: To give out a bright light; to be very good at something.
armB.arabic: يا إما حاجة بتنور وتلمع، يا إما حد بيتألق وبيبقى شاطر جداً في حاجة.
examples: The sun shines.
The stars shine at night.
He shined his shoes for the party.
She really shines in math class.
The flashlight shone directly into my eyes.
This is a chance for you to shine and show your talent.

armA.definition: A large boat for transporting people or goods by sea.
armA.arabic: مركب كبير بيمشي في البحر وبينقل بضائع أو ناس.
examples: We traveled by ship to the island.
The cargo ship arrived at the port yesterday.
The captain steered the ship through the storm.
armA.mnemonic: شبه كلمة 'Sheep' 'خروف'.. تخيل خروف سايق 'Ship' سفينة.

armB.definition: A large boat for transporting people or goods by sea.
armB.arabic: مركب كبير بيمشي في البحر وبينقل بضائع أو ناس.
examples: The ship is big.
We traveled by ship to the island.
The cargo ship arrived at the port yesterday.
The captain steered the ship through the storm.
It was a flagship of the naval fleet.
The abandoned ship was a ghostly derelict drifting in the ocean.
armB.mnemonic: شبه كلمة 'Sheep' 'خروف'.. تخيل خروف سايق 'Ship' سفينة.

armA.definition: To kill or wound with a bullet; to film or photograph; to move suddenly.
armA.arabic: تضرب نار بمسدس، أو تصور فيديو أو صور بكاميرا.
examples: The soldier learned to shoot accurately.
They will shoot the movie in Paris.
Don't shoot!
armA.mnemonic: المخرج قال 'Shoot' عشان يبدأ التصوير.

armB.definition: To kill or wound with a bullet; to film or photograph; to move suddenly.
armB.arabic: تضرب نار بمسدس، أو تصور فيديو أو صور بكاميرا.
examples: Don't shoot!
He likes to shoot videos.
The soldier learned to shoot accurately.
They will shoot the movie in Paris.
Pain shot up his arm.
He shot a glance at his watch.
armB.mnemonic: المخرج قال 'Shoot' عشان يبدأ التصوير.

armA.definition: A tool with a broad blade used for moving loose material like earth or snow.
armA.arabic: أداة ذات نصل عريض ومقبض طويل تُستخدم لرفع ونقل المواد السائبة مثل الرمل، التراب، أو الثلج (الكوريك أو الجاروف).
examples: He used a shovel to dig a hole.
He grabbed a shovel to clear the dirt from the driveway.
Archaeologists used a small shovel to carefully remove the sediment.
armA.mnemonic: قريبة من كلمة 'shove' (يدفع/يزق)، لأنك تستخدم الـ shovel لدفع التراب أو الثلج ورفعه.

armB.definition: A tool with a broad blade used for moving loose material like earth or snow.
armB.arabic: أداة ليها يد طويلة وسلاح عريض بنستخدمها عشان نشيل بيها التراب أو الرمل أو التلج 'الكوريك'.
examples: I need a shovel.
He used a shovel to dig a hole.
We have to shovel the snow off the driveway.
The workers leaned on their shovels during the break.
They shoveled money into the failing project to no avail.
Archaeologists used a small shovel to carefully remove the sediment.
armB.mnemonic: قريبة من كلمة 'Shove' 'يزق'.. لأنك بالـ 'Shovel' بتزق التراب وتشيله.

armA.definition: To become smaller in size or amount.
armA.arabic: إن الحاجة تصغر في الحجم أو تقل في المقدار، زي الهدوم لما تتغسل بمية سخنة وتكش، أو الأرباح لما تنقص.
examples: The company's profits began to shrink.
She did not shrink from her responsibilities.
Don't wash it in hot water or it will shrink.
armA.mnemonic: اربطها بصوت 'Sh' 'ش' في كلمة 'يكش'.. الـ 'Shrink' يعني يكش ويصغر.

armB.definition: To become smaller in size or amount.
armB.arabic: إن الحاجة تصغر في الحجم، زي الهدوم لما تتغسل بمية سخنة وتكش.
examples: Will this shirt shrink?
My sweater shrank in the wash.
The company's profits began to shrink.
Don't wash it in hot water or it will shrink.
She did not shrink from her responsibilities.
The market share continued to shrink despite their efforts.
armB.mnemonic: اربطها بصوت 'Sh' 'ش' في كلمة 'يكش'.. الـ 'Shrink' يعني يكش ويصغر.

armA.definition: To be an indication of; to mean something.
armA.arabic: يدل على حاجة أو يكون علامة ليها، أو يعبر عن معنى معين.
examples: She nodded to signify her agreement.
The dark clouds signify a coming storm.
What does this ancient symbol signify?
armA.mnemonic: جاية من 'Sign' 'علامة'.. الـ 'Signify' هو إنك تدي 'Sign' أو دلالة.

armB.definition: To be an indication of; to mean something.
armB.arabic: يدل على حاجة أو يكون علامة ليها، أو يعبر عن معنى معين.
examples: Not used in A1.
Red lights signify stop.
This symbol signifies peace.
She nodded to signify her agreement.
The dark clouds signify a coming storm.
In this novel, the river signifies the flow of time and life.
armB.mnemonic: جاية من 'Sign' 'علامة'.. الـ 'Signify' هو إنك تدي 'Sign' أو دلالة.

armA.definition: Having the color of silver; shiny gray-white.
armA.arabic: لونه فضي، زي لون معدن الفضة.
examples: I have a silver car.
She wore a silver dress.
He won a silver medal in the competition.

armB.definition: Having the color of silver; shiny gray-white.
armB.arabic: لونه فضي، زي لون معدن الفضة.
examples: I have a silver car.
She wore a silver dress.
The moon cast a silver light on the water.
He won a silver medal in the competition.
She has a silver tongue and can persuade anyone.
The problem with the 'silver bullet' solution is that it rarely exists in complex systems.

armA.definition: Occurring, operating, or done at the same time.
armA.arabic: متزامن. يعني حاجتين بيحصلوا مع بعض في نفس اللحظة بالظبط.
examples: The software allows simultaneous access for multiple users.
Simultaneous interpretation is a very difficult skill.
The two events were simultaneous.
armA.mnemonic: 'Simul' في الأول زي 'Simulation' أو 'Similar'.. حاجات ماشية مع بعض في نفس الوقت.

armB.definition: Occurring, operating, or done at the same time.
armB.arabic: متزامن. يعني حاجتين بيحصلوا مع بعض في نفس اللحظة بالظبط.
examples: They arrived at the same time.
The two events were simultaneous.
There was a simultaneous applause from the crowd.
The software allows simultaneous access for multiple users.
Simultaneous interpretation is a very difficult skill.
The composer used simultaneous rhythms to create a chaotic effect.
armB.mnemonic: 'Simul' في الأول زي 'Simulation' أو 'Similar'.. حاجات ماشية مع بعض في نفس الوقت.

armA.definition: Free from pretense or deceit; proceeding from genuine feelings.
armA.arabic: يعني صادق ومخلص.. مبيكدبش ومش بيمثل
examples: He is a good friend.
Thank you for your sincere help.
I would like to offer my sincere apologies.
She seems very sincere in her beliefs.
His apology was heartfelt and sincere.
Sincere gratitude is rare in this industry.
armA.mnemonic: أصلها اللاتيني 'Sine Cera' يعني 'Without Wax'.. التمثال الأصلي مفيهوش شمع يخبي العيوب.. يبقى صادق

armB.definition: Free from pretense or deceit; proceeding from genuine feelings.
armB.arabic: يعني صادق ومخلص.. مبيكدبش ومش بيمثل
examples: Thank you for your sincere help.
She seems very sincere in her beliefs.
His apology was heartfelt and sincere.

armA.definition: To make musical sounds with the voice.
armA.arabic: يغني.. يطلع صوت موسيقي بكلام ولحن.
examples: I like to sing.
She sings beautifully.
They sang a song together.
He was singing in the shower.
The opera star sang with incredible power.
The poet sings of the heroes of old.
armA.mnemonic: الـ 'Singer' بيعمل إيه؟ بيعمل 'Sing'.

armB.definition: To make musical sounds with the voice.
armB.arabic: يغني.. يطلع صوت موسيقي بكلام ولحن.
examples: I like to sing.
Can you sing this song?
They often sing together in the car.
armB.mnemonic: الـ 'Singer' بيعمل إيه؟ بيعمل 'Sing'.

armA.definition: To go down below the surface of a liquid; to submerge.
armA.arabic: يعني يغرق أو ينزل تحت سطح الميه. وممكن تيجي بمعنى ينخفض أو يهبط.
examples: Stones sink in water.
The ship began to sink.
The sun started to sink below the horizon.
My heart sank when I heard the bad news.
They decided to sink their differences and work together.
The company could sink into bankruptcy if sales don't improve.
armA.mnemonic: السفينة لما بتغرق بنقول عليها 'Sink'.. افتكر التايتنيك وهي بتعمل 'Sinking'.

armB.definition: To go down below the surface of a liquid; to submerge.
armB.arabic: يعني يغرق أو ينزل تحت سطح الميه. وممكن تيجي بمعنى ينخفض أو يهبط.
examples: Stones sink in water.
The ship began to sink.
The sun started to sink below the horizon.
armB.mnemonic: السفينة لما بتغرق بنقول عليها 'Sink'.. افتكر التايتنيك وهي بتعمل 'Sinking'.

armA.definition: A polite way of addressing a man.
armA.arabic: لقب احترام بتقوله لراجل، زي 'يا فندم' أو 'سيدي'.
examples: Yes, sir.
Excuse me, sir, you dropped this.
Can I help you, sir?
Dear Sir or Madam (in a letter).
He was knighted and is now called Sir Elton.
The officer demanded to be addressed as 'Sir' at all times.
armA.mnemonic: كلمة 'Sir' قريبة من 'سِر'.. كأنك بتكلم حد صاحب 'سر' أو مكانة عالية

armB.definition: A polite and formal way of speaking to or addressing a man.
armB.arabic: لقب احترام يُستخدم لمخاطبة الرجل بأدب، بمعنى «يا فندم» أو «سيدي».
examples: Excuse me, sir, you dropped this.
May I help you, sir?
Yes, sir, right away.
armB.mnemonic: كلمة 'Sir' قريبة في النطق من 'سِر'.. تخيل أنك تخاطب شخصاً مهماً وصاحب 'سر' ومكانة باحترام.

armA.definition: To be in a position where your bottom is resting on a chair or the ground.
armA.arabic: يجلس. يعني تقعد على كرسي أو على الأرض، بحيث جسمك يكون مرتاح ومش واقف
examples: Please sit on the chair.
I sit next to my friend in class.
You can sit here while you wait.
armA.mnemonic: كلمة 'Sit' شبه كلمة 'Set'.. لما تعمل 'Set' لحاجة يعني بتثبتها، وإنت لما تقعد بتثبت مكانك

armB.definition: To be in a position where your bottom is resting on a chair or the ground.
armB.arabic: يجلس. يعني تقعد على كرسي أو على الأرض، بحيث جسمك يكون مرتاح ومش واقف
examples: Please sit on the chair.
I sit next to my friend in class.
We sat around the fire and talked.
He sat on the committee for three years.
The house sits high on a hill overlooking the valley.
They sat in judgment of their peers without knowing the full story.
armB.mnemonic: كلمة 'Sit' شبه كلمة 'Set'.. لما تعمل 'Set' لحاجة يعني بتثبتها، وإنت لما تقعد بتثبت مكانك

armA.definition: The number 16; one more than fifteen.
armA.arabic: الرقم اللي بيجي بعد خمستاشر وقبل سبعتاشر.
examples: I have sixteen books.
She is sixteen years old.
The building has sixteen floors.
There are sixteen ounces in a pound.
He inherited a fortune at the tender age of sixteen.
The manuscript dates back to the sixteenth century.
armA.mnemonic: 'Six' يعني ستة، و 'Teen' يعني طعش.. يبقى 'Sixteen' ستطاعش أو ستة عشر

armB.definition: The number 16; one more than fifteen.
armB.arabic: العدد 16 (ستة عشر)، وهو الرقم الذي يلي خمسة عشر وقبل سبعة عشر.
examples: She is sixteen years old.
I have sixteen books.
The building has sixteen floors.
armB.mnemonic: 'Six' يعني ستة، و 'Teen' يعني طعش.. يبقى 'Sixteen' ستطاعش أو ستة عشر

armA.definition: A large, thick, flat piece of stone, concrete, or wood.
armA.arabic: حتة كبيرة وتخينة ومسطحة من الحجر أو الخرسانة، زي بلاطة الرصيف بس ضخمة.
examples: They poured a concrete slab for the patio.
He sat on a slab of rock.
She cut a thick slab of cake for him.
armA.mnemonic: كلمة 'Slab' صوتها تقيل زي الحجر.. 'سْلاب' هبدة حجر على الأرض.

armB.definition: A large, thick, flat piece of stone, concrete, or wood.
armB.arabic: حتة كبيرة وتخينة ومسطحة من الحجر أو الخرسانة، زي بلاطة الرصيف بس ضخمة.
examples: A big stone piece.
He sat on a slab of rock.
They poured a concrete slab for the patio.
She cut a thick slab of cake for him.
The bodies were laid out on cold stone slabs.
The tectonic slab movement caused the earthquake.
armB.mnemonic: كلمة 'Slab' صوتها تقيل زي الحجر.. 'سْلاب' هبدة حجر على الأرض.

armA.definition: To rest with your eyes closed and your mind and body inactive.
armA.arabic: ينام، يعني يرتاح ويغمض عينه ويفصل عن العالم.
examples: I sleep at night.
She sleeps for eight hours.
I couldn't sleep because of the noise.
He slept through the alarm.
I'll sleep on it and tell you my decision tomorrow.
The city that never sleeps is New York.
armA.mnemonic: لما تكون تعبان لازم تـ 'Sleep' عشان ترتاح.

armB.definition: To rest with your eyes closed and your mind and body inactive.
armB.arabic: ينام، يعني يرتاح ويغمض عينه ويفصل عن العالم.
examples: I sleep at night.
I couldn't sleep because of the noise.
You should sleep for eight hours every night.
armB.mnemonic: لما تكون تعبان لازم تـ 'Sleep' عشان ترتاح.

armA.definition: A structure for sliding down; or a single page in a presentation.
armA.arabic: الزحليقة اللي بيلعب عليها الأطفال، أو الشريحة اللي بنعرض عليها صور ومعلومات في البرزنتيشن.
examples: The children played on the slide.
I made a slide for my presentation.
The economy went into a downward slide.
armA.mnemonic: الـ 'Slider' في الأكل صغير وبيزحلق في البطن.. الـ 'Slide' هي الزحليقة أو الحركة الناعمة دي.

armB.definition: A structure for sliding down; or a single page in a presentation.
armB.arabic: الزحليقة اللي بيلعب عليها الأطفال، أو الشريحة اللي بنعرض عليها صور ومعلومات في البرزنتيشن.
examples: The children played on the slide.
I made a slide for my presentation.
He looked at the cell under a microscope slide.
The economy went into a downward slide.
The landslide blocked the road.
The lecture was accompanied by a series of detailed slides.
armB.mnemonic: الـ 'Slider' في الأكل صغير وبيزحلق في البطن.. الـ 'Slide' هي الزحليقة أو الحركة الناعمة دي.

armA.definition: To move smoothly along a surface.
armA.arabic: يتحرك بنعومة وسهولة على سطح أملس، زي التزحلق على الجليد أو لما تزق حاجة على الترابيزة.
examples: I slide on the ice.
Slide the door open.
The glass slid off the table.
He slid the money into his pocket.
She let things slide at work recently.
The country is sliding into chaos.

armB.definition: To move smoothly along a surface, or to make something move smoothly across a surface.
armB.arabic: يتحرك بسلاسة وخفة على سطح أملس، مثل التزحلق على الجليد أو تمرير شيء بنعومة على طاولة.
examples: Children love to slide across the frozen pond in winter.
You can slide the glass door open to let in fresh air.
Please slide the folder across the desk so I can review it.

armA.definition: Being the only one; single and not shared with others.
armA.arabic: الوحيد أو المنفرد، لا يشاركه غيره؛ مثل قولك «المالك الوحيد» أو «المسؤول الوحيد».
examples: He was the sole survivor of the plane crash.
She has sole responsibility for managing the project.
The company is the sole supplier of this medical equipment.
