armB.mnemonic: 'View' 'منظر' + 'Point' 'نقطة'.. النقطة اللي بتشوف منها الموضوع.

armA.definition: A group of houses and associated buildings, larger than a hamlet and smaller than a town, situated in a rural area.
armA.arabic: قرية، مكان صغير الناس بتعيش فيه في الريف، أصغر من المدينة.
examples: I live in a small village.
The village is near the mountains.
Everyone in the village knows each other.
armA.mnemonic: كلمة 'Village' شبه 'Villa'.. الـ 'Village' 'القرية' هي مكان فيه بيوت صغيرة.

armB.definition: A group of houses and associated buildings, larger than a hamlet and smaller than a town, situated in a rural area.
armB.arabic: قرية، مكان صغير الناس بتعيش فيه في الريف، أصغر من المدينة.
examples: I live in a small village.
The village is near the mountains.
Everyone in the village knows each other.
They are building a new road to the village.
The Olympic Village hosted thousands of athletes.
The concept of the 'global village' predicts closer world connection.
armB.mnemonic: كلمة 'Village' شبه 'Villa'.. الـ 'Village' 'القرية' هي مكان فيه بيوت صغيرة.

armA.definition: A small printed piece of paper that entitles the holder to a discount or goods.
armA.arabic: ورقة أو كوبون بيديك الحق تاخد خصم أو تشتري حاجة ببلاش، زي كروت الهدايا.
examples: I have a paper for free food.
Use this voucher at the shop.
I received a gift voucher for my birthday.
This voucher is valid for three months.
The government issued travel vouchers to boost tourism.
Redeeming the voucher required adherence to strict terms and conditions.
armA.mnemonic: كلمة 'Voucher' شبه 'Vouch' 'يضمن'.. الورقة دي بتضمن لك الخصم.

armB.definition: A printed piece of paper or electronic code that entitles the holder to a discount, goods, or services.
armB.arabic: قسيمة أو إيصال (ورقي أو إلكتروني) يمنح حامله الحق في خصم أو شراء بضائع وخدمات مجانية أو مخفضة.
examples: I received a gift voucher for my birthday.
This voucher is valid for three months.
You can redeem the voucher at any participating store.
armB.mnemonic: كلمة 'Voucher' مشتقة من 'vouch' أي يضمن؛ فالقسيمة تضمن لك حق الحصول على البضاعة أو الخصم.

armA.definition: A vehicle used for transporting goods or another specified purpose, often pulled by a horse.
armA.arabic: عربية نقل بضائع، زمان كانت بتتجر بالحصنة، ودلوقتي ممكن تتقال على عربيات الأطفال أو عربيات القطار.
examples: The horse pulls the wagon.
The child pulled his toys in a red wagon.
They loaded the hay onto the wagon.
armA.mnemonic: كلمة 'Wagon' شبه 'Volkswagen' 'ماركة العربيات'.. والاتنين عربيات.

armB.definition: A vehicle used for transporting goods or another specified purpose, often pulled by a horse.
armB.arabic: عربية نقل بضائع، زمان كانت بتتجر بالحصنة، ودلوقتي ممكن تتقال على عربيات الأطفال أو عربيات القطار.
examples: The horse pulls the wagon.
The child pulled his toys in a red wagon.
They loaded the hay onto the wagon.
The settlers traveled west in covered wagons.
He has been on the wagon (sober) for three years.
The band jumped on the bandwagon when the style became popular.
armB.mnemonic: كلمة 'Wagon' شبه 'Volkswagen' 'ماركة العربيات'.. والاتنين عربيات.

armA.definition: To stop sleeping; to become aware.
armA.arabic: يصحى من النوم، أو يفوق لنفسه.
examples: I wake up at seven every morning.
Please wake me up early tomorrow.
Sudden loud noises can wake the baby.
armA.mnemonic: 'وايك'.. اصحى وفوق 'Wake up'.

armB.definition: To stop sleeping; to become aware.
armB.arabic: يصحى من النوم، أو يفوق لنفسه.
examples: I wake up at 7 AM.
Please wake me up early.
The noise woke the baby.
We need to wake up to the reality of the situation.
The incident woke memories of his childhood.
It is time to wake from this collective slumber.
armB.mnemonic: 'وايك'.. اصحى وفوق 'Wake up'.

armA.definition: A written guarantee promising to repair or replace an article if necessary.
armA.arabic: وعد مكتوب من الشركة إنها تصلحلك الجهاز أو تبدله لو باظ في فترة معينة 'الضمان'.
examples: The TV has a guarantee.
Is the phone under warranty?
The warranty covers repairs for one year.
I bought an extended warranty for my laptop.
The warranty is void if you open the device yourself.
Consumer laws imply a warranty of merchantability for most goods.
armA.mnemonic: جاية من 'Warrant' يضمن.. دي ورقة الضمان اللي بتحفظ حقك.

armB.definition: A written guarantee promising to repair or replace an article if necessary.
armB.arabic: وعد مكتوب من الشركة إنها تصلحلك الجهاز أو تبدله لو باظ في فترة معينة 'الضمان'.
examples: The warranty covers repairs for one year.
The warranty is void if you open the device yourself.
I bought an extended warranty for my laptop.
armB.mnemonic: جاية من 'Warrant' يضمن.. دي ورقة الضمان اللي بتحفظ حقك.

armA.definition: To have clothing, jewelry, or other accessories on your body.
armA.arabic: يلبس أو يرتدي هدوم أو إكسسوارات.
examples: I wear glasses.
You should wear sunscreen on the beach.
Do you wear a uniform to school?
armA.mnemonic: نفس الرابط: الـ 'Wear' 'اللبس' اللي هـ 'Wear' 'ألبسه' 'Where' 'فين'؟

armB.definition: To have clothing, jewelry, or other accessories on your body.
armB.arabic: يلبس أو يرتدي هدوم أو إكسسوارات.
examples: I wear glasses.
She wears a uniform to school.
He was wearing a black suit.
You should wear sunscreen on the beach.
The carpet is wearing thin in the middle.
She wore an expression of utter disbelief.
armB.mnemonic: نفس الرابط: الـ 'Wear' 'اللبس' اللي هـ 'Wear' 'ألبسه' 'Where' 'فين'؟

armA.definition: A network of fine threads made by a spider; the Internet.
armA.arabic: شبكة خيوط بيعملها العنكبوت، أو شبكة الإنترنت اللي بتربط العالم ببعضه.
examples: The spider made a web.
I search on the web.
Flies get caught in the spider's web.
The web of lies he told eventually collapsed.
It is a complex web of political alliances.
The duck's webbed feet help it swim efficiently.
armA.mnemonic: شبكة العنكبوت أو الـ 'Web' سايت.

armB.definition: A network of fine threads made by a spider; the Internet.
armB.arabic: شبكة خيوط بيعملها العنكبوت، أو شبكة الإنترنت اللي بتربط العالم ببعضه.
examples: The spider made a web.
Flies get caught in the spider's web.
You can find a lot of useful information on the web.
armB.mnemonic: شبكة العنكبوت أو الـ 'Web' سايت.

armA.definition: A wild plant growing where it is not wanted; also slang for cannabis.
armA.arabic: ليها معنيين: الأعشاب الضارة اللي بتطلع وسط الزرع، أو في العامية بتتقال على مخدر الحشيش.
examples: The garden is full of weeds.
He pulled a weed from the ground.
We need to weed the flower beds.
Dandelions are a common type of weed.
The slang term 'weed' refers to marijuana.
The invasive weed choked out the native plant species.
armA.mnemonic: كلمة 'Weed' 'عشب ضار'.. عاملة زي 'Weird' 'غريب'.. زرع غريب طالع في مكان مش مكانه.

armB.definition: A wild plant growing where it is not wanted; also slang for cannabis.
armB.arabic: ليها معنيين: الأعشاب الضارة اللي بتطلع وسط الزرع، أو في العامية بتتقال على مخدر الحشيش.
examples: He pulled a weed from the ground.
The invasive weed choked out the native plant species.
The room smelled strongly of weed after the party.
armB.mnemonic: كلمة 'Weed' 'عشب ضار'.. عاملة زي 'Weird' 'غريب'.. زرع غريب طالع في مكان مش مكانه.

armA.definition: To shed tears, typically as an expression of distress, pain, or sorrow.
armA.arabic: إنك تعيط بحرقة وبصوت، مش مجرد دمعة تنزل، غالباً من كتر الحزن أو الألم.
examples: She began to weep.
Don't weep for me.
Many in the audience began to weep openly as the memorial service concluded.
armA.mnemonic: شبه 'Wipe' 'يمسح'.. لما تعمل 'Weep' وتعيط بتحتاج 'Wipe' لدموعك.

armB.definition: To shed tears, typically as an expression of distress, pain, or sorrow.
armB.arabic: إنك تعيط بحرقة وبصوت، مش مجرد دمعة تنزل، غالباً من كتر الحزن أو الألم.
examples: She began to weep.
Don't weep for me.
He sat down and wept.
She wept tears of joy.
The mother wept over the loss of her child.
The willow trees seemed to weep over the riverbank.
armB.mnemonic: شبه 'Wipe' 'يمسح'.. لما تعمل 'Weep' وتعيط بتحتاج 'Wipe' لدموعك.

armA.definition: A very large marine mammal that breathes through a blowhole.
armA.arabic: حيوان بحري ضخم جداً بيعيش في المحيط وبيتنفس الهوا.
examples: A whale is very big.
We saw a whale in the sea.
The blue whale is the largest animal.
Whales migrate long distances every year.
Conservationists are working to protect the whale population.
The whaling industry has been heavily criticized by environmental groups.
armA.mnemonic: كلمة 'Whale' بتفكرنا بـ 'Wail' يعني عويل.. صوت الحوت ساعات بيبقى زي البكاء العالي.

armB.definition: A very large marine mammal that breathes through a blowhole.
armB.arabic: حيوان بحري ضخم جداً بيعيش في المحيط وبيتنفس الهوا.
examples: A whale is very big.
We saw a whale in the sea.
The blue whale is the largest animal.
armB.mnemonic: كلمة 'Whale' بتفكرنا بـ 'Wail' يعني عويل.. صوت الحوت ساعات بيبقى زي البكاء العالي.

armA.definition: In which place, situation, or respect; in what way.
armA.arabic: كلمة رسمية معناها 'حيث' أو 'اللي فيه'. بتستخدم لما تشير لمكان أو وثيقة أو موقف وتقول إن جواه حصل كذا.
examples: Where is the problem?
This is the room wherein we sleep.
He showed me the clause wherein the rule is written.
They signed a contract wherein they agreed to the terms.
Wherein lies the difference between the two theories?
We must create a society wherein all citizens are treated equally.
armA.mnemonic: اقسمها لـ 'Where' و 'In'.. يعني 'In where' 'في أين/في ماذا'.. بتسأل أو بتشير للي جوه الشيء.

armB.definition: In which place, situation, or respect; in what way.
armB.arabic: كلمة رسمية معناها 'حيث' أو 'اللي فيه'. بتستخدم لما تشير لمكان أو وثيقة أو موقف وتقول إن جواه حصل كذا.
examples: They signed a contract wherein they agreed to the terms.
We must create a society wherein all citizens are treated equally.
It remains unclear wherein lies the difference between the two theories.
armB.mnemonic: اقسمها لـ 'Where' و 'In'.. يعني 'In where' 'في أين/في ماذا'.. بتسأل أو بتشير للي جوه الشيء.

armA.definition: Used to say that it does not matter which of a set is chosen.
armA.arabic: أي واحد تختاره من المجموعة، مش فارقة انهي واحد.
examples: Take whichever book you want to read.
Whichever way you go, it will take an hour.
The prize will be awarded to whichever contestant scores highest.
armA.mnemonic: 'Which' 'أي' + 'Ever' 'مهما'.. يعني 'أي واحد مهما كان'.

armB.definition: Used to say that it does not matter which of the set is chosen.
armB.arabic: أي واحد تختاره من المجموعة، مش فارقة انهي واحد.
examples: Take any one.
Buy whichever you like.
Take whichever book you want to read.
Whichever way you go, it will take an hour.
Whichever decision you make, I will support you.
The prize will be awarded to whichever contestant scores highest.
armB.mnemonic: 'Which' 'أي' + 'Ever' 'مهما'.. يعني 'أي واحد مهما كان'.

armA.definition: Entirely; fully.
armA.arabic: بالكامل، يعني مية في المية من غير أي نقص.
examples: I am wholly responsible for the mistake.
The two theories are wholly different.
It was a wholly inappropriate remark for the occasion.
armA.mnemonic: جاية من 'Whole' 'كل'.. 'Wholly' يعني 'كلياً'.

armB.definition: Entirely; fully.
armB.arabic: بالكامل، يعني مية في المية من غير أي نقص.
examples: Not typically used at A1 (use 'completely').
The story is wholly true.
I am wholly responsible for the mistake.
The two theories are wholly different.
It was a wholly inappropriate remark for the occasion.
The subsidiary is a wholly owned entity of the parent corporation.
armB.mnemonic: جاية من 'Whole' 'كل'.. 'Wholly' يعني 'كلياً'.

armA.definition: To be the most successful in a competition or fight.
armA.arabic: إنك تكسب في مسابقة أو معركة وتكون الأول.
examples: I want to win the game.
She won the race yesterday.
He hopes to win the lottery.
You must work hard to win their trust.
The argument was difficult to win.
They won the contract after months of negotiation.
armA.mnemonic: اربطها برقم 'One'.. عشان تـ 'Win' لازم تطلع الـ 'One'.

armB.definition: To be the most successful in a competition or fight.
armB.arabic: إنك تكسب في مسابقة أو معركة وتكون الأول.
examples: I want to win the game.
He hopes to win the lottery.
Do you think our team will win?
armB.mnemonic: اربطها برقم 'One'.. عشان تـ 'Win' لازم تطلع الـ 'One'.

armA.definition: To turn or twist something; to move in a curving path.
armA.arabic: إنك تلف حاجة أو تدورها، زي ما بتملى 'تزنبَر' الساعة القديمة، أو الطريق لما يكون متعرج.
examples: Wind the string.
The river winds through the valley.
I need to wind my watch.
She wound the scarf around her neck.
The debate wound down to a close.
He wound up in a difficult situation.
armA.mnemonic: زي 'Rewind' 'إرجاع الشريط'.. بتلف الشريط.

armB.definition: To turn or twist something; to move in a curving path.
armB.arabic: إنك تلف حاجة أو تدورها، زي ما بتملى 'تزنبَر' الساعة القديمة، أو الطريق لما يكون متعرج.
examples: Do not forget to wind the old clock before going to sleep.
You should wind the wire carefully around the spool.
These mountain roads wind through the hills for miles.
armB.mnemonic: زي 'Rewind' 'إرجاع الشريط'.. بتلف الشريط.

armA.definition: To remove or take away; to leave a place or situation.
armA.arabic: تنسحب من مكان أو تسحب فلوسك من البنك، أو تتراجع عن كلامك.
examples: You can withdraw cash from the ATM.
The army began to withdraw from the region.
She decided to withdraw her application for the job.
armA.mnemonic: 'With' 'مع' + 'Draw' 'يسحب'.. لما تعمل 'Withdraw' يعني بتسحب نفسك أو بتسحب فلوسك وتمشي.

armB.definition: To remove or take away; to leave a place or situation.
armB.arabic: تنسحب من مكان أو تسحب فلوسك من البنك، أو تتراجع عن كلامك.
examples: I want to withdraw money.
He withdrew his hand quickly.
You can withdraw cash from the ATM.
The army began to withdraw from the region.
She decided to withdraw her application for the job.
The drug was withdrawn from the market due to side effects.
armB.mnemonic: 'With' 'مع' + 'Draw' 'يسحب'.. لما تعمل 'Withdraw' يعني بتسحب نفسك أو بتسحب فلوسك وتمشي.

armA.definition: A wild carnivorous mammal of the dog family, living and hunting in packs.
armA.arabic: الذئب. حيوان مفترس بيعيش في مجموعات وبيشبه الكلب بس أكبر وأشرس.
examples: We heard a wolf howling at the moon.
He was as hungry as a wolf after the hike.
Reintroducing the grey wolf to the ecosystem has restored ecological balance.
armA.mnemonic: الـ 'Wolf' 'الذئب' لابس 'Wool' 'صوف' خروف عشان يستخبى ويصطاد الفريسة

armB.definition: A wild carnivorous mammal of the dog family, living and hunting in packs.
armB.arabic: الذئب. حيوان مفترس بيعيش في مجموعات وبيشبه الكلب بس أكبر وأشرس.
examples: The wolf is a wild animal.
We heard a wolf howling at the moon.
A pack of wolves hunted in the forest.
He was as hungry as a wolf after the hike.
The idiom 'a wolf in sheep's clothing' describes a dangerous person pretending to be harmless.
Reintroducing the grey wolf to the ecosystem has restored ecological balance.
armB.mnemonic: الـ 'Wolf' 'الذئب' لابس 'Wool' 'صوف' خروف عشان يستخبى ويصطاد الفريسة

armA.definition: An adult female human being.
armA.arabic: الست أو السيدة البالغة.
examples: She is a nice woman.
A woman was waiting for the bus.
She is a successful business woman.
Women have fought for equal rights.
She is a woman of her word.
The portrayal of woman in art has changed.
armA.mnemonic: كلمة 'Woman' فيها 'Man'.. بس الـ 'Wo' في الأول بتميزها إنها ست.

armB.definition: An adult female human being.
armB.arabic: الست أو السيدة البالغة.
examples: She is a nice woman.

She is a woman of her word.
armB.mnemonic: كلمة 'Woman' فيها 'Man'.. بس الـ 'Wo' في الأول بتميزها إنها ست.

armA.definition: A creeping or burrowing invertebrate animal with a long, slender soft body and no limbs.
armA.arabic: كائن صغير وطويل ومالوش رجلين، بيعيش في الطين أو الأرض، وممكن نستخدمه طُعم للصيد.
examples: The bird ate a worm.
We used a worm as bait for fishing.
The gardener placed the worm back into the rich soil.
armA.mnemonic: كلمة 'Worm' قريبة من 'Warm' 'دافي'.. الدودة بتعيش في الأرض الـ 'Warm'.

armB.definition: A creeping or burrowing invertebrate animal with a long, slender soft body and no limbs.
armB.arabic: كائن صغير وطويل ومالوش رجلين، بيعيش في الطين أو الأرض، وممكن نستخدمه طُعم للصيد.
examples: The bird ate a worm.
Worms live in the ground.
We used a worm as bait for fishing.
Earthworms help to improve the soil quality.
The computer was infected by a malicious worm.
He felt like a worm after lying to his friend.
armB.mnemonic: كلمة 'Worm' قريبة من 'Warm' 'دافي'.. الدودة بتعيش في الأرض الـ 'Warm'.

armA.definition: Illegal or dishonest behavior.
armA.arabic: عمل غلط أو مخالف للقانون أو الأخلاق.
examples: She denied any wrongdoing.
The company was accused of financial wrongdoing.
The official resigned amidst allegations of serious wrongdoing.
armA.mnemonic: 'Wrong' 'غلط' + 'Doing' 'فعل'.. يعني فعل الغلط.

armB.definition: Illegal or dishonest behavior.
armB.arabic: عمل غلط أو مخالف للقانون أو الأخلاق.
examples: He did something bad.
She denied any wrongdoing.
The police investigated the wrongdoing.
He was punished for his wrongdoing.
The company was accused of financial wrongdoing.
The official resigned amidst allegations of serious wrongdoing.
armB.mnemonic: 'Wrong' 'غلط' + 'Doing' 'فعل'.. يعني فعل الغلط.

armA.definition: A large boat with sails or a motor, used for racing or pleasure trips.
armA.arabic: مركب كبير وفخم بيستخدم للفسح في البحر أو السباقات، وغالباً بيكون للأغنياء.
examples: Look at that big boat.
They went sailing on a yacht.
He bought a luxury yacht for his holiday.
The harbor was full of expensive yachts.
Owning a yacht is a symbol of immense wealth.
They chartered a private yacht to cruise the Mediterranean.
armA.mnemonic: كلمة 'Yacht' قريبة من 'Hot'.. الجو 'Hot' وعايزين نركب الـ 'Yacht'.
